title_zh: 蛋白质降解：泛素系统的三个酶与 PROTAC
title_en: Protein degradation: the three ubiquitin enzymes and PROTAC

points.zh: 开场交代进度：今天要把生化基础部分（含光合作用）讲完；蛋白质降解这一章他认为真正重要的只有两件事。
points.en: He opens by saying today will finish the basic biochemistry block including photosynthesis, and that this chapter on protein degradation really contains only two important things.

points.zh: 细胞内蛋白质降解有两条路：溶酶体降解和泛素途径降解；他说泛素途径「可能还稍微重要一点」。
points.en: Intracellular protein degradation runs by two routes, the lysosome and the ubiquitin pathway; he calls the ubiquitin pathway the somewhat more important one.

points.zh: 泛素是一个只有约 76 个氨基酸残基、约 8.5 kD 的小蛋白，分布极广，而且在各物种间序列高度保守。
points.en: Ubiquitin is a small protein of about 76 residues and about 8.5 kD, very widely distributed, and highly conserved in sequence across species.

points.zh: 问题的提法：细胞里某个蛋白已经 dysfunction、已经失活了，细胞怎么把它识别出来并降解掉——这就要靠泛素体系。
points.en: The problem as he frames it: a protein in the cell has become dysfunctional and inactive, and the cell must recognise and destroy it, which is the job of the ubiquitin system.

points.zh: 泛素体系由三个酶组成，分别叫 E1、E2、E3。
points.en: The ubiquitin system is made of three enzymes, called E1, E2 and E3.

points.zh: 他讲的 E1：负责在底物蛋白赖氨酸残基的氨基上做共价修饰，把泛素接上去，而且往往不只接一个，会接上一大串泛素。
points.en: His account of E1: it covalently modifies the amino group on a lysine residue of the substrate protein, attaching ubiquitin, and often not just one but a whole chain of them.

points.zh: 他讲的 E2：能识别已经挂上一串泛素的靶标蛋白，作用是把这个蛋白接到 E3 上面。
points.en: His account of E2: it recognises the target protein that already carries a ubiquitin chain, and its job is to hand that protein over to E3.

points.zh: 他讲的 E3：像一块「胶水」，把带泛素的蛋白和细胞里的降解体系（他提到分子伴侣、热休克蛋白）连到一起，从而靶向降解。
points.en: His account of E3: it acts like glue, joining the ubiquitinated protein to the cell's degradation machinery, for which he names chaperones and heat-shock proteins, so the target is destroyed.

points.zh: PROTAC：左边一个小分子专门抓目标蛋白，中间一个 linker，右边一个小分子专一抓 E3；这样强行让 E3 识别目标蛋白并定向降解它。他说这个方向近二十年很火，最近已有一个 PROTAC 药物上市。
points.en: PROTAC: one small molecule grabs the target protein, a linker in the middle, another small molecule specifically grabs E3, forcing E3 to recognise the target and degrade it. He notes the field has been hot for about twenty years and that a PROTAC drug has recently reached the market.

extra.zh: E1/E2/E3 的分工整段讲反了。他在 00:01:03–00:02:39 说 E1 把泛素接到底物、E2 识别底物并送给 E3、E3 只是胶水。正确的是：E1（泛素活化酶）用 ATP 把泛素 C 端甘氨酸腺苷酰化，再与自身 Cys 形成硫酯键，它只活化泛素、根本不接触底物，人细胞里只有两种；E2（泛素结合酶）通过转硫酯反应从 E1 接过泛素，是载体，也不决定特异性；E3（泛素连接酶）才是识别底物、并催化泛素转移到底物赖氨酸 ε-氨基上的那一步，底物特异性全在 E3，人有 600 多种。他在 00:03:12 讲 PROTAC 时说「一端抓 E3，一端抓目标蛋白，强行让 E3 识别这个蛋白」——那一段是对的，做卡片以 PROTAC 那个版本为准。
extra.en: The E1/E2/E3 division of labour is given backwards. At 00:01:03–00:02:39 he has E1 attaching ubiquitin to the substrate, E2 recognising the substrate and delivering it to E3, and E3 as mere glue. In fact E1 (activating enzyme) adenylylates ubiquitin's C-terminal glycine using ATP and forms a thioester with its own cysteine — it activates ubiquitin and never touches the substrate, and humans have only two of them; E2 (conjugating enzyme) receives ubiquitin by transthioesterification and is a carrier, also not specificity-determining; E3 (ubiquitin ligase) is the step that recognises the substrate and catalyses transfer of ubiquitin onto the substrate lysine ε-amino group, and all substrate specificity lives in E3, of which humans have over 600. At 00:03:12, explaining PROTAC, he says one end grabs E3 and the other grabs the target, forcing E3 to recognise it — that version is correct and is the one to remember.

extra.zh: 挂上 K48 多聚泛素链的蛋白由 26S 蛋白酶体降解，不是由分子伴侣/热休克蛋白降解，也不是送进溶酶体。26S = 20S 桶状催化核心（β1/β2/β5 三种肽酶活性）+ 19S 调节帽；19S 识别泛素链、把泛素回收、用 ATP 解折叠底物并把它塞进 20S 的腔里。热休克蛋白参与的是错误折叠蛋白的识别与递送（如 HSP70–CHIP 通路，CHIP 本身就是一个 E3），不是执行降解的机器。老师这一章把蛋白酶体整个跳过了。
extra.en: A protein carrying a K48-linked polyubiquitin chain is destroyed by the 26S proteasome, not by chaperones or heat-shock proteins, and not in the lysosome. The 26S is the barrel-shaped 20S catalytic core (three peptidase activities on β1/β2/β5) plus the 19S regulatory cap; the 19S recognises the chain, recycles the ubiquitin, unfolds the substrate using ATP and feeds it into the 20S chamber. Heat-shock proteins act in recognition and delivery of misfolded proteins (the HSP70–CHIP route, where CHIP is itself an E3), not as the shredder. He skips the proteasome entirely.

extra.zh: 泛素链的连接方式决定命运，所以「挂了泛素就是要被降解」只对一种链成立：K48 链 → 蛋白酶体降解；K63 链 → 信号转导、自噬、DNA 损伤修复；单泛素化 → 内吞与膜蛋白分选（这一条最终确实走溶酶体）。同一个泛素分子在不同赖氨酸上连接，读出的是完全不同的指令。
extra.en: The linkage type of the chain decides the fate, so the rule that ubiquitin means destruction holds for only one chain: K48 chains go to the proteasome; K63 chains signal in NF-κB activation, autophagy and DNA damage repair; monoubiquitination directs endocytosis and membrane-protein sorting, and that route does end in the lysosome. The same ubiquitin molecule linked through different lysines is read as a completely different instruction.

extra.zh: 两条降解途径的分工值得记牢：泛素-蛋白酶体处理胞内短寿命蛋白、错误折叠蛋白和细胞周期调控蛋白（cyclin），是 ATP 依赖、底物高度选择的；溶酶体用组织蛋白酶 cathepsin 在酸性 pH（约 4.5–5）工作，处理内吞进来的胞外蛋白、膜蛋白和自噬包裹的整个细胞器，选择性低、不依赖 ATP 提供水解能量。所以「细胞要精确清除某一个蛋白」用泛素，「要批量清掉一堆东西」用溶酶体。
extra.en: The division between the two routes is worth fixing: the ubiquitin–proteasome system handles short-lived cytosolic proteins, misfolded proteins and cell-cycle regulators such as cyclins, is ATP-dependent and highly substrate-selective; the lysosome uses cathepsins at acidic pH (about 4.5–5) on endocytosed extracellular proteins, membrane proteins and whole organelles delivered by autophagy, with low selectivity and no ATP requirement for the hydrolysis itself. Precise removal of one named protein is ubiquitin's job; bulk disposal is the lysosome's.

quiz.q_zh: 在泛素-蛋白酶体系统里，底物特异性由哪个组分决定？
quiz.q_en: In the ubiquitin–proteasome system, which component determines substrate specificity?

options.zh: E2 结合酶，以硫酯键携带泛素
options.en: E2 conjugating enzyme, which carries ubiquitin

options.zh: E3 连接酶，直接识别并结合底物
options.en: E3 ligase, which recognises the substrate itself

options.zh: 19S 帽，解折叠已标记的蛋白
options.en: 19S cap, which unfolds the tagged substrate

options.zh: E1 活化酶，用 ATP 活化泛素
options.en: E1 activating enzyme, which activates ubiquitin

quiz.explain_zh: E3 连接酶人类有 600 多种，靠它识别底物并把泛素转到底物赖氨酸的 ε-氨基上，PROTAC 招募的也正是它。E1 活化酶全细胞只有两种、只负责用 ATP 活化泛素 C 端，从不接触底物；E2 结合酶只是以硫酯键把泛素从 E1 传下来的载体；19S 帽是在泛素链已经装好之后才识别并解折叠底物，不参与决定谁被标记。
quiz.explain_en: Humans have over 600 E3 ligases; the E3 is what recognises the substrate and catalyses transfer of ubiquitin onto the substrate's lysine ε-amino group, and it is exactly what PROTACs recruit. The E1 activating enzyme exists in only two forms and merely activates ubiquitin's C-terminus with ATP, never contacting the substrate; the E2 conjugating enzyme is only a thioester-linked carrier passing ubiquitin down from E1; the 19S cap acts after the chain is already built, recognising and unfolding, and plays no part in choosing what gets tagged.

quiz.q_zh: 带 K48 多聚泛素链的蛋白最终由什么降解？
quiz.q_en: What finally degrades a protein carrying a K48 polyubiquitin chain?

options.zh: 溶酶体组织蛋白酶，在酸性 pH 下
options.en: Lysosomal cathepsins working at acidic pH

options.zh: 热休克蛋白 HSP70，直接把它切开
options.en: HSP70 chaperones, cleaving it apart itself

options.zh: 钙蛋白酶，在胞质中被钙离子激活
options.en: Calpains in the cytosol, activated by Ca2+

options.zh: 26S 蛋白酶体，ATP 依赖地降解
options.en: The 26S proteasome, in an ATP-dependent way

quiz.explain_zh: K48 链是送进 26S 蛋白酶体的信号：19S 帽识别链、回收泛素、用 ATP 把底物解折叠推进 20S 桶。溶酶体组织蛋白酶在酸性 pH 下降解的是内吞和自噬来的物质，不接收 K48 链；热休克蛋白 HSP70 只负责识别错误折叠蛋白并递交给 E3，本身没有蛋白酶活性；钙蛋白酶是钙激活的胞质蛋白酶，做的是有限切割而不是泛素依赖的完全降解。
quiz.explain_en: A K48 chain is the ticket into the 26S proteasome: the 19S cap reads the chain, recycles the ubiquitin and uses ATP to unfold and thread the substrate into the 20S barrel. Lysosomal cathepsins at acidic pH digest endocytosed and autophagic cargo and do not read K48 chains; HSP70 only recognises misfolded proteins and delivers them to an E3, having no protease activity of its own; calpains are calcium-activated cytosolic proteases performing limited cleavage, not ubiquitin-dependent destruction.

quiz.q_zh: PROTAC 分子发挥作用的基本原理是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the basic principle by which a PROTAC molecule works?

options.zh: 封闭目标蛋白的活性位点使其失活
options.en: Caps the target protein's own active site

options.zh: 抑制蛋白酶体，让底物在胞内堆积
options.en: Blocks the proteasome so substrates pile up

options.zh: 在目标蛋白上直接接上一条泛素链
options.en: Attaches a ubiquitin chain to the target

options.zh: 用双头分子把 E3 拉到目标蛋白上
options.en: A two-headed molecule brings E3 to the target

quiz.explain_zh: PROTAC 是一头结合目标蛋白、一头结合 E3 连接酶的双功能分子，靠 linker 把两者强行拉近，形成三元复合物后由 E3 给目标蛋白挂上泛素链，交给蛋白酶体降解；它是催化性的，一个分子可以反复起作用。封闭活性位点是传统小分子抑制剂的做法，正好是 PROTAC 要绕开的（对没有酶活口袋的蛋白无效）；抑制蛋白酶体是硼替佐米那类药，效果与降解相反；PROTAC 本身不带泛素，也不能直接把泛素接上去。
quiz.explain_en: A PROTAC is bifunctional: one end binds the target, the other binds an E3 ligase, and the linker forces them together into a ternary complex so the E3 ubiquitinates the target and the proteasome destroys it. It works catalytically, one molecule acting repeatedly. Occupying the active site is what classical inhibitors do and is precisely what PROTACs bypass, since they also work on proteins with no druggable pocket; blocking the proteasome is what bortezomib-type drugs do, the opposite effect; and a PROTAC carries no ubiquitin of its own, so it cannot attach a chain directly.

title_zh: 转氨基作用的化学：氨基酸 + α-酮酸的对调
title_en: The chemistry of transamination: swapping between an amino acid and a keto acid

points.zh: 整章蛋白质降解始终围绕一个故事：氨基是如何被消除掉的。
points.en: The whole chapter on protein degradation is organised around one question: how the amino group is got rid of.

points.zh: 原因是游离氨基在体内含量过高会导致氨中毒，所以脱氨基是这章的主线。
points.en: The reason is that too much free amino nitrogen causes ammonia toxicity, so deamination is the through-line of the chapter.

points.zh: 脱氨基主要有三种途径，第一种也是最主要的一种叫转氨基作用。
points.en: There are three main deamination routes, and the first and principal one is transamination.

points.zh: 反应图看起来复杂，其实是两个几乎一模一样的分子：一个带酮基，一个带氨基（就是经典的氨基酸，侧链写作 R1）。
points.en: The scheme looks complicated but is really two nearly identical molecules: one bearing a keto group, the other bearing an amino group — the ordinary amino acid, side chain written R1.

points.zh: 在转氨酶的作用下，氨基酸上的氨基被转移到 R2 的酮基位置上。
points.en: Under the transaminase, the amino group of the amino acid is moved onto the keto position of R2.

points.zh: R2 一般是 α-酮戊二酸；α-酮戊二酸接受氨基以后就变成谷氨酸，有时底物不同也可以生成天冬氨酸。
points.en: R2 is usually α-ketoglutarate, which becomes glutamate once it accepts the amino group; with other substrates the product can be aspartate.

points.zh: 所以转氨基最终接受氨基的那个物质，一般来说就是谷氨酸或者天冬氨酸。
points.en: So the molecule that ends up receiving the amino group in transamination is normally glutamate or aspartate.

points.zh: 谷氨酸和天冬氨酸相当于「承载了氨基的小分子」，可以把氨基运输到别的部位去。
points.en: Glutamate and aspartate act as small carrier molecules loaded with the amino group, able to ship it to other tissues.

points.zh: 他说转氨酶一般在肝脏里比较多，转氨基作用一般是在肝脏里边发生；R1 可以是任意一种氨基酸，比如体内精氨酸或苯丙氨酸太多，就把它们的氨基转给 α-酮戊二酸。
points.en: He says transaminases are mostly in the liver and that transamination generally happens there; R1 can be any amino acid, so if arginine or phenylalanine is in excess its amino group is handed to α-ketoglutarate.

extra.zh: 所有转氨酶的辅酶都是 PLP（磷酸吡哆醛，维生素 B6 的活性形式），机制是乒乓双底物（ping-pong bi-bi）：静息时 PLP 与酶自身赖氨酸形成内部醛亚胺（Schiff 碱），底物氨基酸把它置换成外部醛亚胺，α-碳去质子化生成醌型中间体，再质子化并水解，放出 α-酮酸，酶上留下磷酸吡哆胺 PMP；另一半反应再用 PMP 把氨基交给另一个 α-酮酸，PLP 复原。这就是「两个看起来一样的分子对调基团」背后真正的化学，也解释了为什么反应不放出游离氨——氮始终挂在辅酶或底物上。
extra.en: Every transaminase uses PLP (pyridoxal phosphate, the active form of vitamin B6) and runs a ping-pong bi-bi mechanism: at rest PLP is held as an internal aldimine (Schiff base) with an active-site lysine; the incoming amino acid displaces it to form the external aldimine, the α-carbon is deprotonated to a quinonoid intermediate, reprotonation and hydrolysis release the α-keto acid and leave pyridoxamine phosphate (PMP) on the enzyme; the second half-reaction gives that amino group to a different α-keto acid and regenerates PLP. This is the real chemistry behind the two look-alike molecules swapping groups, and it is why no free ammonia is released — the nitrogen is never off a carrier.

extra.zh: 转氨基本身既不产生游离氨，也不减少体内的氮总量——它只是把分散在 20 种氨基酸上的氨基「汇总」到谷氨酸和天冬氨酸这两个出口分子上。真正把氮变成游离 NH4+ 的是谷氨酸脱氢酶的氧化脱氨，真正把氮排出体外的是尿素循环。把这三步串成一条流水线（收集 → 释放 → 排出）比孤立记三种脱氨方式有用得多。
extra.en: Transamination by itself neither liberates ammonia nor removes any nitrogen from the body: it funnels amino groups scattered over twenty amino acids onto two exit molecules, glutamate and aspartate. What actually generates free NH4+ is oxidative deamination by glutamate dehydrogenase, and what actually excretes nitrogen is the urea cycle. Reading the three as one assembly line — collect, release, excrete — is far more useful than memorising three isolated mechanisms.

extra.zh: 他说「转氨基作用一般是在肝脏里边发生」。实际上 ALT/AST 等转氨酶几乎存在于所有组织，心肌、骨骼肌、肾脏的活性都很高；肝的特殊之处在于氨基的最终去向（尿素循环）在肝，而不是转氨反应只在肝。他自己在 00:09:31 前后举肌肉里丙酮酸转氨生成丙氨酸的例子，等于部分否定了这句话，但那句「主要在肝脏」始终没有明确收回。
extra.en: He states that transamination generally happens in the liver. In fact ALT/AST-type transaminases are present in virtually all tissues, with high activity in heart, skeletal muscle and kidney; what is special about the liver is that the final destination of the nitrogen — the urea cycle — is hepatic, not that the transfer reaction is confined there. Around 00:09:31 he himself gives the muscle example of pyruvate being transaminated to alanine, which partly refutes the claim, but he never explicitly withdraws it.

extra.zh: 转氨反应的标准自由能变化接近零，反应完全可逆，方向只由底物和产物的浓度决定。这一点有两个后果：一是同一个 AST 在需要时可以反向工作（尿素循环把天冬氨酸的氮送进去，就是靠线粒体型 AST 把草酰乙酸变成天冬氨酸）；二是测转氨酶活性反映的是酶的数量（漏出来多少），不是代谢方向。
extra.en: Transamination has a standard free-energy change close to zero, so it is fully reversible and its direction is set purely by the concentrations of substrates and products. Two consequences: the same AST can run backwards when needed — feeding aspartate nitrogen into the urea cycle depends on mitochondrial AST converting oxaloacetate to aspartate — and measuring transaminase activity reports how much enzyme has leaked out, not which way the metabolism is running.

quiz.q_zh: 所有转氨酶共用的辅酶是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which cofactor is shared by all transaminases?

options.zh: 磷酸吡哆醛 PLP，来自维生素 B6
options.en: Pyridoxal phosphate (PLP), from vitamin B6

options.zh: 生物素 biotin，负责携带二氧化碳
options.en: Biotin (vitamin B7), the CO2-carrying cofactor

options.zh: 黄素腺嘌呤二核苷酸，来自维生素 B2
options.en: Flavin adenine dinucleotide, from vitamin B2

options.zh: 硫胺素焦磷酸 TPP，来自维生素 B1
options.en: Thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP), from vitamin B1

quiz.explain_zh: 转氨酶靠 PLP 以内部醛亚胺／外部醛亚胺的形式暂存氨基，PMP 与 PLP 之间循环，所以维生素 B6 缺乏会同时影响转氨和脱羧两类反应。硫胺素焦磷酸 TPP 是丙酮酸脱氢酶和转酮酶那类 α-酮酸脱羧反应的辅酶；生物素是羧化酶（如丙酮酸羧化酶）携带 CO2 的辅基；黄素腺嘌呤二核苷酸参与的是脱氢反应，如琥珀酸脱氢酶。
quiz.explain_en: Transaminases park the amino group on PLP as internal and external aldimines, cycling between PLP and PMP, which is why vitamin B6 deficiency hits both transamination and decarboxylation. Thiamine pyrophosphate serves α-keto acid decarboxylations such as pyruvate dehydrogenase and transketolase; biotin is the CO2 carrier of carboxylases such as pyruvate carboxylase; flavin adenine dinucleotide serves dehydrogenations such as succinate dehydrogenase.

quiz.q_zh: 只看转氨基作用这一步，它对体内氮的净效果是什么？
quiz.q_en: Considering transamination alone, what is its net effect on the body's nitrogen?

options.zh: 把氨基集中到谷氨酸，不放游离氨
options.en: Collects amino groups onto glutamate

options.zh: 把氨基氧化成铵离子释放到血浆
options.en: Oxidises the amino group to free ammonium

options.zh: 把两个氮固定在谷氨酰胺的酰胺基
options.en: Fixes two nitrogens onto glutamine's amide

options.zh: 把氨基转成尿素随尿液排出体外
options.en: Converts amino groups into urinary urea

quiz.explain_zh: 转氨基只是把氨基在氨基酸和 α-酮酸之间对调，氮始终挂在分子上，所以体内氮的总量不变，只是被汇总到谷氨酸和天冬氨酸上等待后续处理。氧化成铵离子是谷氨酸脱氢酶催化的氧化脱氨干的事；把氮固定成谷氨酰胺酰胺基的是谷氨酰胺合成酶，要消耗 ATP；变成尿素排出是肝细胞尿素循环最后由精氨酸酶完成的。
quiz.explain_en: Transamination merely swaps the amino group between an amino acid and a keto acid; the nitrogen never leaves a molecule, so total body nitrogen is unchanged and is simply gathered onto glutamate and aspartate for later handling. Oxidation to ammonium is what glutamate dehydrogenase does; fixing nitrogen into glutamine's amide is glutamine synthetase's ATP-consuming reaction; conversion to excreted urea is the arginase step at the end of the hepatic urea cycle.

title_zh: 转氨基的生理意义、氨基酸平衡与 ALT／AST
title_en: Why transamination matters: amino acid balance and the ALT/AST readout

points.zh: 谷氨酸和天冬氨酸作为氨基载体，主要的去处是尿素循环，两者都会参与，一起把氨基运出去。
points.en: Glutamate and aspartate, as amino-group carriers, are mainly headed for the urea cycle; both take part and together move the nitrogen out.

points.zh: 谷氨酰胺只是比谷氨酸多一个氨基，两者作用基本相似，所以他让学生先记「谷氨酸或谷氨酰胺」是游离氨基的储存和运输形式。
points.en: Glutamine is just glutamate with one more amino group and their roles are broadly similar, so he tells the student to remember glutamate or glutamine as the storage and transport form of free amino nitrogen.

points.zh: 天冬氨酸也是一个很主要的运输氨基的氨基酸。
points.en: Aspartate is also a major amino acid for transporting amino groups.

points.zh: 学生提问：为什么体内精氨酸会过多？他回答这取决于吃进去的蛋白质的组成。
points.en: The student asks why arginine would ever be in excess; he answers that it depends on the composition of the protein eaten.

points.zh: 举例胶原蛋白：他说胶原不是优质蛋白，里面含三分之一比例的脯氨酸、三分之一比例的甘氨酸，吃多了就过量摄入这两种氨基酸。
points.en: His example is collagen: he calls it a poor-quality protein containing one third proline and one third glycine, so eating a lot of it delivers an excess of those two.

points.zh: 用不完的氨基酸通过转氨基把氨基运走，剩下的碳骨架大多参与到别的代谢循环里去。
points.en: The amino acids that cannot be used have their amino groups shipped away by transamination, and most of the remaining carbon skeletons enter other metabolic cycles.

points.zh: 所以转氨基的生理意义之一，是调节体内 20 种氨基酸的比例，让它维持在一个大致平衡的状态。
points.en: One physiological point of transamination is therefore to adjust the proportions of the twenty amino acids and hold them near balance.

points.zh: 谷丙转氨酶（ALT）和谷草转氨酶（AST）是体检项目：一个人肝脏受损严重时，这两个酶一般都会急速升高。
points.en: ALT and AST are routine blood-test items: when someone's liver is badly damaged, both usually rise steeply.

points.zh: 他给的解释是：这两个酶升高代表体内已经有组织在降解、有细胞大量死亡，蛋白裂解成氨基酸被释放出来。
points.en: His explanation is that a rise means tissue is already breaking down and cells are dying in bulk, releasing protein that is cleaved into amino acids.

extra.zh: 胶原蛋白的数字要修一半：甘氨酸约占 1/3 是对的，因为一级结构是 Gly-X-Y 重复，每三个残基必有一个甘氨酸（只有甘氨酸的侧链小到能塞进三股螺旋轴心）；但脯氨酸加羟脯氨酸合计只有 20–25%，不到 1/3。另外胶原被称为不完全蛋白的真正原因是缺色氨酸、蛋氨酸等必需氨基酸，而不是脯／甘比例高本身。
extra.en: Half the collagen numbers need fixing: glycine really is about one third, because the primary structure is a Gly-X-Y repeat and every third residue must be glycine — only glycine's side chain is small enough for the axis of the triple helix. But proline plus hydroxyproline together come to only 20–25%, not a third. And collagen counts as an incomplete protein because it lacks tryptophan and methionine, not because of its proline and glycine content as such.

extra.zh: ALT 与 AST 的分布差别才是它们有诊断价值的原因：ALT 几乎只在肝细胞胞质，肝特异性高；AST 分布于肝、心肌、骨骼肌、红细胞，而且有胞质型（GOT1）和线粒体型（GOT2）两种同工酶，线粒体型占肝内 AST 的大部分。所以 De Ritis 比值 AST/ALT > 2 提示线粒体受损或酒精性肝病（酒精还直接抑制 ALT 需要的 PLP），而急性病毒性肝炎时 ALT 升得更高、比值 < 1。
extra.en: The diagnostic value comes from where the two enzymes live: ALT is essentially confined to hepatocyte cytosol and is liver-specific; AST occurs in liver, heart, skeletal muscle and red cells and exists as cytosolic (GOT1) and mitochondrial (GOT2) isoenzymes, the mitochondrial form making up most of the liver's AST. Hence a De Ritis ratio AST/ALT above 2 points to mitochondrial injury or alcoholic liver disease — alcohol also depletes the PLP that ALT needs — whereas in acute viral hepatitis ALT rises higher and the ratio is below 1.

extra.zh: 转氨酶升高的直接含义只是「细胞膜完整性被破坏、胞内的酶漏进血里」，它是损伤标志，不是功能指标。肝真正的合成储备要看白蛋白、凝血酶原时间 PT/INR 和胆红素。所以在暴发性肝衰竭的终末期，转氨酶反而可能回落——不是好转，而是已经没有活肝细胞可以漏了；这时 INR 和胆红素继续恶化。
extra.en: A raised transaminase means only that membrane integrity failed and cytosolic enzyme leaked into blood; it is a damage marker, not a function test. Real hepatic synthetic reserve is read from albumin, prothrombin time (PT/INR) and bilirubin. So in the terminal phase of fulminant hepatic failure transaminases may fall — not improvement but exhaustion of living hepatocytes to leak from — while INR and bilirubin keep worsening.

extra.zh: 「剩下的碳骨架参与别的代谢循环」具体是指进 TCA 的不同入口，而这决定了氨基酸是生糖还是生酮：亮氨酸和赖氨酸只生酮（终点乙酰乙酰CoA/乙酰CoA，不能变葡萄糖）；丙氨酸、甘氨酸、丝氨酸、半胱氨酸经丙酮酸生糖；谷氨酸族（Gln、Pro、Arg、His）进 α-酮戊二酸；天冬氨酸族进草酰乙酸；苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸兼有生糖和生酮两条出口。
extra.en: The carbon skeletons entering other cycles means entering the TCA at different points, and that is what makes an amino acid glucogenic or ketogenic: leucine and lysine are purely ketogenic, ending at acetoacetyl-CoA/acetyl-CoA and unable to make glucose; alanine, glycine, serine and cysteine are glucogenic via pyruvate; the glutamate family (Gln, Pro, Arg, His) enters at α-ketoglutarate; the aspartate family enters at oxaloacetate; phenylalanine and tyrosine are both, splitting into fumarate and acetoacetate.

quiz.q_zh: AST/ALT 比值明显大于 2 通常提示什么？
quiz.q_en: What does an AST/ALT ratio well above 2 usually indicate?

options.zh: 急性甲型肝炎的典型酶谱变化
options.en: Typical enzyme pattern seen in acute hepatitis A

options.zh: 胆道梗阻造成的淤胆型肝损伤
options.en: Cholestatic injury caused by biliary obstruction

options.zh: 线粒体受损，常见于酒精性肝病
options.en: Mitochondrial damage, as in alcoholic liver disease

options.zh: 药物性肝炎早期的肝细胞水肿
options.en: Early drug-induced hepatitis with cell swelling

quiz.explain_zh: 肝内 AST 大部分是线粒体型（GOT2），只有线粒体也被破坏时它才会大量漏出，同时酒精消耗 PLP 使 ALT 活性偏低，两个因素一起把比值推高到 2 以上。急性甲型肝炎主要伤胞质膜，ALT 升得更高、比值反而小于 1；胆道梗阻的特征是碱性磷酸酶 ALP 和 γ-GT 升高，转氨酶只轻度上升；药物性肝炎早期以 ALT 升高为主，比值也不会到 2。
quiz.explain_en: Most hepatic AST is the mitochondrial isoenzyme (GOT2) and escapes in quantity only when mitochondria are destroyed too, while alcohol depletes the PLP that ALT needs, so both factors push the ratio past 2. Acute hepatitis A damages the plasma membrane, raising ALT more and giving a ratio below 1; biliary obstruction is marked instead by high alkaline phosphatase and γ-GT with only mild transaminase rise; early drug-induced hepatitis is also ALT-predominant and does not reach a ratio of 2.

quiz.q_zh: 关于胶原蛋白的氨基酸组成，哪一句是准确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about collagen's amino acid composition is accurate?

options.zh: 色氨酸含量很高，因此属于优质蛋白
options.en: Tryptophan is abundant, making it a fine protein

options.zh: 甘氨酸约占三分之一，每三残基一个
options.en: Glycine is about one third, every third residue

options.zh: 脯氨酸约占三分之一，甘氨酸占四分之一
options.en: Proline is about a third and glycine a quarter

options.zh: 羟脯氨酸约占一半，其余多为甘氨酸
options.en: Hydroxyproline is half, the rest mostly glycine

quiz.explain_zh: 胶原的一级结构是 Gly-X-Y 重复，每三个残基必有一个甘氨酸，因为只有它的侧链（一个氢）小到能塞进三股螺旋的轴心，所以约占 1/3。脯氨酸加羟脯氨酸合计只有 20–25%，说脯氨酸占三分之一是把课上的数字直接搬来了；羟脯氨酸占一半更远超实际，它只是 Y 位上的部分修饰产物；胶原恰恰缺色氨酸和蛋氨酸，这才是它算不完全蛋白的原因。
quiz.explain_en: Collagen's primary structure is a Gly-X-Y repeat, so every third residue is glycine — only its single-hydrogen side chain fits the axis of the triple helix — giving about one third. Proline plus hydroxyproline reach only 20–25%, so putting proline at a third simply repeats the lecture's figure; hydroxyproline at half is further off still, since it is only a partial modification at the Y position; and collagen specifically lacks tryptophan and methionine, which is why it is an incomplete protein.

quiz.q_zh: 血中转氨酶升高最直接说明的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does a rise in serum transaminases most directly show?

options.zh: 胆红素的结合与排泄发生障碍
options.en: Bilirubin conjugation and excretion are impaired

options.zh: 肝内凝血因子的合成明显减少
options.en: Hepatic clotting factor synthesis has dropped

options.zh: 肝脏合成白蛋白的能力已经下降
options.en: The liver's capacity to make albumin has fallen

options.zh: 细胞膜受损，胞内的酶漏出来
options.en: Membrane damage let cytosolic enzymes leak

quiz.explain_zh: 转氨酶本来在细胞内，血里测到升高只能说明细胞膜完整性被破坏、酶漏了出来，是损伤标志。白蛋白下降、凝血因子合成减少（表现为 PT/INR 延长）反映的是肝的合成功能，两者与转氨酶不是同一维度，肝衰竭终末期甚至可以出现转氨酶回落而 INR 继续恶化；胆红素代谢障碍反映的是排泄与胆道通路，对应的指标是胆红素和 ALP。
quiz.explain_en: Transaminases are intracellular, so finding them elevated in blood shows only that membrane integrity failed and enzyme leaked out — a marker of damage. Falling albumin and reduced clotting factor synthesis, seen as a prolonged PT/INR, report synthetic function, a different axis entirely; in terminal liver failure transaminases can even fall while INR keeps worsening. Impaired bilirubin handling reports excretion and the biliary route, tracked by bilirubin and alkaline phosphatase.

title_zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环与氨基的储存形式
title_en: The glucose–alanine cycle and the storage form of amino nitrogen

points.zh: 他先回顾昨天讲过的几个循环（Cori 循环等），然后讲他称为「葡萄糖丙酮酸循环」的这一个。
points.en: He recalls the cycles covered the day before, such as the Cori cycle, then turns to the one he calls the glucose–pyruvate cycle.

points.zh: 这个循环的主要功能是以丙氨酸（alanine）或别的氨基酸的形式，把氨基运输到肝这个部位。
points.en: Its main function is to ship the amino group to the liver in the form of alanine or other amino acids.

points.zh: 他举的例子在肌肉：肌肉里主要进行 EMP 途径，也就是糖酵解。
points.en: His example is muscle, where the EMP pathway — glycolysis — predominates.

points.zh: 所以肌肉里如果短时间大量运动，就会堆积大量的丙酮酸。
points.en: So a burst of intense exercise piles up a large amount of pyruvate in muscle.

points.zh: 丙酮酸在肌肉里经过一次转氨基作用变成丙氨酸，再以丙氨酸的形式通过血液运输到肝里边。
points.en: In muscle that pyruvate is transaminated to alanine, which then travels through the blood to the liver.

points.zh: 到了肝以后，丙氨酸可以进入糖异生，或者把它的氨基交给肝里边别的分子，总之被利用起来。
points.en: Once in the liver, alanine can enter gluconeogenesis or hand its amino group to other hepatic molecules — either way it gets used.

points.zh: 他说这个循环总的目的是把肌肉里堆积的丙酮酸消耗掉，因为丙酮酸太多会在肌肉里转化成乳酸，而乳酸很大程度上会导致肌肉酸痛。
points.en: He says the overall purpose is to consume the pyruvate accumulating in muscle, because excess pyruvate turns into lactate there, and lactate largely causes muscle soreness.

points.zh: 他补充：丙氨酸不是主要的氨基储存物质，因为它由丙酮酸接受氨基而来，而丙酮酸并不是转氨基的主要底物；主要底物是 α-酮戊二酸或谷氨酸。
points.en: He adds that alanine is not the main storage form of amino nitrogen, since it comes from pyruvate accepting a group and pyruvate is not the main transamination substrate — α-ketoglutarate or glutamate is.

points.zh: 结论：α-酮戊二酸接受氨基变谷氨酸，谷氨酸再接受则变谷氨酰胺；所以体内游离氨基主要的储存和运输形式是谷氨酰胺（他说记成谷氨酸也差不多，两者容易互变）。
points.en: Conclusion: α-ketoglutarate accepting a group gives glutamate, and glutamate accepting another gives glutamine, so the main storage and transport form of free amino nitrogen is glutamine — he adds that remembering glutamate is nearly as good since the two interconvert easily.

extra.zh: 名字他说错了三次：「葡萄糖-丙酮酸循环」应为葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环（glucose–alanine cycle，又称 Cahill 循环）。他描述的过程本身完全正确：肌肉丙酮酸转氨生成丙氨酸 → 血液 → 肝 → 转氨回丙酮酸 → 糖异生成葡萄糖 → 回到肌肉。名字里必须是丙氨酸，因为在血里跑的就是丙氨酸这个分子。
extra.en: He says the name wrong three times: the glucose–pyruvate cycle should be the glucose–alanine cycle (also called the Cahill cycle). The process he describes is entirely correct — muscle pyruvate is transaminated to alanine, travels in blood to the liver, is transaminated back to pyruvate, becomes glucose by gluconeogenesis and returns to muscle. The name must say alanine because alanine is the molecule actually circulating.

extra.zh: 「乳酸导致肌肉酸痛」是流行误解。运动产生的乳酸在运动结束后约一小时内基本清除干净（它还是心肌、慢肌纤维和肝的燃料），而延迟性肌肉酸痛 DOMS 在运动后 24–72 小时才达到高峰，来源是离心收缩造成的肌纤维微损伤和随后的炎症反应——时间尺度就对不上。运动当时的灼烧感与 H+ 和无机磷酸盐等代谢物累积有关，那也不是乳酸分子本身干的。
extra.en: Blaming lactate for muscle soreness is a popular myth. Lactate produced in exercise is essentially cleared within about an hour after stopping — it is fuel for heart, slow fibres and liver — whereas delayed-onset muscle soreness peaks 24–72 hours later and comes from microdamage to fibres caused by eccentric contraction plus the inflammation that follows; the timescales simply do not match. The burning felt during exercise tracks H+ and inorganic phosphate accumulation, and even that is not the lactate molecule itself.

extra.zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环真正的意义是把肌肉蛋白分解产生的氨基氮以无毒形式（丙氨酸）安全运到肝，同时回收碳骨架；「消耗丙酮酸防止酸痛」不是它的目的。和 Cori 循环对照记最清楚：Cori 循环运的是乳酸，只搬碳，肝里乳酸脱氢回丙酮酸；葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环运的是丙氨酸，同时搬碳和氮，肝里多一步转氨把氮卸下来进尿素循环。两者的葡萄糖回程是一样的。
extra.en: The real point of the glucose–alanine cycle is to move amino nitrogen from muscle protein breakdown to the liver in a non-toxic form while recovering the carbon skeleton; consuming pyruvate to prevent soreness is not its purpose. It is clearest against the Cori cycle: Cori ships lactate and moves carbon only, with lactate dehydrogenated back to pyruvate in the liver; the glucose–alanine cycle ships alanine and moves carbon and nitrogen together, with an extra transamination in the liver that unloads the nitrogen into the urea cycle. The glucose return leg is identical.

extra.zh: 谷氨酰胺是血浆中浓度最高的游离氨基酸，也是骨骼肌里含量最高的游离氨基酸，这正是它当「氨的运输车」的资格：一个分子带两个氮（α-氨基和 γ-酰胺氮），而且中性、不带净电荷、可被多种组织的谷氨酰胺酶就地卸载。肾在酸中毒时用谷氨酰胺酶产 NH4+ 随尿排酸，肠上皮把谷氨酰胺当首选燃料，走的都是这条供应线。
extra.en: Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in plasma and also in skeletal muscle, which is exactly its qualification as the ammonia truck: one molecule carries two nitrogens (the α-amino and the γ-amide), it is neutral with no net charge, and glutaminase in many tissues can unload it on site. The kidney's use of glutaminase to excrete NH4+ during acidosis, and the gut epithelium's preference for glutamine as fuel, both draw on this same supply line.

quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环与 Cori 循环最关键的区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the key difference between the glucose–alanine cycle and the Cori cycle?

options.zh: 前者在肾脏进行，后者在肝脏进行
options.en: One runs in the kidney, the other in liver

options.zh: 前者不需要糖异生，后者需要糖异生
options.en: One skips gluconeogenesis, the other needs it

options.zh: 前者只在心肌，后者只在骨骼肌进行
options.en: One is cardiac only, the other skeletal only

options.zh: 前者运丙氨酸，同时把氮带给肝
options.en: Alanine is shipped, carrying nitrogen too

quiz.explain_zh: 两个循环的葡萄糖回程完全一样，差别在往肝去的那一程运的是什么：Cori 循环运乳酸，只搬碳；葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环运丙氨酸，碳和氮一起搬，肝里多一步转氨把氮卸进尿素循环。两者都发生在肌肉与肝之间，不涉及肾脏；两者都靠肝的糖异生把三碳单位变回葡萄糖；两者都以骨骼肌为主要外周端，心肌不是任何一个的专属场所。
quiz.explain_en: The glucose return leg is identical in both; the difference is what travels toward the liver. The Cori cycle carries lactate and moves carbon only, while the glucose–alanine cycle carries alanine and moves carbon and nitrogen together, with an extra hepatic transamination that unloads nitrogen into the urea cycle. Both run between muscle and liver with no renal step; both depend on hepatic gluconeogenesis to rebuild glucose from the three-carbon unit; and both are predominantly skeletal-muscle cycles, neither being confined to heart.

quiz.q_zh: 延迟性肌肉酸痛（DOMS）的真正成因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What actually causes delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS)?

options.zh: 肌糖原耗尽导致肌纤维渗透肿胀
options.en: Glycogen depletion swells muscle fibres

options.zh: 乳酸在肌肉内堆积并持续数天不散
options.en: Lactate piles up and lingers for many days

options.zh: 肌纤维微损伤与随后的炎症反应
options.en: Microdamage to fibres and inflammation

options.zh: 丙酮酸过量转成乳酸后刺激神经
options.en: Excess pyruvate becomes an irritant lactate

quiz.explain_zh: DOMS 在运动后 24–72 小时达到高峰，与离心收缩造成的肌纤维微损伤和随后的炎症、水肿、痛觉敏化一致。乳酸在停止运动后约一小时内就被清除，根本撑不到第二天，所以乳酸堆积数天和丙酮酸转乳酸刺激神经这两种说法在时间上都站不住；肌糖原耗尽引起的是疲劳和力量下降，不是延迟性疼痛。
quiz.explain_en: DOMS peaks 24–72 hours after exercise, matching microdamage from eccentric contraction followed by inflammation, oedema and sensitisation of nociceptors. Lactate is cleared within about an hour of stopping and cannot survive into the next day, so both the lingering-lactate account and the pyruvate-to-lactate nerve-irritation account fail on timing; glycogen depletion produces fatigue and loss of force, not delayed pain.

title_zh: 氧化脱氨与游离氨的危害
title_en: Oxidative deamination and why free ammonia is dangerous

points.zh: 第二种脱氨基方式叫氧化脱氨。
points.en: The second deamination route is oxidative deamination.

points.zh: 他说这个词很字面：氧化就是加氧原子，直接把氨基氧化掉、脱下来。
points.en: He takes the name literally, saying oxidation means adding oxygen atoms, which strips the amino group off directly.

points.zh: 氧化脱氨脱下来的是游离的氨基，直接在血浆里以铵根离子的形式游离存在。
points.en: What comes off in oxidative deamination is free amino nitrogen, existing as free ammonium ion in the plasma.

points.zh: 所以氧化脱氨发生的强度远低于转氨基作用：转氨基把氨基以谷氨酸和天冬氨酸的形式储存起来，这两个对人体无害；而游离氨基危害较大。
points.en: Its intensity is therefore far below that of transamination: transamination stores the nitrogen as glutamate and aspartate, which are harmless, whereas free amino nitrogen is quite damaging.

points.zh: 他把氧化脱氨定位成一种补充性的脱氨基途径。
points.en: He positions oxidative deamination as a supplementary deamination route.

points.zh: 关于游离氨的毒性：可以把它想象成氨水，带有弱碱性。
points.en: On ammonia toxicity: think of it as ammonia water, weakly basic.

points.zh: 他说体内氨盐太多，一方面会改变 pH 和电荷平衡（尽管人体有缓冲对），另一方面会干扰正常的二氧化碳运输。
points.en: He says too much ammonium changes pH and charge balance despite the body's buffer pairs, and also interferes with normal CO2 transport.

points.zh: 他给的机制：铵根有很强倾向和二氧化碳结合。
points.en: The mechanism he gives is that ammonium has a strong tendency to bind carbon dioxide.

points.zh: 他由此推论：二氧化碳浓度太低，相对来说氧分压就升高，会导致机体获取氧的能力下降——联系到前面讲血红蛋白按氧分压运氧那一段。
points.en: From that he concludes that if CO2 falls, oxygen partial pressure relatively rises and the body's ability to take up oxygen drops, linking back to the earlier haemoglobin/oxygen-tension discussion.

extra.zh: 「氧化就是加氧原子」不对。谷氨酸脱氢酶（GDH）催化的氧化脱氨走的是脱氢：谷氨酸先被 NAD(P)+ 夺走两个氢生成亚氨基酸（Schiff 碱型中间体），再水解为 α-酮戊二酸 + NH4+；产物上那个氧原子来自水，不是分子氧，全程不接触 O2。真正用 O2 的是 L-氨基酸氧化酶和 D-氨基酸氧化酶（FMN/FAD 为辅基），属于次要途径，副产 H2O2 由过氧化氢酶清除。GDH 这个酶老师全程没有点名，但它是这一步的主角，而且是唯一能同时用 NAD+ 和 NADP+ 的脱氢酶之一。
extra.en: Saying oxidation means adding oxygen atoms is wrong. Oxidative deamination by glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH) proceeds by dehydrogenation: NAD(P)+ removes two hydrogens from glutamate to give an imino acid (a Schiff-base intermediate), which is then hydrolysed to α-ketoglutarate plus NH4+; the oxygen in the product comes from water, not from molecular oxygen, and O2 is never involved. The enzymes that genuinely use O2 are L- and D-amino acid oxidases with FMN/FAD prosthetic groups, a minor route producing H2O2 that catalase removes. He never names GDH, yet it is the protagonist of this step and one of the few dehydrogenases able to use NAD+ and NADP+ alike.

extra.zh: 氨与二氧化碳那段机制要整体重讲。铵根并不「很强倾向和 CO2 结合」——血液里与 CO2 结合成氨甲酰（carbamate）的是血红蛋白 N 端的自由氨基，那是血红蛋白运 CO2 的一种方式，与游离 NH4+ 无关。高氨血症确实常伴随 CO2 下降，但机制是氨刺激呼吸中枢造成过度通气，属于呼吸性碱中毒，不是氨把 CO2「吃掉」。
extra.en: The ammonia-meets-CO2 passage needs rebuilding. Ammonium has no strong tendency to bind CO2; what forms carbamate with CO2 in blood is the free N-terminal amino group of haemoglobin, one of haemoglobin's ways of carrying CO2, and it has nothing to do with free NH4+. Hyperammonaemia is indeed often accompanied by a fall in CO2, but the mechanism is ammonia stimulating the respiratory centre into hyperventilation — a respiratory alkalosis — not ammonia consuming the CO2.

extra.zh: 「CO2 浓度低 → 氧分压升高 → 获氧能力下降」因果讲反了。正确的是波尔效应：CO2 和 H+ 降低使血红蛋白对氧的亲和力升高、氧解离曲线左移，结果是氧在组织里放不出来——下降的是卸氧能力，不是获取氧的能力，而且与氧分压升高无关（肺里本来就摄取充分）。过度通气时手脚发麻、头晕正是碱中毒 + 左移的表现。
extra.en: The chain low CO2 → higher oxygen tension → poorer oxygen uptake reverses the causality. The correct account is the Bohr effect: lower CO2 and H+ raise haemoglobin's oxygen affinity and shift the dissociation curve left, so oxygen cannot be released in the tissues. What falls is unloading capacity, not uptake capacity, and it has nothing to do with a rise in oxygen partial pressure, since uptake in the lung is already near-saturating. The tingling and dizziness of hyperventilation are exactly alkalosis plus a left shift.

extra.zh: 氨真正的毒性主要在中枢，机制值得单独记：脑内没有尿素循环，只能靠星形胶质细胞的谷氨酰胺合成酶把 NH3 固定成谷氨酰胺；谷氨酰胺在星形胶质细胞内渗透性积累导致细胞肿胀和脑水肿，同时这一步消耗 α-酮戊二酸而抑制 TCA 循环，并干扰谷氨酸能神经传递。这就是肝性脑病（扑翼样震颤、意识障碍）的机制，也是临床上用乳果糖和利福昔明降低肠源性氨的理由。
extra.en: The real toxicity of ammonia is central, and the mechanism is worth learning on its own: the brain has no urea cycle and depends on astrocytic glutamine synthetase to fix NH3 as glutamine; glutamine then accumulates osmotically inside astrocytes, swelling them into cerebral oedema, while the same step drains α-ketoglutarate and throttles the TCA cycle and disturbs glutamatergic transmission. This is the mechanism of hepatic encephalopathy with asterixis and altered consciousness, and the reason lactulose and rifaximin are given to cut gut-derived ammonia.

quiz.q_zh: 谷氨酸脱氢酶催化的氧化脱氨，产物上的氧原子来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: In oxidative deamination by glutamate dehydrogenase, where does the oxygen in the product come from?

options.zh: 来自分子氧 O2，并产生过氧化氢
options.en: From molecular O2, making hydrogen peroxide

options.zh: 来自 NAD+ 上被还原的氧原子
options.en: From the oxygen carried on NAD+ as it reduces

options.zh: 来自水分子，本质是脱氢后再水解
options.en: From water: dehydrogenation, then hydrolysis

options.zh: 来自 α-酮戊二酸自带的羰基氧
options.en: From the keto oxygen of the α-ketoglutarate

quiz.explain_zh: GDH 先由 NAD(P)+ 夺走谷氨酸的两个氢生成亚氨基酸，再由水水解成 α-酮戊二酸和 NH4+，新出现的羰基氧来自这个水分子，全程不接触分子氧。用 O2 并产生 H2O2 的是 L-／D-氨基酸氧化酶那条次要途径；NAD+ 在这里接受的是氢负离子，不提供氧原子；说氧来自 α-酮戊二酸自带的羰基是循环论证，那个羰基正是这一步才生成的。
quiz.explain_en: GDH first lets NAD(P)+ take two hydrogens from glutamate to give an imino acid, which water then hydrolyses to α-ketoglutarate and NH4+; the new carbonyl oxygen comes from that water molecule and molecular oxygen is never involved. The route that uses O2 and makes H2O2 is the minor L-/D-amino acid oxidase pathway; NAD+ here accepts a hydride and supplies no oxygen; and saying the oxygen comes from α-ketoglutarate's own carbonyl is circular, since that carbonyl is created by this very step.

quiz.q_zh: 高氨血症患者常见的血气改变及其机制是什么？
quiz.q_en: What blood-gas change is common in hyperammonaemia, and by what mechanism?

options.zh: 呼吸性酸中毒，氨抑制呼吸中枢换气不足
options.en: Respiratory acidosis, ammonia suppresses breathing

options.zh: 代谢性酸中毒，铵盐直接消耗血中碳酸氢根
options.en: Metabolic acidosis, ammonium consumes bicarbonate

options.zh: 代谢性碱中毒，铵根结合二氧化碳后排出
options.en: Metabolic alkalosis, as ammonium binds the CO2

options.zh: 呼吸性碱中毒，氨刺激呼吸中枢过度通气
options.en: Respiratory alkalosis from ammonia hyperventilation

quiz.explain_zh: 氨直接刺激脑干呼吸中枢，患者通气过度把 CO2 呼掉，形成呼吸性碱中毒，这也是急性高氨血症早期常见的血气表现。呼吸性酸中毒需要通气不足，与氨的兴奋作用方向相反；铵盐并不直接消耗碳酸氢根，代谢性酸中毒另有原因（如有机酸血症）；至于铵根结合二氧化碳被排出，这正是课上讲错的那个机制，血中与 CO2 成氨甲酰的是血红蛋白 N 端氨基，不是游离铵。
quiz.explain_en: Ammonia stimulates the brainstem respiratory centre directly, so the patient hyperventilates off CO2 and develops a respiratory alkalosis, the typical early blood gas in acute hyperammonaemia. Respiratory acidosis would require hypoventilation, the opposite of ammonia's stimulant effect; ammonium does not itself consume bicarbonate, and metabolic acidosis in these patients has other causes such as organic acidaemias; and ammonium binding and removing CO2 is precisely the mechanism given wrongly in class, since what forms carbamate with CO2 in blood is haemoglobin's N-terminal amino group.

quiz.q_zh: 氨对中枢神经系统的毒性主要通过什么机制产生？
quiz.q_en: By what mechanism does ammonia mainly damage the central nervous system?

options.zh: 铵根与血红蛋白结合使氧亲和力下降
options.en: Ammonium binds haemoglobin, lowering O2 affinity

options.zh: 氨直接溶解神经元膜上的髓鞘脂质
options.en: Ammonia dissolves myelin lipids in neurons

options.zh: 脑内尿素循环被抑制使尿素无法生成
options.en: The brain's urea cycle is blocked, so no urea

options.zh: 星形胶质细胞内谷氨酰胺渗透性积累
options.en: Glutamine accumulates osmotically in astrocytes

quiz.explain_zh: 脑没有尿素循环，只能靠星形胶质细胞的谷氨酰胺合成酶把 NH3 固定成谷氨酰胺；谷氨酰胺在细胞内渗透性积累引起星形胶质细胞肿胀和脑水肿，同时消耗 α-酮戊二酸抑制 TCA 循环，这就是肝性脑病。氨与血红蛋白结合改变氧亲和力不是氨中毒的机制，血红蛋白上做 carbamate 的是 CO2；氨也不溶解髓鞘脂质；而「脑内尿素循环被抑制」本身不成立，脑里根本就没有这条循环。
quiz.explain_en: The brain has no urea cycle and relies on astrocytic glutamine synthetase to fix NH3 as glutamine; glutamine then accumulates osmotically, swelling astrocytes into cerebral oedema while draining α-ketoglutarate and throttling the TCA cycle — this is hepatic encephalopathy. Ammonia binding haemoglobin and shifting oxygen affinity is not the mechanism, since what forms carbamate on haemoglobin is CO2; ammonia does not dissolve myelin lipids; and a blocked cerebral urea cycle is not possible, because the brain never had one.

title_zh: 联合脱氨：腺苷酸参与的循环与三种脱氨的对比
title_en: Coupled deamination: the adenylate-driven cycle and the three routes compared

points.zh: 第三种是联合脱氨，他说这个主要是在肌肉里边发生。
points.en: The third route is coupled deamination, which he says takes place mainly in muscle.

points.zh: 它发生的频率相比转氨基作用也要低很多。
points.en: Its frequency is also much lower than that of transamination.

points.zh: 他说联合脱氨比较复杂，学生只需要记住这个过程是由腺苷酸一起参与进行的。
points.en: He calls it complicated and says the student only needs to remember that adenylate takes part in it.

points.zh: 腺苷酸帮助这个过程完成脱氨，但它像催化剂一样：参与完一轮反应以后又回到腺苷酸。
points.en: Adenylate helps the deamination happen but behaves like a catalyst: after one round of reaction it returns to adenylate.

points.zh: 他把这个循环描述成「腺苷酸 → 次黄嘌呤 → 腺苷酸」。
points.en: He describes the cycle as adenylate to hypoxanthine and back to adenylate.

points.zh: 所以腺苷酸只起辅助作用，并没有真正去承载这个氨基。
points.en: So adenylate is only an accessory and never actually carries the amino group.

points.zh: 学生追问次黄嘌呤是不是跟核酸代谢有关；他确认次黄嘌呤是核酸代谢很重要的中间体，马上就要讲到，并预告核酸代谢那一章非常绕。
points.en: The student asks whether hypoxanthine belongs to nucleic acid metabolism; he confirms it is an important intermediate there, says it is coming up next, and warns that the nucleotide chapter is very convoluted.

points.zh: 他强调联合脱氨最终也是把氨以游离氨的形式脱除的。
points.en: He stresses that coupled deamination too ends by releasing the nitrogen as free ammonia.

points.zh: 总结三种方式：只有转氨基作用是以谷氨酸和天冬氨酸的形式承载氨基，氧化脱氨和联合脱氨都是游离氨基的脱除形式。
points.en: Summary of the three: only transamination keeps the nitrogen loaded on glutamate and aspartate, while oxidative and coupled deamination both release it as free ammonia.

extra.zh: 两个机制被并成了一个。教科书的「联合脱氨基作用」通常指转氨基 + 谷氨酸脱氢酶氧化脱氨的偶联：各种氨基酸先把氨基交给 α-酮戊二酸生成谷氨酸，谷氨酸再由 GDH 氧化脱氨放出 NH4+，主要在肝和肾，是体内脱氨的主力。他讲的「腺苷酸参与、以肌肉为主」的那一套是嘌呤核苷酸循环（purine nucleotide cycle），确实以骨骼肌为主——原因正是骨骼肌的 GDH 活性很低，走不了前一条路。两者不要混成一个。
extra.en: Two mechanisms have been merged into one. Textbook coupled deamination normally means transamination coupled to oxidative deamination by glutamate dehydrogenase: amino acids hand their groups to α-ketoglutarate to make glutamate, and GDH then oxidatively deaminates glutamate to release NH4+, mainly in liver and kidney, and this is the body's principal deaminating route. The adenylate-driven, muscle-based version he describes is the purine nucleotide cycle, which really is predominantly skeletal-muscle — precisely because skeletal muscle has very low GDH activity and cannot use the other route. Keep the two apart.

extra.zh: 循环里的中间物是 IMP（次黄嘌呤核苷酸／肌苷酸），不是游离碱基次黄嘌呤。三步是：AMP —(AMP 脱氨酶)→ IMP + NH3；IMP + 天冬氨酸 + GTP —(腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶)→ 腺苷酸代琥珀酸；腺苷酸代琥珀酸 —(裂解酶)→ AMP + 延胡索酸。全程碱基一直连着核糖和磷酸，从来没有变成游离碱基。游离的次黄嘌呤属于嘌呤分解代谢（次黄嘌呤 → 黄嘌呤 → 尿酸，黄嘌呤氧化酶催化），是另一条线，别混。
extra.en: The intermediate in the cycle is IMP (inosine monophosphate, inosinic acid), not the free base hypoxanthine. The three steps are: AMP → IMP + NH3 by AMP deaminase; IMP + aspartate + GTP → adenylosuccinate by adenylosuccinate synthetase; adenylosuccinate → AMP + fumarate by the lyase. Throughout, the base stays attached to ribose and phosphate and never becomes a free base. Free hypoxanthine belongs to purine catabolism (hypoxanthine → xanthine → uric acid, both steps by xanthine oxidase), a different line entirely.

extra.zh: 嘌呤核苷酸循环的净反应是「天冬氨酸 + GTP + H2O → 延胡索酸 + NH3 + GDP + Pi」：氮以游离氨放出，碳骨架以延胡索酸的形式补进 TCA 循环。这个回补（anaplerosis）作用是剧烈运动时骨骼肌补充 TCA 中间物、维持产能的重要机制，同时产生的氨也是运动时血氨升高的来源。肌腺苷酸脱氨酶缺陷（AMPD1 deficiency）是最常见的人类肌病之一，表现为运动不耐受和运动后肌痛。
extra.en: The net reaction of the purine nucleotide cycle is aspartate + GTP + H2O → fumarate + NH3 + GDP + Pi: the nitrogen leaves as free ammonia and the carbon skeleton enters the TCA cycle as fumarate. That anaplerotic top-up is an important way skeletal muscle replenishes TCA intermediates during intense exercise, and the ammonia produced is the source of the rise in blood ammonia seen with exertion. Myoadenylate deaminase deficiency (AMPD1) is among the commonest human myopathies, presenting as exercise intolerance and post-exercise myalgia.

extra.zh: 「腺苷酸像催化剂」这个比喻只在「净反应里腺苷酸不被消耗」这个意义上成立。每转一圈实实在在要付出代价：消耗一个 GTP（腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶那一步）和一分子天冬氨酸，产物端出来一分子延胡索酸。真正的催化剂不消耗任何底物，所以更准确的说法是腺苷酸在这里是循环载体（像 TCA 里的草酰乙酸），不是催化剂。
extra.en: Calling adenylate a catalyst holds only in the sense that it is not consumed in the net reaction. Each turn has a real cost: one GTP at the adenylosuccinate synthetase step and one molecule of aspartate go in, and one fumarate comes out. A genuine catalyst consumes no substrate at all, so the accurate description is that adenylate is a cycling carrier here — like oxaloacetate in the TCA cycle — not a catalyst.

quiz.q_zh: 骨骼肌嘌呤核苷酸循环中，AMP 脱氨后的直接产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the skeletal-muscle purine nucleotide cycle, what does AMP deamination give directly?

options.zh: 腺苷酸代琥珀酸，随后放出延胡索酸
options.en: Adenylosuccinate, which releases fumarate

options.zh: 次黄嘌呤，即嘌呤分解的中间碱基
options.en: Hypoxanthine, a free base in catabolism

options.zh: 肌苷，也就是次黄嘌呤的核苷形式
options.en: Inosine, the nucleoside of hypoxanthine

options.zh: IMP，即次黄嘌呤核苷酸（肌苷酸）
options.en: IMP, inosine monophosphate (inosinic acid)

quiz.explain_zh: AMP 脱氨酶把 AMP 的 6 位氨基水解脱去，放出 NH3，产物仍带着核糖和磷酸，就是 IMP。次黄嘌呤是游离碱基，属于嘌呤分解代谢（次黄嘌呤 → 黄嘌呤 → 尿酸）那条线，不是这里的产物；肌苷是核苷，要再脱掉磷酸才出现，属于降解方向；腺苷酸代琥珀酸是下一步 IMP 与天冬氨酸在 GTP 供能下缩合的产物，顺序在后面。
quiz.explain_en: AMP deaminase hydrolyses the 6-amino group off AMP, releasing NH3 and leaving the ribose and phosphate in place, which is IMP. Hypoxanthine is a free base belonging to purine catabolism, hypoxanthine to xanthine to uric acid, not a product here; inosine is a nucleoside and appears only after a phosphate is removed, on the degradative branch; adenylosuccinate is formed one step later when IMP condenses with aspartate using GTP.

quiz.q_zh: 三种脱氨方式中，哪一种不直接放出游离氨？
quiz.q_en: Which of the three deamination routes does not release free ammonia directly?

options.zh: 转氨基作用，氨基被交给 α-酮酸
options.en: Transamination, passing it to an α-keto acid

options.zh: 嘌呤核苷酸循环，AMP 脱氨那一步
options.en: The purine nucleotide cycle, at the AMP step

options.zh: 联合脱氨，转氨与氧化脱氨的偶联
options.en: Coupled deamination, transamination plus GDH

options.zh: 氧化脱氨，谷氨酸脱氢酶催化的那种
options.en: Oxidative deamination, by way of GDH catalysis

quiz.explain_zh: 转氨基作用只是把氨基在氨基酸和 α-酮酸之间对调，氮全程挂在 PLP 或底物上，产物是谷氨酸或天冬氨酸，不出现游离氨。谷氨酸脱氢酶催化的氧化脱氨直接放出 NH4+；嘌呤核苷酸循环里 AMP 脱氨酶那一步放出 NH3；联合脱氨是把转氨和谷氨酸脱氢酶两步串起来，最终仍以游离氨结束。
quiz.explain_en: Transamination merely swaps the amino group between an amino acid and a keto acid, keeping the nitrogen on PLP or on a substrate throughout and yielding glutamate or aspartate, with no free ammonia. Oxidative deamination by glutamate dehydrogenase releases NH4+ directly; the AMP deaminase step of the purine nucleotide cycle releases NH3; and coupled deamination strings transamination onto glutamate dehydrogenase, so it too ends in free ammonia.

title_zh: 脱羧作用、氨中毒的成因与尿素循环登场
title_en: Decarboxylation, what causes ammonia toxicity, and the urea cycle introduced

points.zh: 他还提了一种脱羧作用，但认为这个过程很少见。
points.en: He also mentions decarboxylation but regards the process as rare.

points.zh: 脱羧是在酶的催化下、以 VB6 为辅因子，直接把氨基酸上的羧基脱掉，以二氧化碳的形式排出。
points.en: Decarboxylation removes the carboxyl group from an amino acid enzymatically with vitamin B6 as cofactor, releasing it as CO2.

points.zh: 他说课本没怎么讲脱羧以后剩下的那部分，自己推测那个氨可能再进入转氨基或联合脱氨被脱掉。
points.en: He notes the textbook says little about what remains and speculates that the ammonia may re-enter transamination or coupled deamination to be removed.

points.zh: 他的理由：羧基对人体没那么有害，因为可以变成二氧化碳直接排出体外；而氨的危害大得多。
points.en: His reasoning is that the carboxyl group is less harmful since it leaves as CO2, while ammonia is far more dangerous.

points.zh: 所以他判断脱羧不是很重要，重点还是看游离氨浓度太高导致的氨中毒。
points.en: He therefore judges decarboxylation unimportant and returns to ammonia toxicity from too high a free ammonia concentration.

points.zh: 关于氨中毒的主因，他的判断是：人代谢氨的能力不足，而不是氨的产生量大——因为产生速率一般比较恒定。
points.en: On the cause of ammonia toxicity he judges that the failure is in the body's capacity to metabolise ammonia, not in production, since the production rate is fairly constant.

points.zh: 除非人快死了、各种转氨酶数值直接飙到几万，游离氨才会大大增加。
points.en: Only when someone is near death and transaminase values shoot into the tens of thousands does free ammonia rise sharply.

points.zh: 他说正常人的氨中毒很大程度上是因为肾脏对游离氨的代谢不足，导致氨积累。
points.en: He says that in an otherwise normal person, ammonia toxicity is largely due to the kidney's insufficient metabolism of free ammonia, causing it to accumulate.

points.zh: 接着开始讲尿素循环并挂出英文图；他说尿素循环比脂肪酸的合成和分解稍难、也稍重要，重要性排在 EMP 途径和 TCA 循环之后的第三位。
points.en: He then brings up an English diagram of the urea cycle, calling it slightly harder and slightly more important than fatty acid synthesis and breakdown, and third in importance after the EMP pathway and the TCA cycle.

extra.zh: 这是本讲最要紧的一处：氨的解毒器官是肝，不是肾。他在这一段两次把它归给肾脏，而且这个错误在后面继续扩大（紧接着说尿素循环主要发生在肾脏），本段结束前没有更正。正确的是：游离氨的解毒靠肝细胞的尿素循环（CPS-1、OTC 在线粒体基质，ASS、ASL、精氨酸酶在胞质），所以高氨血症的典型病因是肝功能衰竭、门体分流、以及尿素循环酶的遗传缺陷（CPS-1、OTC 缺陷等），临床后果是肝性脑病。肾的角色是把肝造好的尿素排出去；酸中毒时肾用谷氨酰胺酶产氨、以 NH4+ 形式随尿排酸，那是产氨排酸，不是解氨毒。
extra.en: This is the most consequential error in the lecture: ammonia is detoxified by the liver, not the kidney. He assigns it to the kidney twice here, and the mistake then grows — he goes straight on to place the urea cycle in the kidney — and is never corrected before the end of this stretch. Correctly: free ammonia is disposed of by the hepatocyte urea cycle (CPS-1 and OTC in the mitochondrial matrix, ASS, ASL and arginase in the cytosol), so hyperammonaemia is typically caused by liver failure, portosystemic shunting, or inherited urea cycle enzyme defects such as CPS-1 and OTC deficiency, and its clinical consequence is hepatic encephalopathy. The kidney's role is to excrete the urea the liver has already made; during acidosis it uses glutaminase to generate ammonia and excrete acid as NH4+, which is producing ammonia to dump acid, not detoxifying it.

extra.zh: 「脱羧很少见、不重要」要改。氨基酸脱羧在物质量上确实不是主流代谢途径，但在生理上极其重要，产物全是信号分子：组氨酸 → 组胺（过敏、胃酸分泌）、谷氨酸 → GABA（主要抑制性递质）、色氨酸 → 5-羟色胺（经 5-羟色氨酸）、酪氨酸 → 多巴胺／儿茶酚胺（经多巴）、丝氨酸 → 乙醇胺（磷脂原料）。他说以 VB6 为辅因子这一点是对的，这些脱羧酶都依赖 PLP，也正因如此 B6 缺乏会引起惊厥（GABA 生成不足）。
extra.en: Calling decarboxylation rare and unimportant needs correcting. It is indeed not a bulk metabolic route, but physiologically it is essential and its products are all signalling molecules: histidine to histamine (allergy, gastric acid), glutamate to GABA (the main inhibitory transmitter), tryptophan to serotonin via 5-hydroxytryptophan, tyrosine to dopamine and the catecholamines via DOPA, serine to ethanolamine for phospholipids. His point about vitamin B6 is right — these decarboxylases are all PLP-dependent — and that is exactly why B6 deficiency causes seizures, through insufficient GABA.

extra.zh: 脱羧以后剩下的不是「氨」，而是胺（amine）这一整类分子——组胺、多巴胺、GABA、5-羟色胺都是。它们不会简单地再回去转氨，而是由单胺氧化酶 MAO、二胺氧化酶等专门降解。这也是为什么服用 MAO 抑制剂的人吃陈年奶酪（富含酪胺）会出现高血压危象：酪胺不能被代谢，把储存的去甲肾上腺素挤出来。记住「脱氨留下酮酸，脱羧留下胺」这一对。
extra.en: What is left after decarboxylation is not ammonia but an amine — histamine, dopamine, GABA and serotonin all belong to that class. They are not simply fed back into transamination; they are degraded by dedicated enzymes such as monoamine oxidase and diamine oxidase. This is why someone on an MAO inhibitor who eats aged cheese, rich in tyramine, can have a hypertensive crisis: the tyramine is not metabolised and displaces stored noradrenaline. The pair worth memorising is deamination leaves a keto acid, decarboxylation leaves an amine.

extra.zh: 他「产氨速率恒定、清除能力才是瓶颈」这个判断方向是对的，值得补上具体来源：门静脉氨的两大来源是肠道细菌脲酶分解尿素和肠上皮的谷氨酰胺代谢。正常肝几乎一次通过就把门静脉血里的氨清干净（first-pass extraction 极高），所以外周静脉血氨浓度很低。肝硬化时侧支循环让门静脉血绕过肝细胞，这个门体分流就是高氨血症最直接的机制——也说明问题出在肝的处理量而不是产量。
extra.en: His judgement that production is steady and clearance is the bottleneck is directionally right and deserves specifics: the two main sources of portal ammonia are bacterial urease splitting urea in the gut and glutamine metabolism in the intestinal epithelium. A normal liver clears portal ammonia almost completely on a single pass — first-pass extraction is very high — which is why peripheral venous ammonia is low. In cirrhosis, collateral vessels let portal blood bypass the hepatocytes, and this portosystemic shunt is the most direct mechanism of hyperammonaemia, confirming that the problem lies in hepatic throughput rather than in production.

quiz.q_zh: 人体内游离氨的解毒主要由哪个器官承担？
quiz.q_en: Which organ is mainly responsible for detoxifying free ammonia?

options.zh: 肝脏，靠肝细胞里完整的尿素循环
options.en: Liver, running a complete urea cycle there

options.zh: 肌肉，靠谷氨酰胺合成酶把氨固定
options.en: Muscle, via glutamine synthetase fixing it

options.zh: 肠道，靠细菌脲酶把氨转成尿素
options.en: Gut, where bacterial urease builds urea

options.zh: 肾脏，靠谷氨酰胺酶把氨随尿排掉
options.en: Kidney, using glutaminase to void ammonia

quiz.explain_zh: 只有肝细胞同时表达 CPS-1、OTC、ASS、ASL 和精氨酸酶五个酶，能把游离氨变成尿素，所以高氨血症的病因是肝衰竭、门体分流或尿素循环酶缺陷，后果是肝性脑病。肾里的谷氨酰胺酶做的是产氨排酸，把 NH4+ 排进尿里带走质子，方向上是制造氨而不是解毒；肠道细菌脲酶恰恰相反，是把尿素分解成氨、构成门静脉氨的来源；肌肉的谷氨酰胺合成酶只是把氨暂时固定成谷氨酰胺运走，最终还得交给肝。
quiz.explain_en: Only hepatocytes express all five enzymes — CPS-1, OTC, ASS, ASL and arginase — and can convert free ammonia into urea, which is why hyperammonaemia arises from liver failure, portosystemic shunting or urea cycle enzyme defects and ends in hepatic encephalopathy. Renal glutaminase generates ammonia to excrete acid, dumping NH4+ into urine with a proton, so it makes ammonia rather than detoxifying it; gut bacterial urease does the reverse of detoxification, splitting urea into ammonia and supplying portal ammonia; and muscle glutamine synthetase only parks ammonia as glutamine for transport, still leaving the liver to finish the job.

quiz.q_zh: 下面哪一组是氨基酸脱羧作用的产物？
quiz.q_en: Which pair are products of amino acid decarboxylation?

options.zh: 丝氨酸生成甘氨酸，苏氨酸生成丙酮酸
options.en: Serine to glycine, threonine to pyruvate

options.zh: 谷氨酸生成 GABA，组氨酸生成组胺
options.en: Glutamate to GABA, histidine to histamine

options.zh: 谷氨酸生成谷酰胺，组氨酸生成尿刊酸
options.en: Glutamate to glutamine, histidine to urocanate

options.zh: 色氨酸生成犬尿氨酸，酪氨酸生成尿黑酸
options.en: Tryptophan to kynurenine, tyrosine to fumarate

quiz.explain_zh: 谷氨酸脱羧酶（GAD）去掉羧基生成 GABA，组氨酸脱羧酶生成组胺，两者都以 PLP 为辅酶，是脱羧的经典产物。谷氨酸变谷氨酰胺是谷氨酰胺合成酶的酰胺化、组氨酸变尿刊酸是组氨酸酶的脱氨，都不脱羧；色氨酸经犬尿氨酸、酪氨酸经尿黑酸走的是分解代谢的开环氧化路线；丝氨酸变甘氨酸是一碳单位转移，苏氨酸变丙酮酸是脱水脱氨，同样都不是脱羧。
quiz.explain_en: Glutamate decarboxylase (GAD) removes the carboxyl group to give GABA and histidine decarboxylase gives histamine, both PLP-dependent and the classic decarboxylation products. Glutamate to glutamine is an amidation by glutamine synthetase and histidine to urocanate is a deamination by histidase, neither losing CO2; tryptophan via kynurenine and tyrosine via homogentisate are ring-opening oxidative catabolic routes; serine to glycine is a one-carbon transfer and threonine to pyruvate is dehydration-deamination, again not decarboxylations.

quiz.q_zh: 关于氨中毒的成因，哪种说法最成立？
quiz.q_en: Which account of the cause of ammonia toxicity holds up best?

options.zh: 主要是肝清除氨的能力不足或被绕过
options.en: Hepatic clearance fails or blood bypasses it

options.zh: 主要是肠道细菌产氨量长期偏高
options.en: Gut bacteria chronically make too much

options.zh: 主要是氨的产生速率突然大幅上升
options.en: Ammonia production suddenly rises sharply

options.zh: 主要是肾脏排氨的浓缩能力不足
options.en: The kidney cannot concentrate ammonia enough

quiz.explain_zh: 老师说「问题在清除能力而不在产生速率」这个方向是对的，但器官说成了肾。正常肝几乎一次通过就把门静脉氨清干净，肝硬化的门体分流让血绕过肝细胞，或尿素循环酶（OTC 等）遗传缺陷使清除失效，才出现高氨血症。氨的产生速率相对恒定，不是变量；肾排的是肝造好的尿素，它自己反而在酸中毒时产氨；肠菌脲酶确实持续产氨，但只要肝功能正常，这些氨在门静脉里就被清掉了。
quiz.explain_en: His direction — the problem is clearance, not production — is right, but he names the wrong organ. A normal liver strips portal ammonia almost completely on one pass; hyperammonaemia appears when cirrhotic portosystemic shunting lets blood bypass hepatocytes or when an inherited urea cycle enzyme defect such as OTC deficiency disables clearance. Production is relatively constant and is not the variable; the kidney excretes urea the liver has already made and itself generates ammonia during acidosis; and gut bacterial urease does produce ammonia continuously, but with a working liver that ammonia is removed within the portal circulation.

title_zh: 尿素循环的部位与氨向肝的两条转运路线
title_en: Where the urea cycle runs, and the two routes that deliver ammonia to it

points.zh: 他先说尿素循环还有一个名字叫 Krebs 循环，并调侃老外喜欢用人名命名。
points.en: He notes the urea cycle also goes by the name Krebs cycle, joking about the Western habit of naming things after people.

points.zh: 他说尿素循环主要发生的部位是肾脏，因为尿素的合成主要在肾脏。
points.en: He says the urea cycle runs mainly in the kidney, because urea synthesis is mainly renal.

points.zh: 他补充说肌肉细胞少一点，但上皮细胞等大部分细胞也都能少量发生尿素循环。
points.en: He adds that muscle cells do less of it but that most cells, epithelial cells for instance, can run a little urea cycle.

points.zh: 他给的证据：人出汗某种程度上也是尿素循环的一种体现。
points.en: His evidence is that sweating is in some sense an expression of the urea cycle.

points.zh: 然后讲游离氨怎么富集过去。大脑里神经细胞不断衰老死亡，必然产生游离氨，而机体必须保障脑内游离氨不过多。
points.en: He then explains how free ammonia is concentrated there. Neurons in the brain are constantly ageing and dying, which necessarily produces free ammonia, and the body must keep cerebral ammonia low.

points.zh: 他说脑内的游离氨和谷氨酸发生转氨基作用生成谷氨酰胺。
points.en: He says the free ammonia in the brain undergoes transamination with glutamate to form glutamine.

points.zh: 谷氨酰胺是中性氨基酸、不带任何电荷，所以能很轻松地透过血脑屏障；到肝脏又分解成谷氨酸和游离氨，游离氨进入尿素循环。
points.en: Glutamine is a neutral amino acid with no charge, so it crosses the blood–brain barrier easily; in the liver it is split back into glutamate and free ammonia, and that ammonia enters the urea cycle.

points.zh: 肌肉那条路：肌肉里 EMP 途径多、附近供能细胞频繁进行 TCA 循环，所以由 α-酮戊二酸接受氨基变成谷氨酸；谷氨酸再通过丙氨酸循环把氨带走——谷氨酸变回 α-酮戊二酸并生成丙氨酸，丙氨酸在肝里释放出游离氨。
points.en: The muscle route: muscle runs mostly EMP and nearby energy-supplying cells run the TCA cycle frequently, so α-ketoglutarate accepts the amino group to become glutamate; glutamate then hands the nitrogen to the alanine cycle, reverting to α-ketoglutarate while making alanine, and alanine releases free ammonia in the liver.

points.zh: 他的总结：两条路径，脑内的运输媒介是谷氨酰胺，身体外周运输的是谷氨酸；他说「通过谷氨酸和谷氨酰胺把尿素运输到肝脏」，随即自己改口为「运输到血液里边让它变成游离的氨」，然后游离氨进入尿素循环。
points.en: His summary: two routes, glutamine as the carrier in the brain and glutamate in the periphery. He says glutamate and glutamine transport urea to the liver, then immediately corrects himself to transport it into the blood where it becomes free ammonia, which then enters the urea cycle.

extra.zh: 完整的尿素循环只存在于肝细胞，这是本讲最严重的错误。他在这一段反复说肾脏（「尿素的合成主要在肾脏」「主要在肾脏发生」「进入到肾脏以后就会进入尿素循环」），而同一段里他自己又两次说「透过血脑屏障以后在肝脏里边分解」「运输到肝脏」，前后自相矛盾，且始终没有明确改口。正确的是：CPS-1、OTC、ASS、ASL、精氨酸酶五个酶同时表达只见于门静脉周围的肝细胞（periportal hepatocyte）；肾确实表达 ASS/ASL 用来合成精氨酸（所谓 intestinal–renal axis），但缺 CPS-1 和 OTC，跑不完整个循环。尿素在肝合成，随血流到肾只是被排泄。这一点必须改过来，否则「高氨血症是肝病而不是肾病的表现」这个结论就反了。
extra.en: The complete urea cycle exists only in hepatocytes, and this is the lecture's most serious error. Here he repeatedly says kidney — urea synthesis is mainly renal, it happens mainly in the kidney, ammonia enters the urea cycle once it reaches the kidney — while in the same stretch twice saying the liver, that glutamine is broken down in the liver after crossing the blood–brain barrier and that the carriers deliver to the liver. He contradicts himself and never explicitly retracts. Correctly: CPS-1, OTC, ASS, ASL and arginase are co-expressed only in periportal hepatocytes; the kidney does express ASS and ASL to make arginine, the intestinal–renal axis, but lacks CPS-1 and OTC and cannot complete the cycle. Urea is made in the liver and merely excreted by the kidney. Without this correction the whole clinical conclusion — that hyperammonaemia signals liver disease, not kidney disease — comes out backwards.

extra.zh: 「人出汗是尿素循环的体现，所以大部分细胞都能少量跑尿素循环」这条证据不成立。汗液里确实含尿素（约占汗中固形物的一部分），但那是肝脏合成好、经血液到达汗腺后被动排出的，皮肤细胞并不自己造尿素。肝外组织缺 CPS-1 和 OTC，无法从游离氨造出氨甲酰磷酸，也就无法启动这条循环。同理，尿里的尿素也是排泄而非合成。
extra.en: The claim that sweating demonstrates the urea cycle, and hence that most cells run a little of it, does not hold. Sweat does contain urea, but that urea was made in the liver, carried in blood to the sweat glands and passively excreted; skin cells do not synthesise it. Extrahepatic tissues lack CPS-1 and OTC, cannot make carbamoyl phosphate from free ammonia and therefore cannot start the cycle at all. By the same logic, urea in urine is excreted, not synthesised there.

extra.zh: 脑内谷氨酰胺的生成不是转氨基作用。谷氨酸 + NH4+ + ATP → 谷氨酰胺 + ADP + Pi 由谷氨酰胺合成酶（glutamine synthetase）催化，是酰胺化：把游离铵固定到谷氨酸的 γ-羧基上，消耗一个 ATP。转氨基是氨基在氨基酸和 α-酮酸之间对调，既不生成酰胺也不耗 ATP，而且转氨根本无法处理游离氨。这一步在星形胶质细胞里进行，是脑内解氨最关键的一环；机制说错就解释不了为什么高氨血症时脑内谷氨酰胺升高、星形胶质细胞渗透性肿胀。
extra.en: Making glutamine in the brain is not transamination. Glutamate + NH4+ + ATP → glutamine + ADP + Pi is catalysed by glutamine synthetase and is an amidation: free ammonium is fixed onto glutamate's γ-carboxyl at the cost of one ATP. Transamination swaps an amino group between an amino acid and a keto acid, produces no amide, spends no ATP, and cannot handle free ammonia at all. This step runs in astrocytes and is the brain's key ammonia-disposal reaction; getting the mechanism wrong makes it impossible to explain why cerebral glutamine rises and astrocytes swell osmotically in hyperammonaemia.

extra.zh: 两个小陷阱。一是名字：尿素循环严格说是 Krebs–Henseleit 循环（1932，Krebs 与 Henseleit 共同发现），单说「Krebs 循环」在文献和考试里默认指三羧酸循环，而他前一分钟刚拿 TCA 循环排重要性，极易混。二是转运：谷氨酰胺跨血脑屏障靠的是 L 型氨基酸转运体（LAT1）等载体蛋白，不是因为「不带电荷所以自由扩散」；同理谷氨酸进线粒体基质也靠载体，不是自由透膜。
extra.en: Two small traps. First the name: the urea cycle is strictly the Krebs–Henseleit cycle, described by Krebs and Henseleit in 1932, whereas Krebs cycle alone means the tricarboxylic acid cycle in the literature and in exams — and he had just ranked the TCA cycle a minute earlier, so the two are easy to confuse. Second, transport: glutamine crosses the blood–brain barrier on carrier proteins such as the L-type amino acid transporter LAT1, not by free diffusion because it is uncharged; likewise glutamate enters the mitochondrial matrix on carriers rather than passing freely through the membrane.

quiz.q_zh: 完整的尿素循环在人体内存在于哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where in the human body does the complete urea cycle exist?

options.zh: 肾小管上皮细胞，与尿液的浓缩偶联
options.en: Renal tubular cells, coupled to urine concentration

options.zh: 肝细胞，分线粒体基质与胞质两室
options.en: Hepatocytes, split between matrix and cytosol

options.zh: 汗腺细胞，因此汗液里能测到尿素
options.en: Sweat gland cells, which is why sweat has urea

options.zh: 小肠上皮细胞，与精氨酸合成偶联
options.en: Intestinal epithelium, tied to arginine synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: 五个酶同时表达只见于门静脉周围肝细胞：CPS-1 和 OTC 在线粒体基质，ASS、ASL、精氨酸酶在胞质，两室之间靠鸟氨酸／瓜氨酸转运体连接。肾小管虽然表达 ASS/ASL 用于合成精氨酸，但缺 CPS-1 和 OTC，跑不完循环，它做的是排泄尿素；汗腺里的尿素是肝造好后经血液送来被动排出的，不是本地合成；小肠上皮参与的是瓜氨酸的生成（intestinal–renal axis），同样不是完整循环。
quiz.explain_en: All five enzymes are co-expressed only in periportal hepatocytes: CPS-1 and OTC in the mitochondrial matrix, ASS, ASL and arginase in the cytosol, the two compartments linked by the ornithine/citrulline transporter. Renal tubule cells do express ASS and ASL for arginine synthesis but lack CPS-1 and OTC and cannot complete the cycle; their job is to excrete urea. Urea in sweat was made in the liver and delivered by blood, not synthesised locally, and the intestinal epithelium contributes citrulline in the intestinal–renal axis, again not the whole cycle.

quiz.q_zh: 脑内把游离氨固定下来的那一步反应是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which reaction fixes free ammonia in the brain?

options.zh: 谷氨酸脱氢酶把氨加回 α-酮戊二酸
options.en: Glutamate dehydrogenase running in reverse

options.zh: 天冬氨酸接受游离氨生成天冬酰胺
options.en: Aspartate takes up ammonia to give asparagine

options.zh: 谷氨酸与氨缩合成谷氨酰胺，耗 ATP
options.en: Glutamate plus ammonia to glutamine, using ATP

options.zh: α-酮戊二酸与谷氨酸之间的转氨反应
options.en: Transamination between glutamate and α-KG

quiz.explain_zh: 星形胶质细胞的谷氨酰胺合成酶把 NH4+ 固定到谷氨酸的 γ-羧基上生成谷氨酰胺，消耗一个 ATP（产 ADP + Pi），这是脑内唯一有效的解氨途径，也解释了高氨血症时脑内谷氨酰胺升高、细胞渗透性肿胀。转氨反应只在氨基酸和 α-酮酸之间对调氨基，根本处理不了游离氨；谷氨酸脱氢酶在脑内主要往放氨的方向跑，逆向固氨需要很高的氨浓度，不是主力；天冬酰胺合成酶用的氮供体是谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮，不是直接抓游离氨。
quiz.explain_en: Astrocytic glutamine synthetase fixes NH4+ onto the γ-carboxyl of glutamate to make glutamine at the cost of one ATP, yielding ADP and Pi; this is the brain's only effective ammonia-disposal route and explains the rise in cerebral glutamine and the osmotic swelling seen in hyperammonaemia. Transamination only swaps amino groups between an amino acid and a keto acid and cannot touch free ammonia; glutamate dehydrogenase in brain runs predominantly toward releasing ammonia, and reversing it would need very high ammonia concentrations; asparagine synthetase takes its nitrogen from glutamine's amide rather than capturing free ammonia.

quiz.q_zh: 骨骼肌把氨基氮送往肝脏，主要用哪一种载体分子？
quiz.q_en: Which carrier molecule mainly ships amino nitrogen from skeletal muscle to the liver?

options.zh: 谷氨酰胺，靠中性不带电穿过血脑屏障
options.en: Glutamine, crossing the blood-brain barrier

options.zh: 天冬酰胺，由天冬氨酸酰胺化生成
options.en: Asparagine, from amidation of aspartate

options.zh: 尿素，肌肉合成后经血液运到肝脏
options.en: Urea, made in muscle and shipped to liver

options.zh: 丙氨酸，由丙酮酸经转氨反应生成
options.en: Alanine, from pyruvate by transamination

quiz.explain_zh: 肌肉走糖酵解产生大量丙酮酸，丙酮酸转氨接下氨基变成丙氨酸，随血液到肝，肝再把它转氨回丙酮酸做糖异生、把氮送进尿素循环，这就是葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环。谷氨酰胺确实是重要的氨载体，但它是脑和全身的通用形式，而穿血脑屏障那条描述属于脑内路线，不是肌肉→肝的主线；天冬酰胺不是血中运氮的主要形式；尿素只在肝细胞合成，肌肉缺 CPS-1 和 OTC 造不出来。
quiz.explain_en: Glycolytic muscle generates abundant pyruvate, which is transaminated to alanine and travels in blood to the liver, where it is transaminated back to pyruvate for gluconeogenesis while the nitrogen enters the urea cycle — this is the glucose–alanine cycle. Glutamine is certainly an important ammonia carrier, but it is the general-purpose form and the blood–brain-barrier description belongs to the cerebral route, not the muscle-to-liver line; asparagine is not a major nitrogen shuttle in blood; and urea is made only in hepatocytes, since muscle lacks CPS-1 and OTC.

title_zh: 谷氨酸进入线粒体、交出游离氨，与尿素循环第一步 CPS-1
title_en: Glutamate enters the mitochondrion, releases free ammonia, and CPS-1 opens the urea cycle

points.zh: 他以 α-酮戊二酸为例讲转氨基作用：氨基酸把氨基交给 α-酮酸生成谷氨酸，并强调受体不一定是 α-酮戊二酸，也可以是别的 α-酮酸。
points.en: He uses alpha-ketoglutarate as the example acceptor in transamination: an amino acid hands its amino group to an alpha-keto acid to make glutamate, and he notes the acceptor need not be alpha-ketoglutarate.

points.zh: 他说这一段生成谷氨酸的转氨基作用「始终」发生在细胞质里，要求学生把反应发生的区室记清楚。
points.en: He says the transamination that makes glutamate always happens in the cytosol, and asks students to keep the compartments straight.

points.zh: 他说只有谷氨酸能透过线粒体的双层膜，所以氮必须先装到谷氨酸上才能被送进基质。
points.en: He says only glutamate can cross the mitochondrial double membrane, so nitrogen must be loaded onto glutamate before it can enter the matrix.

points.zh: 谷氨酸进入线粒体基质后重新变回 α-酮戊二酸，同时把氮以游离氨的形式释放出来。
points.en: Once inside the matrix, glutamate is converted back to alpha-ketoglutarate and releases its nitrogen as free ammonia.

points.zh: 他指出基质是 TCA 循环的主要场所，所以放出来的 α-酮戊二酸可以就地进入 TCA 循环，碳骨架不浪费。
points.en: He points out that the matrix is where the TCA cycle runs, so the alpha-ketoglutarate released here feeds straight into the TCA cycle and the carbon skeleton is not wasted.

points.zh: 释放出来的游离氨基就是尿素循环真正的起点，对应他图上左上角的位置。
points.en: The free ammonia set loose here is the true entry point of the urea cycle, matching the top-left corner of his diagram.

points.zh: 他列出第一步的四个组分：游离氨基、三羧酸循环产生的二氧化碳、两分子 ATP，再加一分子磷酸。
points.en: He lists four components for the first step: free ammonia, carbon dioxide from the TCA cycle, two ATP, and one free phosphate.

points.zh: 催化这一步的酶叫 carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1（氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 I，CPS-1），产物是氨甲酰磷酸，他建议直接记英文名。
points.en: The enzyme is carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS-1) and the product is carbamoyl phosphate; he advises memorising the English name.

points.zh: 他特别提醒 CPS 这个名字在后面核苷酸代谢一章还会再出现（CPS-2），所以 CPS-1 的编号要记住。
points.en: He flags that the CPS name will come back in the nucleotide metabolism chapter (CPS-2), so the number in CPS-1 matters.

extra.zh: 他把整条氨的去路放在肾脏里讲（前一句还说血里的游离氨「进入到肾脏以后就会进入到尿素循环」），并在本讲多次重复，全程没有改口。完整的尿素循环只在肝细胞里跑：CPS-1 和 OTC 在肝细胞线粒体基质，ASS、ASL、精氨酸酶在胞质，五个酶同时表达的只有肝（尤其门静脉周围的 periportal hepatocyte）。肾确实表达 ASS/ASL，用来合成精氨酸（intestinal-renal axis），但缺 CPS-1 和 OTC，跑不完整个循环。肾对尿素做的是排泄，不是合成。这个器官弄反了，临床结论就整个反了：解氨能力垮掉的是肝（肝硬化、门体分流、尿素循环酶遗传缺陷），表现为高氨血症和肝性脑病；肾衰竭表现的是尿毒症，是尿素等含氮废物排不出去，是完全不同的一幅图。
extra.en: He locates the whole ammonia-disposal story in the kidney, saying just before this stretch that free ammonia in blood enters the urea cycle after reaching the kidney, and he repeats it without ever correcting himself. The complete urea cycle runs only in hepatocytes: CPS-1 and OTC in the hepatocyte mitochondrial matrix, argininosuccinate synthetase, argininosuccinate lyase and arginase in the cytosol; only liver (especially periportal hepatocytes) expresses all five. The kidney does express ASS and ASL for arginine synthesis (the intestinal-renal axis) but lacks CPS-1 and OTC and cannot complete the cycle. The kidney excretes urea; it does not make it. Getting the organ wrong inverts the clinical conclusion: loss of ammonia detoxification is a liver problem (cirrhosis, portosystemic shunt, inherited urea cycle enzyme defects) presenting as hyperammonemia and hepatic encephalopathy, whereas kidney failure presents as uraemia, the retention of urea and other nitrogenous waste, which is a different picture entirely.

extra.zh: 他把「一分子磷酸」列成 CPS-1 的第四种底物，这一列法在 22:10、26:28、32:53、35:03 反复出现。CPS-1 真正的底物只有三样：NH4+、HCO3-（不是游离 CO2）和两分子 ATP，另外必须有变构激活剂 N-乙酰谷氨酸 NAG 才有活性。氨甲酰磷酸上的那个磷酸基由 ATP 提供：先由一分子 ATP 把 HCO3- 磷酸化成碳酸磷酸酐，氨进攻生成氨甲酸，再由另一分子 ATP 把氨甲酸磷酸化。他在 23:47 说「从用这个 ATP 上了一分子磷酸」，其实是对的，只是列反应式时始终多列了一项。
extra.en: He lists free phosphate as a fourth substrate of CPS-1, repeating this at 22:10, 26:28, 32:53 and 35:03. CPS-1 has three substrates only: NH4+, HCO3- (not free CO2) and two ATP, plus the obligatory allosteric activator N-acetylglutamate (NAG). The phosphate in carbamoyl phosphate comes from the second ATP: the first ATP phosphorylates HCO3- to carboxyphosphate, ammonia attacks to give carbamate, and the second ATP phosphorylates that carbamate. At 23:47 he actually says the phosphate came from the ATP, which is correct; only his written list of reactants carries the extra item.

extra.zh: 「转氨基作用始终在细胞质」和「只有谷氨酸能透过双层膜」两句都说过头了。ALT 和 AST 都有胞质型和线粒体型同工酶（GPT1/GPT2、GOT1/GOT2），线粒体型 AST 正是苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭的组成部分，也是尿素循环第三步的氮送进来的方式。谷氨酸进基质也不是自由透膜，靠的是载体蛋白（谷氨酸/H+ 同向转运体 GC1、GC2，以及谷氨酸-天冬氨酸转运体 citrin/aralar）；游离 NH3 本身也能扩散进基质。他这么简化在讲图时可以接受，但「始终」「只有」不成立。
extra.en: Both claims are overstated. ALT and AST each exist as cytosolic and mitochondrial isoenzymes (GPT1/GPT2, GOT1/GOT2), and mitochondrial AST is part of the malate-aspartate shuttle, which is exactly how nitrogen reaches step three of the urea cycle. Glutamate does not diffuse across the inner membrane either; it is carried by transporters (the glutamate/H+ carriers GC1 and GC2 and the glutamate-aspartate exchanger citrin/aralar), and free NH3 can itself diffuse into the matrix. The simplification is tolerable while reading a diagram, but always and only are both too strong.

extra.zh: 紧接在这一段之前，他把脑内谷氨酰胺的生成叫成「转氨基作用」。那一步不是转氨：谷氨酰胺合成酶 glutamine synthetase 把游离 NH4+ 直接酰胺化到谷氨酸的 γ-羧基上，消耗一分子 ATP 生成 ADP + Pi，没有任何氨基在氨基酸和 α-酮酸之间对调，也不生成 α-酮酸。转氨（PLP 为辅酶）不耗 ATP、不产酰胺、不固定游离氨。这一步机制说错会解释不了为什么高氨血症时脑内谷氨酰胺升高、星形胶质细胞渗透性肿胀，也就是肝性脑病的机制。
extra.en: Just before this stretch he calls the synthesis of glutamine in the brain a transamination. It is not: glutamine synthetase amidates the gamma-carboxyl of glutamate with free NH4+ at the cost of one ATP (giving ADP + Pi). No amino group is exchanged between an amino acid and a keto acid, and no keto acid is produced. Transamination, which uses PLP, costs no ATP, makes no amide and fixes no free ammonia. Getting this wrong makes the rise in brain glutamine during hyperammonemia, and the osmotic swelling of astrocytes behind hepatic encephalopathy, impossible to explain.

quiz.q_zh: 五个酶齐备、能够跑完整个尿素循环的细胞是哪一种？
quiz.q_en: Which cell expresses all five enzymes and can run the complete urea cycle?

options.zh: 脑内星形胶质细胞，与谷氨酰胺偶联
options.en: Brain astrocytes, tied to glutamine synthesis

options.zh: 肾小管上皮细胞，全程在胞质完成
options.en: Renal tubular cells, entirely in the cytosol

options.zh: 肝细胞，分在线粒体基质与胞质
options.en: Hepatocytes, using both matrix and cytosol

options.zh: 骨骼肌纤维，与嘌呤核苷酸循环偶联
options.en: Skeletal muscle fibres, via the purine cycle

quiz.explain_zh: 只有肝细胞同时表达 CPS-1、OTC、ASS、ASL 和精氨酸酶，前两个在线粒体基质、后三个在胞质。肾小管细胞虽有 ASS/ASL（用于合成精氨酸），却缺 CPS-1 和 OTC，它做的是把肝造好的尿素排出去；骨骼肌跑的是嘌呤核苷酸循环，不造尿素；星形胶质细胞用谷氨酰胺合成酶把氨固定成谷氨酰胺，也不造尿素。
quiz.explain_en: Only hepatocytes express CPS-1, OTC, ASS, ASL and arginase together, the first two in the matrix and the last three in the cytosol. Renal tubular cells carry ASS and ASL for arginine synthesis but lack CPS-1 and OTC, and their job is excreting the urea the liver made. Skeletal muscle runs the purine nucleotide cycle and makes no urea, and astrocytes fix ammonia as glutamine with glutamine synthetase rather than making urea.

quiz.q_zh: CPS-1 催化尿素循环第一步时真正需要的底物是哪一组？
quiz.q_en: Which set of substrates does CPS-1 actually need for the first step of the urea cycle?

options.zh: 谷氨酰胺、HCO3- 和两分子 ATP
options.en: Glutamine, HCO3- and two ATP molecules

options.zh: NH4+、HCO3- 和一分子 GTP
options.en: NH4+, HCO3- and one molecule of GTP

options.zh: NH4+、Pi、CO2 和两分子 ATP
options.en: NH4+, Pi, CO2 and two molecules of ATP

options.zh: NH4+、HCO3- 和两分子 ATP
options.en: NH4+, HCO3- and two molecules of ATP

quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 用游离 NH4+、HCO3- 和两分子 ATP，另需变构激活剂 NAG。以谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮为氮源的是胞质里的 CPS-2（嘧啶从头合成），不是 CPS-1；这一步不用 GTP；游离磷酸也不是底物，产物上的磷酸由 ATP 直接提供。
quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 uses free NH4+, HCO3- and two ATP, with NAG as an obligatory allosteric activator. The enzyme that takes nitrogen from the amide of glutamine is cytosolic CPS-2 in pyrimidine synthesis, not CPS-1. No GTP is involved, and free phosphate is not a substrate: the phosphate in the product comes from the second ATP.

quiz.q_zh: 谷氨酸进入线粒体基质后把氮交出来的那一步属于什么反应？
quiz.q_en: What kind of reaction releases the nitrogen once glutamate is inside the matrix?

options.zh: 谷丙转氨酶转氨，把氨基交给了丙酮酸
options.en: ALT transamination, handing the group to pyruvate

options.zh: 谷氨酰胺合成酶酰胺化，耗一分子 ATP
options.en: Glutamine synthetase amidates it, consuming one ATP

options.zh: 谷氨酸脱氢酶氧化脱氨，生成 α-酮戊二酸
options.en: Glutamate dehydrogenase oxidatively deaminates it

options.zh: 谷氨酰胺酶水解酰胺键，产谷氨酸和氨
options.en: Glutaminase hydrolyses the amide, freeing ammonia

quiz.explain_zh: 基质里由谷氨酸脱氢酶（GDH）催化氧化脱氨：NAD(P)+ 先夺氢生成亚氨基酸，再水解成 α-酮戊二酸和 NH4+，氧原子来自水而不是分子氧。转氨只是把氨基换个载体，不放出游离氨；谷氨酰胺合成酶是把氨装上去而不是卸下来；谷氨酰胺酶水解的底物是谷氨酰胺，不是谷氨酸。
quiz.explain_en: Glutamate dehydrogenase in the matrix performs oxidative deamination: NAD(P)+ removes hydride to give an imino acid, which is then hydrolysed to alpha-ketoglutarate and NH4+, with the oxygen coming from water rather than molecular oxygen. Transamination merely moves the amino group to another carrier and frees no ammonia, glutamine synthetase loads ammonia on rather than off, and glutaminase acts on glutamine, not glutamate.

title_zh: 氨甲酰磷酸的结构，与鸟氨酸接手生成瓜氨酸（OTC）
title_en: The structure of carbamoyl phosphate, and ornithine taking it up to give citrulline (OTC)

points.zh: 他拆开氨甲酰磷酸的名字：Carbamoyl 对应中文的氨甲酰，Phosphate 是磷酸盐，合起来就是氨甲酰磷酸。
points.en: He takes the name apart: carbamoyl is the acyl group, phosphate is the phosphate, and together they give carbamoyl phosphate.

points.zh: 他在图上逐个指出来源：中间的甲酰碳来自二氧化碳，氮来自刚才释放的游离氨基，再加上一分子磷酸。
points.en: He points to each atom on the diagram: the central carbon comes from carbon dioxide, the nitrogen from the free ammonia just released, plus one phosphate.

points.zh: 他强调氨甲酰磷酸是整个尿素循环的起始分子。
points.en: He stresses that carbamoyl phosphate is the starting molecule of the whole urea cycle.

points.zh: 他注意到磷酸刚接上去，下一步马上又被脱掉，觉得这一上一下值得解释。
points.en: He notices that the phosphate is attached and then immediately removed in the next step, and thinks the round trip needs explaining.

points.zh: 他推测磷酸带负电，可以让这个小分子带上电荷，不能随意进出线粒体内膜，否则会干扰尿素循环；另一方面猜测磷酸起稳定作用。
points.en: He speculates that the negatively charged phosphate keeps this small molecule from slipping across the inner membrane, which would disrupt the cycle, and additionally guesses that the phosphate stabilises it.

points.zh: 接手氨甲酰基的是鸟氨酸 ornithine；他把鸟氨酸和赖氨酸对比，说赖氨酸侧链四个碳、鸟氨酸三个碳，只差一个碳，长得很像。
points.en: Ornithine takes up the carbamoyl group; he compares ornithine with lysine, noting lysine has four side-chain carbons and ornithine three, one carbon apart and very similar in shape.

points.zh: 他说氨甲酰基接到鸟氨酸的 γ 位氨基上，产物叫瓜氨酸 citrulline。
points.en: He says the carbamoyl group is attached to the gamma amino group of ornithine, giving citrulline.

points.zh: 他一度把瓜氨酸和 guanidine、胱氨酸/半胱氨酸串在一起，说了几句后自己放弃了这条线索。
points.en: He briefly tangles citrulline with guanidine and with cystine/cysteine, then drops the thread himself.

points.zh: 他总结线粒体基质里只发生两步：CPS-1 生成氨甲酰磷酸，鸟氨酸接过氨甲酰基、丢掉磷酸生成瓜氨酸；并说鸟氨酸和瓜氨酸都不属于 20 种经典氨基酸。
points.en: He sums up that only two steps happen in the matrix: CPS-1 makes carbamoyl phosphate, then ornithine takes the carbamoyl group and loses the phosphate to give citrulline; he also notes ornithine and citrulline are not among the 20 standard amino acids.

extra.zh: 磷酸的通透性故事是他自己的推测（他连用了「有可能是」「可能」），实际不是这么回事。氨甲酰磷酸是一个高能混合酸酐（酰基磷酸），那个磷酸基是 OTC 反应的离去基团：它提供把氨甲酰基转到鸟氨酸上的驱动力，ΔG 大幅为负，使 OTC 这一步实际不可逆。它不是「稳定剂」，也不是「防外漏的电荷标签」。而且 CPS-1 和 OTC 都在线粒体基质里，氨甲酰磷酸从生成到被用掉根本不接触内膜，膜通透性问题对它不适用。
extra.en: The permeability story is his own guess, hedged with maybe twice, and it is not what is going on. Carbamoyl phosphate is a high-energy mixed anhydride (an acyl phosphate), and that phosphate is the leaving group of the OTC reaction: it supplies the driving force for transferring the carbamoyl group onto ornithine, making the step strongly exergonic and effectively irreversible. It is neither a stabiliser nor a charge tag against leakage. Moreover CPS-1 and OTC are both in the matrix, so carbamoyl phosphate never meets the inner membrane between being made and being consumed, and membrane permeability simply does not apply to it.

extra.zh: 氨甲酰基接的是鸟氨酸的 δ 氨基，不是 γ。鸟氨酸是五碳氨基酸（2,5-二氨基戊酸），侧链氨基在 C5 即 δ 位；赖氨酸是六碳，侧链氨基在 ε 位。这正好和他自己讲的「赖氨酸侧链四个碳、鸟氨酸三个碳、差一个碳」对得上——那一段说得没错，只是位号标错了一位。
extra.en: The carbamoyl group goes onto the delta amino group of ornithine, not the gamma. Ornithine is a five-carbon amino acid (2,5-diaminopentanoic acid) with its side-chain amine on C5, the delta position; lysine has six carbons with its side-chain amine at epsilon. This matches his own remark that lysine has four side-chain carbons and ornithine three, one apart. That part was right; only the Greek letter is off by one.

extra.zh: 瓜氨酸、guanidine 和胱氨酸这三个概念被读音带串了，拆开记：胍基 guanidino（-NH-C(=NH)-NH2）长在精氨酸上，正是尿素循环最后一步被精氨酸酶水解掉的那个基团；瓜氨酸 citrulline 带的是脲基 ureido（-NH-CO-NH2），就是氨甲酰基转上来的产物，所以瓜氨酸是「带着半个尿素的鸟氨酸」；胱氨酸/半胱氨酸是含硫氨基酸，和这里毫无关系。
extra.en: Three concepts got tangled by their sounds, so separate them: the guanidino group (-NH-C(=NH)-NH2) sits on arginine and is exactly what arginase hydrolyses off in the last step; citrulline carries a ureido group (-NH-CO-NH2), the carbamoyl group just transferred onto it, so citrulline is essentially ornithine wearing half a urea; and cystine/cysteine are sulfur amino acids with no connection here at all.

extra.zh: 他全程没有点这个酶的名字：催化第二步的是鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶 ornithine transcarbamylase（OTC），在线粒体基质内。OTC 缺陷是最常见的尿素循环遗传病，而且是唯一 X 连锁的一种，男婴常在新生儿期因高氨血症发病；因为氨甲酰磷酸堆积会溢出到胞质走嘧啶合成，OTC 缺陷的特征性化验是尿乳清酸（orotic acid）升高、血瓜氨酸低——这条线索把尿素循环和后面要讲的嘧啶从头合成串了起来。
extra.en: He never names the enzyme: step two is catalysed by ornithine transcarbamylase (OTC) in the mitochondrial matrix. OTC deficiency is the commonest inherited urea cycle disorder and the only X-linked one, typically presenting with neonatal hyperammonemia in boys. Because the backed-up carbamoyl phosphate spills into the cytosol and enters pyrimidine synthesis, the diagnostic signature is raised urinary orotic acid with low plasma citrulline, a clue that links the urea cycle to the de novo pyrimidine pathway coming later in this lecture.

quiz.q_zh: OTC 把氨甲酰基转到鸟氨酸的哪一个氨基上？
