quiz.q_en: Onto which amino group of ornithine does OTC transfer the carbamoyl group?

options.zh: 侧链末端的 δ 氨基，即 C5 上的氨基
options.en: The side-chain delta amino group on carbon five

options.zh: 侧链末端的 ε 氨基，即 C6 上的氨基
options.en: The side-chain epsilon amino group on carbon six

options.zh: 侧链中段的 γ 氨基，即 C4 上的氨基
options.en: The side-chain gamma amino group on carbon four

options.zh: 参与成肽的 α 氨基，即 C2 上的骨架氨基
options.en: The alpha amino group on carbon two of ornithine

quiz.explain_zh: 鸟氨酸是 2,5-二氨基戊酸，侧链氨基在 C5 即 δ 位，OTC 把氨甲酰基转到这里生成瓜氨酸。γ 位（C4）上没有氨基；α 氨基要留着做羧基旁边的骨架氨基，不参与这一步；ε 位是赖氨酸侧链氨基的位号，鸟氨酸只有五个碳，根本没有 C6。
quiz.explain_en: Ornithine is 2,5-diaminopentanoic acid, so its side-chain amine sits on C5, the delta position, and OTC transfers the carbamoyl group there to give citrulline. There is no amine at gamma (C4); the alpha amine belongs to the backbone and is not used here; and epsilon is the position of the lysine side-chain amine, since ornithine has only five carbons and no C6 at all.

quiz.q_zh: 尿素循环中在线粒体基质内进行的是哪两步？
quiz.q_en: Which two steps of the urea cycle take place inside the mitochondrial matrix?

options.zh: CPS-1 生成氨甲酰磷酸与 ASS 所催化的缩合
options.en: Carbamoyl phosphate by CPS-1 and condensation by ASS

options.zh: ASS 催化的缩合与 ASL 催化的裂解这两步
options.en: The condensation by ASS and the cleavage done by ASL

options.zh: OTC 生成瓜氨酸与精氨酸酶水解精氨酸这两步
options.en: Citrulline formation by OTC and arginase hydrolysis

options.zh: CPS-1 生成氨甲酰磷酸和 OTC 生成瓜氨酸
options.en: Carbamoyl phosphate by CPS-1 and citrulline by OTC

quiz.explain_zh: 基质里只有 CPS-1 和 OTC 两步，其产物瓜氨酸再经载体运到胞质。ASS、ASL 和精氨酸酶都是胞质酶：ASS 让瓜氨酸和天冬氨酸缩合，ASL 裂解出延胡索酸，精氨酸酶水解精氨酸放出尿素，这三步都在膜外进行。老师这一处的区室划分本身是对的。
quiz.explain_en: Only CPS-1 and OTC operate in the matrix, and their product citrulline is then carried out to the cytosol. ASS, ASL and arginase are all cytosolic: ASS condenses citrulline with aspartate, ASL cleaves out fumarate, and arginase hydrolyses arginine to release urea, all outside the membrane. The teacher's compartment assignment on this point is correct.

quiz.q_zh: 瓜氨酸侧链末端带的是哪一类基团？
quiz.q_en: Which group sits at the end of the citrulline side chain?

options.zh: 脲基，由氨甲酰基转到氨基上形成
options.en: A ureido group, made by carbamoyl transfer

options.zh: 胍基，与精氨酸侧链上的完全一样
options.en: A guanidino group, the one arginine carries

options.zh: 巯基，与半胱氨酸侧链上的完全一样
options.en: A thiol group, the same one cysteine carries

options.zh: 咪唑基，与组氨酸侧链上的完全一样
options.en: An imidazole ring, the one histidine carries

quiz.explain_zh: OTC 把氨甲酰基转到 δ-氨基上，形成的正是脲基 -NH-CO-NH2，所以瓜氨酸相当于带着半个尿素。胍基 -NH-C(=NH)-NH2 在精氨酸上，要等 ASL 那一步之后才出现；巯基属于半胱氨酸，是含硫氨基酸的特征；咪唑基属于组氨酸，与尿素循环无关。
quiz.explain_en: OTC transfers the carbamoyl group onto the delta amine, producing a ureido group, -NH-CO-NH2, so citrulline effectively carries half a urea. The guanidino group, -NH-C(=NH)-NH2, belongs to arginine and only appears after the ASL step; the thiol belongs to cysteine, the marker of a sulfur amino acid; and the imidazole belongs to histidine and has nothing to do with this cycle.

title_zh: 瓜氨酸出线粒体，与天冬氨酸缩合成精氨琥珀酸
title_en: Citrulline leaves the mitochondrion and condenses with aspartate to give argininosuccinate

points.zh: 瓜氨酸生成后重新离开线粒体基质，进入细胞质；他顺带感慨自己也分不清 cytosol 和 plasma 这两个词的中文叫法。
points.en: Citrulline leaves the matrix again and enters the cytosol; he digresses on not being sure how cytosol and plasma differ as Chinese terms.

points.zh: 他说瓜氨酸在细胞质里要接受第二分子的氨，并追问这一分子氨是从哪来的。
points.en: He says citrulline picks up a second molecule of nitrogen in the cytosol, and asks where that nitrogen comes from.

points.zh: 先由一分子 ATP 把瓜氨酸活化，他强调这个 ATP 起的是激活作用。
points.en: One ATP first activates citrulline, and he stresses that this ATP serves an activating role.

points.zh: 这个 ATP 变成 AMP 和 PPi（焦磷酸），所以相当于消耗了两分子 ATP 的能量。
points.en: The ATP goes to AMP plus PPi (pyrophosphate), so the energy cost is equivalent to two ATP.

points.zh: 另一个氮的载体是天冬氨酸；他提醒学生天冬氨酸是与谷氨酸、谷氨酰胺并驾齐驱的三大氨基载体之一，在前面讲转氨基作用时已经出现过。
points.en: Aspartate carries the second nitrogen; he reminds students that aspartate ranks alongside glutamate and glutamine as one of the three main amino-group carriers introduced in the transamination section.

points.zh: 天冬氨酸与瓜氨酸结合成一个大分子，叫精氨琥珀酸。
points.en: Aspartate and citrulline join into one large molecule, argininosuccinate.

points.zh: 他从结构上解释这个名字：右边那段四个碳的基团是琥珀酸，左边那部分就是将来的精氨酸，所以直译叫精氨琥珀酸。
points.en: He explains the name from the structure: the four-carbon piece on the right is the succinate part and the left-hand piece is the future arginine, so the name is a literal compound.

points.zh: 他说这个过程其实只是天冬氨酸把氨基「怼」到瓜氨酸上，自己变成琥珀酸。
points.en: He describes the step as aspartate simply shoving its amino group onto citrulline while turning itself into succinate.

points.zh: 他犹豫地把这一步归到转氨基作用里，同时中间插了一段关于琥珀酸是不是流式细胞术标记物的题外提问，没有展开。
points.en: He tentatively classifies the step as a transamination, and a side question about whether succinate is a flow cytometry label is raised and left unresolved.

extra.zh: 这一步不是转氨基作用。催化它的精氨酸代琥珀酸合成酶（ASS，argininosuccinate synthetase）是一个连接酶 ligase：先用 ATP 把瓜氨酸脲基上的氧活化成 citrullyl-AMP 中间物，再由天冬氨酸的 α-氨基亲核进攻缩合，生成精氨酸代琥珀酸 + AMP + PPi。转氨基的定义是氨基在氨基酸和 α-酮酸之间对调、必然生成一个新的 α-酮酸；这里天冬氨酸的碳骨架整个留在产物分子里，没有生成任何 α-酮酸。他在 33:23 复述五步时又说了一次「它是转氨基作用」，两处都要按连接酶更正。
extra.en: This step is not a transamination. Argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS) is a ligase: ATP first activates the ureido oxygen of citrulline as a citrullyl-AMP intermediate, then the alpha amino group of aspartate attacks and condenses, giving argininosuccinate plus AMP and PPi. Transamination by definition swaps an amino group between an amino acid and a keto acid and must generate a new alpha-keto acid; here the entire aspartate carbon skeleton stays in the product and no keto acid appears. He repeats the transamination label at 33:23 while recapping the five steps, and both places need the same correction.

extra.zh: 天冬氨酸并不是「自己变成琥珀酸」。它的碳骨架成为精氨酸代琥珀酸里的琥珀酰部分，下一步被 ASL 裂解后是以延胡索酸（fumarate，即富马酸）的形式离开的，不是琥珀酸——差一个双键。他在 29:41 之后说「释放出富马酸」、33:23 之后说「延胡索酸」，都是对的，只有这里的简化说法不准。
extra.en: Aspartate does not turn into succinate. Its carbon skeleton becomes the succinyl portion of argininosuccinate and leaves in the next step, cleaved off by ASL, as fumarate, not succinate; the two differ by one double bond. After 29:41 he says fumarate and after 33:23 he says the Chinese name for fumarate, both correct, so only this shorthand is inaccurate.

extra.zh: 这一步的能量账值得单独记：ATP 断的是 α-β 键，生成 AMP + PPi，等于一次投入两个高能磷酸键，而细胞里的无机焦磷酸酶随即把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi，把平衡彻底拉向产物方向，使反应实际不可逆。这是生化里非常固定的一个模式（脂肪酸活化成脂酰CoA、氨基酸活化上 tRNA 都是同一套），凡是看到「产物是 AMP + PPi」就应当想到「不可逆、耗两个高能键」。
extra.en: The energetics of this step are worth memorising on their own: the ATP is split at the alpha-beta bond to give AMP and PPi, spending two high-energy phosphate bonds at once, and cellular inorganic pyrophosphatase immediately hydrolyses the PPi to two Pi, pulling the equilibrium hard towards product and making the reaction effectively irreversible. This is a fixed motif in biochemistry (fatty acid activation to acyl-CoA, amino acid charging onto tRNA), so AMP plus PPi as products should always signal irreversible and two high-energy bonds.

extra.zh: 瓜氨酸不是自己扩散出去的：它由线粒体内膜上的鸟氨酸/瓜氨酸转运体 ORNT1（SLC25A15）与鸟氨酸做反向交换运出，同时把鸟氨酸换进来，这一个载体就把循环的两个区室接了起来；ORNT1 缺陷即 HHH 综合征。另一个载体 citrin（SLC25A13，天冬氨酸-谷氨酸交换体）负责把天冬氨酸送到胞质来供 ASS 用，它的缺陷是瓜氨酸血症 II 型。ASS 本身是这条通路胞质段的限速酶。
extra.en: Citrulline does not diffuse out on its own: the inner-membrane ornithine/citrulline carrier ORNT1 (SLC25A15) exports it in exchange for ornithine coming in, so a single transporter stitches the two compartments of the cycle together; ORNT1 deficiency is HHH syndrome. A second carrier, citrin (SLC25A13, the aspartate-glutamate exchanger), delivers the aspartate that ASS needs into the cytosol, and its deficiency is citrullinemia type II. ASS itself is the rate-limiting enzyme of the cytosolic half of the pathway.

quiz.q_zh: 瓜氨酸与天冬氨酸生成精氨酸代琥珀酸这一步属于哪类反应？
quiz.q_en: What kind of reaction joins citrulline and aspartate into argininosuccinate?

options.zh: ATP 依赖的水解，把脲基的酰胺键直接切断
options.en: ATP-dependent hydrolysis, cutting the ureido amide

options.zh: PLP 依赖的转氨，同时生成对应的 α-酮酸
options.en: PLP-dependent transamination, making a keto acid

options.zh: NAD+ 依赖的氧化脱氨，同时放出一分子氨
options.en: NAD-dependent oxidative deamination, freeing ammonia

options.zh: ATP 依赖的缩合反应，断成 AMP 与 PPi
options.en: ATP-dependent condensation, split to AMP and PPi

quiz.explain_zh: ASS 是连接酶：ATP 先把脲基氧活化成 citrullyl-AMP，天冬氨酸的 α-氨基再亲核进攻完成缩合，产物是精氨酸代琥珀酸 + AMP + PPi。这里没有生成 α-酮酸，所以不是转氨；也没有 NAD+ 参与、没有游离氨放出；更不是把脲基切断——脲基恰恰被保留下来，将来变成精氨酸的胍基。
quiz.explain_en: ASS is a ligase: ATP activates the ureido oxygen as citrullyl-AMP and the alpha amino group of aspartate then attacks to complete the condensation, giving argininosuccinate plus AMP and PPi. No keto acid is formed, so it is not a transamination; no NAD is involved and no ammonia is released; and the ureido group is not cut but preserved, later becoming the guanidino group of arginine.

quiz.q_zh: 这一步消耗的那分子 ATP 最终变成了什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the ATP consumed in this step end up as?

options.zh: 变成 AMP 和 PPi，净花两个高能键
options.en: AMP and PPi, spending two high-energy bonds net

options.zh: 变成 cAMP 和 Pi，随后参与信号转导
options.en: cAMP and Pi, which then act in signal transduction

options.zh: 变成 GTP 和 Pi，为下一步裂解供能
options.en: GTP and Pi, powering the cleavage in the next step

options.zh: 变成 ADP 和 Pi，只花掉一个高能键
options.en: ADP and Pi, spending one high-energy bond only

quiz.explain_zh: ATP 在 α-β 位断开，生成 AMP + PPi，等于一次投入两个高能磷酸键，焦磷酸随后被焦磷酸酶水解成 2 Pi，把反应拉成不可逆。断成 ADP + Pi 只花一个高能键，是 CPS-1 那两步的方式；cAMP 由腺苷酸环化酶生成，与本步无关；下一步 ASL 的裂解根本不耗核苷三磷酸。
quiz.explain_en: The ATP is cleaved between the alpha and beta phosphates to AMP plus PPi, spending two high-energy bonds at once, and pyrophosphatase then hydrolyses the PPi to two Pi, making the step irreversible. Cleavage to ADP and Pi costs only one bond and is what happens twice at CPS-1; cAMP is made by adenylate cyclase and is irrelevant here; and the ASL cleavage that follows consumes no nucleoside triphosphate at all.

title_zh: ASL 裂解与精氨酸酶：尿素的生成与鸟氨酸的再生
title_en: ASL and arginase: making urea and regenerating ornithine

points.zh: 精氨琥珀酸这个大分子在下一步被裂解，右边那一小段直接被切下来，以富马酸的形式释放出去。
points.en: The large argininosuccinate molecule is cleaved in the next step, the right-hand piece being snipped off and released as fumarate.

points.zh: 他指着图说裂解后左边剩下的部分正好就是一个精氨酸。
points.en: He points out that what remains on the left after the cleavage is exactly an arginine.

points.zh: 精氨酸在精氨酸酶的作用下再被切开，产生一分子尿素。
points.en: Arginine is then cut by arginase, releasing one molecule of urea.

points.zh: 他第一次说这一步的产物是「一个精氨酸和一分子的尿素」。
points.en: He first states that this step yields an arginine plus a molecule of urea.

points.zh: 他在 30:47 明确自我更正：精氨酸裂解后是一分子尿素和一分子鸟氨酸，此后一直用鸟氨酸。
points.en: At 30:47 he corrects himself explicitly: the products are one urea and one ornithine, and he uses ornithine consistently from then on.

points.zh: 鸟氨酸重新回到线粒体基质，再次起始下一轮，所以这条通路才叫「循环」——起于鸟氨酸、终于鸟氨酸，有头有尾。
points.en: Ornithine returns to the matrix and starts the next round, which is why the pathway is a cycle: it begins and ends with ornithine.

points.zh: 他从尿素的结构讲意义：尿素上面的两个氨基都来自体内被代谢掉的氨，一分子尿素可以一次带走两分子氨。
points.en: He reads the meaning off the urea structure: both of its amino groups come from ammonia produced by metabolism, so one urea carries away two ammonia at once.

points.zh: 他强调尿素的溶解性非常好，说这个小分子的溶解程度比氯化钠还要好上 10 倍左右。
points.en: He stresses that urea is extremely soluble, saying this small molecule dissolves about ten times better than sodium chloride.

points.zh: 他据此总结：人体最终选择尿素这种形式来运输和排出游离氨。
points.en: He concludes that the body therefore settles on urea as the form in which free ammonia is transported and excreted.

extra.zh: 精氨酸酶的产物他先说成「精氨酸 + 尿素」，但在 30:47 自己改回来了：精氨酸 + H2O → 鸟氨酸 + 尿素。以他后半段的说法为准。顺带一个用词：精氨酸酶 arginase 做的是水解（水攻击胍基的碳），属于水解酶而不是裂解酶；本循环里真正的裂解酶是上一步的 ASL（argininosuccinate lyase），它做的是 β-消除，不用水也不用 ATP。
extra.en: He first gives the arginase products as arginine plus urea, then corrects himself at 30:47: arginine + H2O gives ornithine + urea. Take the later statement. A wording note as well: arginase hydrolyses (water attacks the guanidino carbon), so it is a hydrolase, not a lyase; the genuine lyase in this cycle is ASL in the preceding step, which performs a beta-elimination needing neither water nor ATP.

extra.zh: 溶解度的数字夸大了。20 °C 下尿素约 1080 g/L，NaCl 约 360 g/L，是约 3 倍而不是 10 倍。结论没问题：尿素是不带电的中性小分子（MW 60），可以在血和尿里浓缩到很高浓度而不改变 pH、不影响渗透调节以外的功能，这正是它适合当氮排泄形式的原因。
extra.en: The solubility figure is inflated. At 20 degrees C urea dissolves to about 1080 g/L against roughly 360 g/L for NaCl, about three times better rather than ten. The conclusion stands: urea is an uncharged neutral small molecule (MW 60) that can be concentrated in blood and urine without shifting pH or interfering with anything beyond osmotic balance, which is precisely why it works as the nitrogen excretion form.

extra.zh: 被切下来的富马酸不是废物，它正是尿素循环和 TCA 循环的接口，这条连接叫天冬氨酸-精氨酸代琥珀酸穿梭（aspartate-argininosuccinate shunt）：富马酸经胞质延胡索酸酶水合成苹果酸，苹果酸由胞质苹果酸脱氢酶氧化成草酰乙酸（顺便产 NADH），草酰乙酸再由胞质 AST 转氨变回天冬氨酸，重新去喂 ASS。所以尿素循环的另一个氮是被 TCA 中间物来回搬运进来的，两个循环在这里咬合成一个 8 字（Krebs 双循环）。
extra.en: The fumarate cut off here is not waste; it is the junction between the urea cycle and the TCA cycle, a link called the aspartate-argininosuccinate shunt. Cytosolic fumarase hydrates fumarate to malate, cytosolic malate dehydrogenase oxidises malate to oxaloacetate (yielding NADH on the way), and cytosolic AST transaminates oxaloacetate back to aspartate to feed ASS again. The second nitrogen of urea is therefore ferried in by TCA intermediates, and the two cycles interlock here into a figure of eight, the Krebs bicycle.

extra.zh: 尿素两个氮的来源并不相同，这是考点：一个氮是游离 NH4+ 经 CPS-1 装进氨甲酰磷酸的，另一个氮是天冬氨酸的 α-氨基经 ASS 带进来的；碳原子来自 HCO3-。他说「两个氨基都来源于体内被代谢的氨」在结果上没错（两者最终都源自氨基酸的氮），但路径完全不同——一条是游离氨直接固定，一条是靠天冬氨酸这个载体转运，这也解释了为什么谷氨酸-天冬氨酸的转氨系统对尿素循环不可或缺。
extra.en: The two nitrogens of urea have different origins, and this is examinable: one comes from free NH4+ loaded into carbamoyl phosphate by CPS-1, the other from the alpha amino group of aspartate delivered by ASS, while the carbon comes from HCO3-. His statement that both amino groups derive from metabolised ammonia is true as an endpoint, since both ultimately come from amino acid nitrogen, but the routes differ completely: one fixes free ammonia directly, the other arrives on aspartate as a carrier, which is why the glutamate-aspartate transamination system is indispensable to the cycle.

quiz.q_zh: 精氨酸酶催化的这一步真正的产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the arginase step actually produce?

options.zh: 延胡索酸和尿素，延胡索酸进 TCA
options.en: Fumarate and urea, the fumarate entering the TCA cycle

options.zh: 精氨酸和尿素，精氨酸再回基质
options.en: Arginine and urea, arginine returning to the matrix

options.zh: 鸟氨酸和尿素，鸟氨酸再回基质
options.en: Ornithine and urea, ornithine returning to the matrix

options.zh: 瓜氨酸和尿素，瓜氨酸再回基质
options.en: Citrulline and urea, citrulline returning to the matrix

quiz.explain_zh: 精氨酸 + H2O → 鸟氨酸 + 尿素，鸟氨酸回到线粒体基质开始下一轮，这也是这条通路叫循环的原因。老师一开始说成精氨酸 + 尿素，在 30:47 自己改正了。瓜氨酸是上游 OTC 的产物，不在这一步出现；延胡索酸是前一步 ASL 切下来的，与精氨酸酶无关。
quiz.explain_en: Arginine plus water gives ornithine plus urea, and the ornithine returns to the matrix to begin another round, which is what makes this a cycle. The teacher first said arginine plus urea and corrected himself at 30:47. Citrulline is the upstream product of OTC and does not appear here, and fumarate was cut off in the preceding ASL step and has nothing to do with arginase.

quiz.q_zh: ASL 切下来的富马酸随后走的是哪条路？
quiz.q_en: What happens to the fumarate released by ASL?

options.zh: 经苹果酸、草酰乙酸转氨回天冬氨酸
options.en: Via malate and oxaloacetate, transaminated to aspartate

options.zh: 被脲酶分解成氨和碳酸氢根后排出
options.en: Urease splits it to ammonia and bicarbonate for exit

options.zh: 直接被精氨酸酶水解，交出另一个氮原子
options.en: Arginase hydrolyses it, handing over a nitrogen atom

options.zh: 被还原成琥珀酸后进入嘧啶的合成
options.en: It is reduced to succinate for pyrimidine synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: 这是天冬氨酸-精氨酸代琥珀酸穿梭：富马酸→苹果酸→草酰乙酸→（AST 转氨）→天冬氨酸，再回来喂 ASS，尿素循环与 TCA 在此咬合。脲酶分解的底物是尿素而且人体没有这个酶；精氨酸酶的底物是精氨酸；富马酸不会被还原成琥珀酸去做嘧啶，嘧啶环的碳来自 HCO3- 和天冬氨酸。
quiz.explain_en: This is the aspartate-argininosuccinate shunt: fumarate becomes malate, then oxaloacetate, then aspartate by AST transamination, and returns to feed ASS, which is where the urea and TCA cycles interlock. Urease acts on urea and humans do not have it; arginase acts on arginine; and fumarate is not reduced to succinate for pyrimidine synthesis, whose ring carbons come from bicarbonate and aspartate.

quiz.q_zh: 关于尿素分子里的两个氮，下面哪种说法正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the two nitrogens in urea is correct?

options.zh: 一个来自谷氨酰胺酰胺氮，一个来自 NH4+
options.en: One comes from the glutamine amide, one from NH4+

options.zh: 一个来自游离的 NH4+，另一个则来自天冬氨酸
options.en: One comes from free NH4+, the other from aspartate

options.zh: 一个来自鸟氨酸侧链，另一个来自天冬氨酸
options.en: One from the ornithine side chain, one from aspartate

options.zh: 两个都由 CPS-1 以游离 NH4+ 装入
options.en: Both are loaded as free NH4+ by CPS-1 at the start

quiz.explain_zh: 其中一个氮由 CPS-1 把游离 NH4+ 装进氨甲酰磷酸，另一个氮由 ASS 从天冬氨酸的 α-氨基带进来，碳来自 HCO3-。两个氮都走 CPS-1 是错的，那样就不需要天冬氨酸了；用谷氨酰胺酰胺氮的是胞质里的 CPS-2，属于嘧啶合成；鸟氨酸的侧链氮留在分子骨架上循环使用，并不进入尿素。
quiz.explain_en: The first nitrogen is loaded as free NH4+ into carbamoyl phosphate by CPS-1 and the second arrives from the alpha amino group of aspartate via ASS, while the carbon comes from bicarbonate. Both nitrogens passing through CPS-1 would make aspartate unnecessary; the amide nitrogen of glutamine is used by cytosolic CPS-2 in pyrimidine synthesis; and the ornithine side-chain nitrogen stays in the recycling backbone and never ends up in urea.

title_zh: 为什么非做成尿素不可：游离氨的麻烦，以及五步的复述
title_en: Why nitrogen must become urea: the trouble with free ammonia, and a recap of the five steps

points.zh: 他再次强调循环闭合的逻辑：鸟氨酸起始、鸟氨酸再生，有头有尾，所以叫尿素循环。
points.en: He restates the logic of closure: ornithine starts it and ornithine is regenerated, head meeting tail, which is why it is called a cycle.

points.zh: 学生提问：裂解羧基没问题，但裂解 amine 很困难，所以才要把氮运出去；两人确认讨论的是游离氨。
points.en: A student asks why carboxyl groups are easy to remove while the amine is hard, hence the need to export nitrogen; they confirm they mean free ammonia.

points.zh: 他形容游离氨是个「很恶心的东西」，因为它能和水络合，与一分子水紧密结合变成氨水。
points.en: He calls free ammonia a nasty molecule because it associates tightly with water to become aqueous ammonia.

points.zh: 他由此论证人体很难直接处理游离氨：肾脏很难把水和氨水区分开。
points.en: From this he argues the body cannot handle free ammonia directly, because the kidney can hardly tell water from aqueous ammonia.

points.zh: 而把尿素和水区分开要简单得多，所以最终选择尿素形式把氮排出去。
points.en: Separating urea from water is much easier, so urea is the form finally chosen for exporting nitrogen.

points.zh: 他开始复述整个循环共五步：第一步在线粒体基质，由游离氨基、二氧化碳、两分子 ATP 和一分子磷酸在 CPS-1 作用下生成氨甲酰磷酸。
points.en: He recaps the cycle as five steps: step one in the matrix, where free ammonia, carbon dioxide, two ATP and one phosphate give carbamoyl phosphate under CPS-1.

points.zh: 第二步氨甲酰磷酸的氨甲酰基被鸟氨酸接收，生成瓜氨酸，随后瓜氨酸出到细胞质。
points.en: Step two: ornithine takes the carbamoyl group from carbamoyl phosphate to make citrulline, which then moves out into the cytosol.

points.zh: 第三步瓜氨酸接受一分子天冬氨酸生成精氨琥珀酸；他再次把这一步叫作转氨基作用，说是天冬氨酸带走的氨。
points.en: Step three: citrulline takes on aspartate to give argininosuccinate; he again calls this a transamination, with the nitrogen carried in by aspartate.

points.zh: 第四步精氨琥珀酸裂解成精氨酸和延胡索酸，第五步精氨酸进一步裂解成鸟氨酸加尿素；他解释板书乱是因为当年跟着教授在黑板上一边写一边抄。
points.en: Step four cleaves argininosuccinate into arginine and fumarate, step five splits arginine into ornithine and urea; he explains his messy board comes from copying his professor live.

extra.zh: 「肾脏很难把水和氨水区分开」这句里的器官又错位了。解氨靠的是肝细胞的尿素循环，肾做的是把肝造好的尿素滤出并浓缩排掉。而且肾在代谢性酸中毒时反而是产氨器官：肾小管的谷氨酰胺酶把谷氨酰胺水解成谷氨酸和 NH4+，NH4+ 随尿排出并带走 H+，这是排酸机制，不是解氨毒。所以高氨血症要查的是肝，尿素氮升高才是查肾。
extra.en: The organ slips again in the line about the kidney struggling to tell water from aqueous ammonia. Detoxifying ammonia is done by the urea cycle in hepatocytes; the kidney filters and concentrates the urea the liver has already made. In metabolic acidosis the kidney is in fact an ammonia-producing organ: tubular glutaminase hydrolyses glutamine to glutamate and NH4+, and the NH4+ leaves in the urine carrying protons with it, an acid-excretion mechanism rather than ammonia detoxification. Hyperammonemia therefore points at the liver, while a rising urea nitrogen points at the kidney.

extra.zh: 氨真正致命的地方不在肾而在中枢。脑没有尿素循环，只能靠星形胶质细胞的谷氨酰胺合成酶把 NH3 固定成谷氨酰胺；氨一高，谷氨酰胺在星形胶质细胞内渗透性积累，细胞肿胀导致脑水肿甚至颅内压升高。同时氨的固定不断抽走 α-酮戊二酸，削弱 TCA 循环供能，并干扰谷氨酸能神经传递。这三条合起来就是肝性脑病的机制，也是为什么临床上要用乳果糖（减少肠道产氨与吸收）和利福昔明（减少产氨菌）来治疗。
extra.en: Ammonia is lethal in the brain, not the kidney. The brain has no urea cycle and relies on astrocytic glutamine synthetase to trap NH3 as glutamine; when ammonia rises, glutamine accumulates osmotically inside astrocytes, swelling them and producing cerebral oedema and even raised intracranial pressure. Trapping ammonia also drains alpha-ketoglutarate, weakening TCA output, and disturbs glutamatergic transmission. Together these three are the mechanism of hepatic encephalopathy, and they are why lactulose (less gut ammonia produced and absorbed) and rifaximin (fewer ammonia-producing bacteria) are used clinically.

extra.zh: 他说的「氨和水络合」用化学语言讲更清楚：NH3 溶于水后与水建立平衡，NH4+ 的 pKa 约 9.25，所以生理 pH 7.4 下血中 98% 以上以带电的 NH4+ 存在，只有极小部分是能自由跨膜的 NH3。麻烦正在于此——带电的 NH4+ 过不了膜、要靠转运体，中性的 NH3 却能自由扩散进细胞尤其进脑；而且氨的浓度稍高就足以干扰 pH 和神经传递。尿素相反：中性、不解离、不参与酸碱平衡，可以安全地高浓度存在。
extra.en: His idea that ammonia associates with water is clearer in chemical terms: dissolved NH3 equilibrates with water, and since the pKa of NH4+ is about 9.25, more than 98 percent of blood ammonia at pH 7.4 is the charged NH4+ ion, with only a trace as freely membrane-permeant NH3. That is exactly the problem: charged NH4+ cannot cross membranes and needs transporters, while neutral NH3 diffuses freely into cells and especially into the brain, and even modest concentrations disturb pH and neurotransmission. Urea is the opposite: neutral, non-ionising, outside acid-base balance, and safe at high concentration.

extra.zh: 五步对应五个酶，也对应五种遗传性尿素循环障碍，正好可以用来记顺序：CPS-1 缺陷、OTC 缺陷（最常见，且是唯一 X 连锁）、ASS 缺陷即瓜氨酸血症 I 型、ASL 缺陷即精氨酸代琥珀酸尿症、精氨酸酶缺陷即精氨酸血症。区分要点是阻断位点上游的中间物堆积：OTC 缺陷时氨甲酰磷酸溢到胞质走嘧啶合成，尿乳清酸高；CPS-1 缺陷因为堵在更上游，乳清酸不高——这一条差别就是临床上区分这两种病的关键。
extra.en: The five steps map onto five enzymes and onto five inherited urea cycle disorders, which makes a useful way to remember the order: CPS-1 deficiency, OTC deficiency (commonest and the only X-linked one), ASS deficiency or citrullinemia type I, ASL deficiency or argininosuccinic aciduria, and arginase deficiency or argininemia. They are told apart by what piles up above the block: in OTC deficiency carbamoyl phosphate spills into the cytosol and drives pyrimidine synthesis, raising urinary orotic acid, whereas CPS-1 deficiency is blocked further upstream and orotic acid stays normal, and that single difference is the clinical discriminator.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么人体要把游离氨转成尿素再排出，而不是直接排氨？
quiz.q_en: Why does the body convert free ammonia into urea instead of excreting ammonia?

options.zh: 尿素能在细胞内被脲酶迅速分解为氨基
options.en: Urea is quickly split back to ammonia by cell urease

options.zh: 尿素是中性小分子，不影响酸碱平衡
options.en: Urea is neutral and stays out of acid-base balance

options.zh: 尿素能被肾小管重吸收后再利用为氮源
options.en: Urea is reabsorbed by tubules and reused as nitrogen

options.zh: 尿素在血中不溶，可以被肝直接分泌掉
options.en: Urea is insoluble in blood and secreted by the liver

quiz.explain_zh: 尿素不带电、不解离、极易溶（20 °C 约 1080 g/L），一分子带走两个氮，可以在血和尿里高浓度存在而不扰乱 pH 和神经传递；游离氨则以 NH4+/NH3 平衡存在，中性的 NH3 能自由进脑，毒性正在于此。尿素在髓质确实参与浓缩机制但不是被当氮源再利用；说它不溶正好说反了；人体根本没有脲酶。
quiz.explain_en: Urea is uncharged, does not ionise, dissolves extremely well (about 1080 g/L at 20 degrees C) and carries two nitrogens per molecule, so it can sit at high concentration in blood and urine without disturbing pH or neurotransmission, whereas free ammonia exists as an NH4+/NH3 equilibrium whose neutral NH3 enters the brain freely, which is where the toxicity lies. Urea does participate in medullary concentration but is not recycled as a nitrogen source, calling it insoluble is exactly backwards, and humans have no urease at all.

quiz.q_zh: 高氨血症最主要的临床后果是什么，机制在哪里？
quiz.q_en: What is the main clinical consequence of hyperammonemia, and by what mechanism?

options.zh: 痛风，因为氨在关节内形成结晶沉积
options.en: Gout, because ammonia crystallises inside the joints

options.zh: 尿毒症，因为肾小球滤过率下降而潴留废物
options.en: Uraemia, because a low filtration rate retains waste

options.zh: 溶血，因为氨破坏红细胞膜上的磷脂
options.en: Haemolysis, because ammonia attacks membrane lipids

options.zh: 肝性脑病，因为脑内谷氨酰胺积累肿胀
options.en: Encephalopathy, from glutamine building in astrocytes

quiz.explain_zh: 脑没有尿素循环，只能靠谷氨酰胺合成酶把氨固定成谷氨酰胺，谷氨酰胺在星形胶质细胞内渗透性积累引起细胞肿胀和脑水肿，同时抽走 α-酮戊二酸削弱 TCA，这就是肝性脑病。痛风来自尿酸而非氨；尿毒症是肾衰竭时含氮废物潴留，与解氨能力不是一回事；氨并不以破坏红细胞膜磷脂的方式致病。
quiz.explain_en: The brain has no urea cycle and can only trap ammonia as glutamine via glutamine synthetase; the glutamine accumulates osmotically in astrocytes, swelling them into cerebral oedema, while the trapping drains alpha-ketoglutarate and weakens the TCA cycle. That is hepatic encephalopathy. Gout comes from uric acid rather than ammonia, uraemia is retention of nitrogenous waste in renal failure and is a different problem from ammonia detoxification, and ammonia does not act by attacking red cell membrane lipids.

title_zh: 五步的整体账：尿素循环的净反应式与能量收支
title_en: The overall balance sheet: the net equation and energy cost of the urea cycle

points.zh: 他把尿素循环的五步与别的通路比步数：三羧酸循环十来步（他自己也记不准是 10、11 还是 12 步），脂肪酸分解只有四步，并推测步数越多可能越重要。
points.en: He compares step counts: about ten to twelve for the TCA cycle (he is unsure which) against four for fatty acid breakdown, and guesses more steps may mean more importance.

points.zh: 整个过程一共移除两分子游离氨：一分子来自游离氨基，另一分子来自天冬氨酸携带的氨基。
points.en: The process removes two ammonia in total: one from free ammonia and one carried in on aspartate.

points.zh: 还接受一分子二氧化碳；他说有时候写成碳酸氢根也可以，因为二氧化碳在体内的主要形式就是碳酸。
points.en: It also takes up one carbon dioxide; he says it can be written as bicarbonate, because carbon dioxide exists in the body mainly as carbonic acid.

points.zh: 明面上消耗三分子 ATP：两分子在氨甲酰磷酸那一步，一分子在瓜氨酸变精氨琥珀酸那一步。
points.en: Three ATP are spent on paper: two at the carbamoyl phosphate step and one at the citrulline to argininosuccinate step.

points.zh: 但他提醒瓜氨酸那一步实际消耗的是两分子 ATP 的能量，只不过只用掉一分子 ATP。
points.en: He notes the citrulline step actually costs the energy of two ATP while consuming only one ATP molecule.

points.zh: 他把这归纳成一条通则：很多「活化」都是分解成一分子焦磷酸加一分子 AMP 或 GMP 的形式。
points.en: He generalises: many activation steps split the nucleotide into pyrophosphate plus AMP or GMP.

points.zh: 他举丙二酸单酰CoA 的生成作为同类例子，说那个活化也是耗两个高能磷酸键、只用一分子 ATP 或 GTP。
points.en: He offers malonyl-CoA formation as a parallel example, claiming it too spends two high-energy bonds using only one ATP or GTP.

points.zh: 他说反应还「络合」了两分子水，最终产物是一分子尿素、两分子 ADP 加一分子 AMP、以及四分子游离磷酸；他随后复述时把 ADP 说成了 ATP。
points.en: He says the reaction also complexes two waters, with products of one urea, two ADP plus one AMP, and four free phosphates; on repeating it he says ATP instead of ADP.

points.zh: 他最后说明：讲尿素循环时很少谈能量代谢，因为它既不是主要的耗能途径也不是产能途径，它只是把氨基变成尿素。
points.en: He closes by saying energy is rarely discussed for this cycle, since it is neither a major consumer nor producer of energy and exists only to turn amino nitrogen into urea.

extra.zh: 完整的净方程写出来是：NH4+ + HCO3- + 天冬氨酸 + 3 ATP + 2 H2O → 尿素 + 延胡索酸 + 2 ADP + AMP + 4 Pi。四个高能磷酸键（CPS-1 用两个、ASS 用两个），四个 Pi 全部来自这三分子 ATP。他复述时说的「两分子 ATP 一分子 AMP」是口误，前一句「两分子 ADP 加一分子 AMP」才是对的。要注意这个 4 个高能键并不是净成本：切下来的延胡索酸经苹果酸氧化成草酰乙酸时产一分子 NADH，回收的能量把实际净支出压下来不少。
extra.en: Written out in full: NH4+ + HCO3- + aspartate + 3 ATP + 2 H2O gives urea + fumarate + 2 ADP + AMP + 4 Pi. Four high-energy phosphate bonds are spent (two at CPS-1, two at ASS) and all four Pi come from those three ATP. His repeated version, two ATP and one AMP, is a slip; the earlier two ADP plus one AMP is right. Note the four bonds are not the net cost: the fumarate released is oxidised via malate to oxaloacetate, yielding one NADH whose recovered energy offsets a good part of the outlay.

extra.zh: 两分子水是被消耗（水解掉）的，不是「络合」。一分子用在精氨酸酶那一步（精氨酸 + H2O → 尿素 + 鸟氨酸），另一分子用在无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi 这一步。「络合」是配位化学的词，指配体与金属中心配位，这里没有任何配位反应。
extra.en: The two waters are consumed by hydrolysis, not complexed. One is used by arginase (arginine + H2O gives urea + ornithine) and the other by inorganic pyrophosphatase splitting PPi into two Pi. Complexation is a coordination-chemistry term for ligands binding a metal centre, and nothing of the sort happens here.

extra.zh: 丙二酸单酰CoA 这个例子举错了。乙酰CoA 羧化酶（ACC）用的是 ATP → ADP + Pi，只断一个高能磷酸键，属于生物素依赖的羧化反应，跟 AMP + PPi 那一类不是一回事。真正符合「一分子 ATP、两个高能磷酸键、产物是 AMP + PPi」的例子是脂肪酸的活化（脂酰CoA 合成酶：脂肪酸 + CoA + ATP → 脂酰CoA + AMP + PPi），以及氨基酸活化上 tRNA——它们和尿素循环第三步 ASS 才是同一个模式。他要讲的道理没错，例子换掉即可。
extra.en: The malonyl-CoA example is the wrong one. Acetyl-CoA carboxylase uses ATP going to ADP plus Pi, breaking only one high-energy bond, and it is a biotin-dependent carboxylation, a different class from the AMP plus PPi pattern. Genuine examples of one ATP spending two high-energy bonds to give AMP and PPi are fatty acid activation (acyl-CoA synthetase: fatty acid + CoA + ATP giving acyl-CoA + AMP + PPi) and amino acid charging onto tRNA, which are the true analogues of the ASS step. His general point is right; only the example needs replacing.

extra.zh: 「二氧化碳在体内的主要形式就是碳酸」不成立。血液里的 CO2 约 90% 以碳酸氢根 HCO3- 的形式存在，真正的 H2CO3 浓度只有 HCO3- 的约 1/400（碳酸酐酶把 CO2 + H2O 迅速转成 H+ + HCO3-）。他前半句「有些时候写成碳酸氢根也可以」是对的，后半句退回碳酸就错了。这不是措辞问题：CPS-1 的底物本来就是 HCO3-，不是溶解的 CO2。
extra.en: Carbon dioxide does not exist in the body mainly as carbonic acid. About 90 percent of blood CO2 is bicarbonate, and true H2CO3 sits at roughly one four-hundredth of the bicarbonate concentration, since carbonic anhydrase converts CO2 and water rapidly into protons and HCO3-. His first clause, that it can be written as bicarbonate, is correct; retreating to carbonic acid is not. This is not merely wording: the substrate of CPS-1 is HCO3- itself, not dissolved CO2.

quiz.q_zh: 尿素循环合成一分子尿素的净反应式中，核苷酸产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the net equation for making one urea, what are the nucleotide products?

options.zh: 两分子 ATP、一分子 AMP 和两分子 Pi
options.en: Two ATP, one AMP and two inorganic phosphates

options.zh: 一分子 ADP、两分子 GMP 和四分子 Pi
options.en: One ADP, two GMP and four inorganic phosphates

options.zh: 三分子 ADP、三分子 Pi 和一分子 PPi
options.en: Three ADP, three Pi and one molecule of PPi

options.zh: 两分子 ADP、一分子 AMP 以及四分子 Pi
options.en: Two ADP, one AMP and four inorganic phosphates

quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 用掉两个 ATP、各给出一个 ADP + Pi，ASS 用掉一个 ATP 给出 AMP + PPi，PPi 再被水解成 2 Pi，所以共 2 ADP + 1 AMP + 4 Pi，折合四个高能磷酸键。三个 ADP 意味着三步都只断一个高能键，忽略了 ASS 的 AMP；产物写成 ATP 是老师复述时的口误；GMP 在尿素循环里根本不出现，那是嘌呤合成里 IMP 变 AMP 的供能方式。
quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 spends two ATP, each giving ADP plus Pi, and ASS spends one ATP giving AMP plus PPi, which is then hydrolysed to two Pi, so the total is two ADP, one AMP and four Pi, equal to four high-energy bonds. Three ADP would imply every step breaks only one bond and ignores the AMP from ASS; writing ATP as a product is the slip the teacher made on repeating it; and GMP never appears in this cycle, belonging instead to the IMP to AMP step of purine synthesis.

quiz.q_zh: 尿素循环里净方程消耗的那两分子水用在了哪两步？
quiz.q_en: Where are the two waters of the net equation actually consumed?

options.zh: CPS-1 活化 HCO3-，与 OTC 的转移
options.en: Bicarbonate activation by CPS-1 and carbamoyl transfer

options.zh: 精氨酸酶的水解，与焦磷酸酶对 PPi 的水解
options.en: Arginase hydrolysis and pyrophosphatase splitting PPi

options.zh: ASL 的裂解反应，以及富马酸水合成苹果酸
options.en: The ASL cleavage and hydration of fumarate to malate

options.zh: 谷氨酸脱氢酶的脱氨，以及 ASS 的缩合反应
options.en: Deamination by dehydrogenase and condensation by ASS

quiz.explain_zh: 一分子水用于精氨酸酶（精氨酸 + H2O → 尿素 + 鸟氨酸），另一分子用于无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi。CPS-1 和 OTC 的化学是磷酸转移与酰基转移，不是水解；ASL 走的是 β-消除，不加水，而富马酸水合虽然确实加水，却发生在循环之外的穿梭里；谷氨酸脱氢酶那一步在基质、在循环之前，ASS 是缩合而非水解。
quiz.explain_en: One water is used by arginase (arginine + H2O giving urea + ornithine) and the other by inorganic pyrophosphatase splitting PPi into two Pi. The chemistry at CPS-1 and OTC is phosphoryl and acyl transfer, not hydrolysis; ASL performs a beta-elimination without water, and although hydrating fumarate does add water it happens in the shunt outside the cycle proper; and glutamate dehydrogenase acts in the matrix before the cycle while ASS condenses rather than hydrolyses.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 CPS-1 使用的一碳底物，下面哪种说法准确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the one-carbon substrate of CPS-1 is accurate?

options.zh: 底物是溶解态的 CO2，全由碳酸酐酶直接供给
options.en: The substrate is dissolved CO2, supplied by anhydrase

options.zh: 底物是氨甲酸，由氨与 CO2 自发结合而来
options.en: The substrate is carbamate, formed from CO2 and NH3

options.zh: 底物是 HCO3-，血中 CO2 主要以它存在
options.en: The substrate is HCO3-, the main form of CO2 in blood

options.zh: 底物是 H2CO3，血中的 CO2 主要以它存在
options.en: The substrate is H2CO3, the main form of CO2 in blood

quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 用的是碳酸氢根，血液中约 90% 的 CO2 就是以 HCO3- 存在的，它也正是被 ATP 磷酸化的对象（生成碳酸磷酸酐）。H2CO3 的浓度只有 HCO3- 的约 1/400，不是主要形式；溶解态 CO2 只占很小一部分，碳酸酐酶的作用恰恰是把它转成 HCO3-；氨甲酸是磷酸化之后由氨进攻形成的中间物，不是投进去的底物。
quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 uses bicarbonate, which is about 90 percent of the CO2 in blood, and it is bicarbonate that the first ATP phosphorylates to carboxyphosphate. Carbonic acid sits at roughly one four-hundredth of the bicarbonate concentration and is not the main form; dissolved CO2 is a small fraction and carbonic anhydrase exists precisely to convert it into bicarbonate; and carbamate is the intermediate formed after the first ATP when ammonia attacks, not a substrate fed in.

title_zh: 尿素这个分子本身：结构、稳定性与它在自然界的去向
title_en: The urea molecule itself: structure, stability and its fate in nature

points.zh: 学生追问尿素是不是自带氨、还是尿素上面又带了两个游离氨；他明确回答画出来的这个分子本身就叫尿素。
points.en: A student asks whether urea carries ammonia or has two free ammonias attached; he answers that the molecule drawn is urea itself.

points.zh: 他确认尿素上面就是带着两个氨基，这就是它一次能带走两个氮的原因。
points.en: He confirms urea carries two amino groups, which is why it takes two nitrogens away at once.

points.zh: 他举日常例子：尿素是化肥。
points.en: He gives the everyday example that urea is a fertiliser.

points.zh: 他说尿素很容易被微生物分解成两分子游离氨和一分子碳酸氢根。
points.en: He says microbes readily break urea down into two ammonia and one bicarbonate.

points.zh: 他据此称尿素是一种比较环保的化肥。
points.en: On that basis he calls urea a relatively environmentally friendly fertiliser.

points.zh: 他说尿素的组成形式很简单，就是一分子二氧化碳加上两分子游离氨形成的一个复合物，并在板书上写下这个记法。
points.en: He describes the composition as simply one carbon dioxide plus two ammonia forming a complex, and writes this down on the board.

points.zh: 他再次强调尿素的溶解性非常好。
points.en: He again stresses that urea is extremely soluble.

points.zh: 他指出尿素在水溶液里比较稳定，只有被微生物摄取到体内以后才会被分解。
points.en: He notes urea is fairly stable in aqueous solution and only breaks down once taken up by microbes.

points.zh: 他用这一段收束前面的论证：结构简单、溶解度高、水溶液里稳定，所以适合作为氮的排泄形式。
points.en: He wraps up the argument: simple structure, high solubility and aqueous stability make urea suitable as the nitrogen excretion form.

extra.zh: 尿素不是 CO2 与 NH3 的「复合物」，它是共价化合物碳酰二胺 CO(NH2)2：一个羰基碳，两侧各连一个 NH2，是一个平面、有共振离域的分子，这正是它稳定的原因。生理上它也不是由 CO2 加两个 NH3 直接拼起来的：碳来自 HCO3-，一个氮由 CPS-1 从游离 NH4+ 装进氨甲酰磷酸，另一个氮由 ASS 从天冬氨酸带来，两个氮的路径完全不同、跨了两个区室。作为记忆口诀可以用，作为机制描述不成立。
extra.en: Urea is not a complex of CO2 and ammonia; it is the covalent compound carbonyl diamide, CO(NH2)2, a planar resonance-delocalised molecule with a carbonyl carbon flanked by two NH2 groups, which is exactly why it is stable. Physiologically it is not assembled from CO2 plus two NH3 either: the carbon comes from bicarbonate, one nitrogen is loaded from free NH4+ into carbamoyl phosphate by CPS-1, and the other is delivered from aspartate by ASS, two entirely different routes across two compartments. It works as a mnemonic but not as a mechanism.

extra.zh: 分解尿素的酶叫脲酶 urease（尿素 + H2O → 2 NH3 + CO2，写成 HCO3- 也可以），是含镍的酶，广泛存在于细菌、真菌和植物，哺乳动物没有它——这正是尿素在人体内不会被拆回氨的原因。临床上这一点有两个落点：幽门螺杆菌靠脲酶产氨中和胃酸，13C/14C 尿素呼气试验就是据此设计的；肠道细菌的脲酶把肠腔尿素分解成氨再吸收入门脉，是肝硬化患者氨负荷的重要来源，乳果糖和利福昔明正是针对这一环。
extra.en: The enzyme that splits urea is urease (urea + H2O giving two NH3 and CO2, or bicarbonate), a nickel enzyme widespread in bacteria, fungi and plants but absent from mammals, which is why urea is never taken back apart inside us. Two clinical consequences follow: Helicobacter pylori uses urease to neutralise stomach acid with ammonia, which is the basis of the carbon-13 or carbon-14 urea breath test, and gut bacterial urease splits luminal urea into ammonia that is reabsorbed into the portal vein, a major ammonia load in cirrhosis, which is precisely what lactulose and rifaximin target.

extra.zh: 尿素分子量 60，一分子带两个氮，含氮量按质量算约 47%，这也是它作为氮肥效率高的原因。在人体内，膳食蛋白和组织蛋白降解产生的氨基酸氮绝大部分以尿素形式排出，其余小部分走铵盐、肌酐、尿酸等；正因为尿素氮占比这么高，血尿素氮（BUN）才被当作肾排泄功能的常规指标——但要注意 BUN 同时受蛋白摄入量和肝合成能力影响，严重肝衰竭时 BUN 反而可以偏低。
extra.en: Urea has a molecular weight of 60 and carries two nitrogens, giving it a nitrogen content near 47 percent by mass, which is why it is such an efficient nitrogen fertiliser. In humans the great majority of amino acid nitrogen from dietary and tissue protein leaves as urea, with smaller amounts as ammonium salts, creatinine and uric acid. Because urea nitrogen dominates, blood urea nitrogen is a routine index of renal excretory function, but it also depends on protein intake and hepatic synthetic capacity, and in severe liver failure it can actually run low.

extra.zh: 尿素 urea 和尿酸 uric acid 是两种完全不同的分子，中文只差一个字，很容易混：尿素 CO(NH2)2 是氨基酸氮的排泄形式，由肝的尿素循环合成，高度可溶；尿酸是嘌呤碱基分解的终产物，是个双环的杂环化合物，人因为缺尿酸氧化酶而停在这一步，溶解度差，堆积会析出尿酸钠结晶引起痛风。后面核苷酸代谢那一章讲的就是尿酸，不要把两条线并成一条。
extra.en: Urea and uric acid are entirely different molecules and are easily confused since their Chinese names differ by one character. Urea, CO(NH2)2, is the excretion form of amino acid nitrogen, made by the hepatic urea cycle, and is highly soluble. Uric acid is the end product of purine base degradation, a bicyclic heterocycle at which humans stop because we lack urate oxidase; it is poorly soluble and precipitates as monosodium urate crystals to cause gout. The nucleotide metabolism section later in this lecture is about uric acid, so keep the two lines apart.

quiz.q_zh: 从化学上说，尿素这个分子的本质是什么？
quiz.q_en: Chemically, what kind of molecule is urea?

options.zh: CO2 与两个 NH3 结合成的一个复合物
options.en: A complex of one CO2 bound to two ammonia molecules

options.zh: 羰基两侧各连一个 NH2 的共价化合物
options.en: A covalent compound, a carbonyl flanked by two NH2

options.zh: 由两个氨甲酰基缩合而成的一个环状二聚体
options.en: A dimer condensed from two separate carbamoyl groups

options.zh: 带正电的铵盐，完全靠离子键维持其结构
options.en: A charged ammonium salt held together by ionic bonds

quiz.explain_zh: 尿素是碳酰二胺 CO(NH2)2，羰基碳两侧各以共价键连一个 NH2，平面、有共振离域，所以中性且稳定。说它是 CO2 和 NH3 的复合物只是记忆口诀，化学上不成立，生理上碳来自 HCO3-、两个氮来自两条不同路径；它不是两个氨甲酰基的二聚体；也不带电，正因为不带电才不干扰酸碱平衡。
quiz.explain_en: Urea is carbonyl diamide, CO(NH2)2, with a carbonyl carbon covalently bonded to two NH2 groups, planar and resonance-delocalised, hence neutral and stable. Calling it a complex of CO2 and ammonia is only a mnemonic and fails chemically, since physiologically the carbon comes from bicarbonate and the two nitrogens arrive by different routes. It is not a dimer of two carbamoyl groups, and it carries no charge, which is exactly why it does not perturb acid-base balance.

quiz.q_zh: 尿素在人体内不会被拆回氨，主要原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why is urea never broken back down into ammonia inside the human body?

options.zh: 尿素在血中浓度太低，达不到 Km
options.en: Blood urea is too dilute to reach the Km of urease

options.zh: 尿素被血浆蛋白结合，无法接触酶
options.en: Urea is bound by plasma proteins and cannot reach it

options.zh: 人体细胞里根本不存在脲酶这种酶
options.en: Human cells simply do not possess the enzyme urease

options.zh: 人体血液的 pH 太低，抑制了脲酶
options.en: Human blood pH is too low and inhibits the urease

quiz.explain_zh: 哺乳动物基因组里没有脲酶，这个含镍的酶只见于细菌、真菌和植物，所以尿素在人体内是终末产物，只被排出。血液 pH 稳定在 7.4 附近，不是抑制因素；血尿素氮浓度在毫摩尔级，一点也不低；尿素是不带电的小分子，自由通过膜也不与血浆蛋白结合。肠道菌的脲酶倒是会把肠腔尿素拆成氨，那是细菌的酶不是人的。
quiz.explain_en: The mammalian genome carries no urease; this nickel enzyme is found only in bacteria, fungi and plants, so urea is a terminal product in humans and is simply excreted. Blood pH is held near 7.4 and inhibits nothing here, blood urea nitrogen sits in the millimolar range and is far from dilute, and urea is a small uncharged molecule that crosses membranes freely and binds no plasma protein. Gut bacterial urease does split luminal urea into ammonia, but that enzyme is the bacterium's, not ours.

title_zh: 尿素循环的调控，以及蛋白质分解代谢一章的收尾
title_en: Regulation of the urea cycle, and closing the protein catabolism chapter

points.zh: 他先做对比：脂质代谢那一章几乎没讲每一步的调控，因为他认为脂质分解基本不存在什么太多调控，四个步骤开始了就顺着进行下来。
points.en: He opens by contrasting with the lipid chapter, where he covered almost no step-level regulation, because he thinks lipid breakdown has little regulation and its four steps just run once started.

points.zh: 尿素循环则有一点调控，重点全在第一步：氨甲酰磷酸的合成。
points.en: The urea cycle does have some regulation, all of it concentrated on the first step, the synthesis of carbamoyl phosphate.

points.zh: 他强调这一步是不可逆的，这是必须记住的一点。
points.en: He stresses that this step is irreversible, and that this must be remembered.

points.zh: 而且这一步是限速步骤，它的合成水平决定整个尿素循环的发生水平。
points.en: It is also the rate-limiting step, and its rate sets the level at which the whole cycle runs.

points.zh: 他预告 CPS-2 会在核苷酸代谢一章讲到，把两个同名酶先区分开。
points.en: He flags that CPS-2 will appear in the nucleotide metabolism chapter, separating the two similarly named enzymes in advance.

points.zh: 除第一步之外他认为就没有什么别的调控了。
points.en: Apart from the first step he considers there to be no further regulation.

points.zh: 他说 CPS-1 受精氨酸调控：精氨酸浓度越高，CPS-1 的活性越高。
points.en: He says CPS-1 is regulated by arginine: the higher the arginine concentration, the higher the activity of CPS-1.

points.zh: 他给出理由：精氨酸是下游第四步的产物，精氨酸积累说明体内已经积累了很多游离氨，需要赶快把精氨酸裂解掉、把循环开起来。
points.en: His reasoning: arginine is the downstream product of step four, so accumulating arginine signals a build-up of free ammonia and a need to split arginine and speed the cycle up.

points.zh: 他收尾：蛋白质降解代谢全章只有两个重点——氨基怎么转移（由谷氨酸、谷氨酰胺、天冬氨酸三种载体带到肝），以及尿素循环；氨基酸的合成一章当年被打了星号属于选修，他建议直接不看。
points.en: He closes the chapter with two key points only: how amino groups are moved (carried by glutamate, glutamine and aspartate) and the urea cycle; the amino acid synthesis chapter was starred as optional and he recommends skipping it.

extra.zh: 「精氨酸高 → CPS-1 活性高」这个方向没错，但中间少了最关键的一环：CPS-1 的变构激活剂是 N-乙酰谷氨酸（NAG），不是精氨酸本身；没有 NAG，CPS-1 几乎完全没有活性。NAG 由 NAG 合成酶（NAGS）用乙酰CoA + 谷氨酸合成，而精氨酸激活的正是 NAGS。所以完整的链条是：高蛋白饮食 → 氨基酸多 → 谷氨酸和精氨酸升高 → 精氨酸激活 NAGS → NAG 增多 → CPS-1 打开 → 尿素循环开大。这一环有临床意义：NAGS 缺陷本身就是一种遗传性高氨血症，可以用 NAG 类似物 carglumic acid（N-氨甲酰谷氨酸）治疗。
extra.en: The direction, more arginine meaning more CPS-1 activity, is right, but the crucial link is missing: the allosteric activator of CPS-1 is N-acetylglutamate (NAG), not arginine itself, and without NAG the enzyme is essentially inactive. NAG is made by NAG synthase (NAGS) from acetyl-CoA and glutamate, and arginine is the activator of NAGS. The full chain is therefore: a high-protein meal raises amino acids, glutamate and arginine rise, arginine activates NAGS, NAG accumulates, CPS-1 switches on and the urea cycle opens up. This matters clinically: NAGS deficiency is itself an inherited hyperammonemia and is treated with the NAG analogue carglumic acid.

extra.zh: 第一步之外还有一层他没讲的调控，而且是量级更大的一层：长期（粗调）调控在转录水平。高蛋白饮食和长期饥饿（后者在分解自身肌肉蛋白）时，尿素循环的五个酶连同 NAGS 一起被上调，酶量可以变化数倍，由胰高血糖素和糖皮质激素驱动；低蛋白饮食时同步下调。所以 NAG 是几分钟量级的「细调」，酶量是几天量级的「粗调」，两层叠加。此外精氨酸酶那一步还与鸟氨酸的去向竞争：鸟氨酸也可以走鸟氨酸脱羧酶做多胺，精氨酸也可以被 NOS 用来产 NO 和瓜氨酸。
extra.en: There is a second layer of regulation he does not mention, and it is the larger one: long-term control at the level of transcription. On a high-protein diet and in prolonged starvation (which breaks down the body's own muscle protein), all five urea cycle enzymes plus NAGS are induced together, with enzyme amounts changing severalfold under glucagon and glucocorticoids, and repressed again on a low-protein diet. So NAG is fine control on a timescale of minutes and enzyme abundance is coarse control on a timescale of days, the two layered together. The arginase step also competes for ornithine, which can go to polyamines via ornithine decarboxylase, while arginine can be used by NOS to make nitric oxide and citrulline.

extra.zh: 「脂质代谢基本不存在什么太多的调控」不成立。脂肪酸氧化的调控点在入口而不在 β-氧化那四步：肉碱穿梭的 CPT-1 被丙二酰CoA 强烈抑制，这正是脂肪合成与脂肪氧化互斥的总开关；脂肪动员端有激素敏感脂肪酶 HSL 和 ATGL，受 cAMP-PKA 磷酸化调控，胰岛素抑制、儿茶酚胺激活。他说的「四个步骤顺着就下来了」只对已经进入 β-氧化之后的循环成立。
extra.en: The claim that lipid metabolism has little regulation does not hold. Control of fatty acid oxidation sits at the entrance rather than within the four beta-oxidation steps: CPT-1 of the carnitine shuttle is strongly inhibited by malonyl-CoA, which is the master switch making fat synthesis and fat oxidation mutually exclusive, while at the mobilisation end hormone-sensitive lipase and ATGL are controlled by cAMP-PKA phosphorylation, inhibited by insulin and activated by catecholamines. His remark that the four steps just run through is true only once beta-oxidation has been entered.

extra.zh: 他说「快速地把这些精氨酸全部裂解」，用词上要区分：催化精氨酸这一步的是精氨酸酶 arginase，做的是水解（水攻击胍基碳），属于水解酶；本循环里叫「裂解酶」的是上一步的 ASL。另外这一段器官仍按肾脏在讲，前面已经指出：五个酶齐备、能被这样调控的是肝细胞，NAG/NAGS 这套开关也是肝细胞里的开关。
extra.en: He says the arginine should all be cleaved quickly, which needs a wording distinction: the enzyme acting on arginine is arginase, which hydrolyses (water attacks the guanidino carbon) and is a hydrolase, while the lyase in this cycle is ASL in the preceding step. This stretch also still frames the organ as the kidney, which as noted earlier is wrong: the cell that carries all five enzymes and is regulated this way is the hepatocyte, and the NAG/NAGS switch is a hepatocyte switch.

quiz.q_zh: 精氨酸是通过什么机制把尿素循环开大的？
quiz.q_en: By what mechanism does arginine turn the urea cycle up?

options.zh: 精氨酸直接结合并变构激活 CPS-1 酶本身
options.en: Arginine binds CPS-1 directly and activates the enzyme

options.zh: 精氨酸激活 NAGS，NAG 激活 CPS-1
options.en: Arginine activates NAGS, and NAG then activates CPS-1

options.zh: 精氨酸反馈抑制精氨酸酶，使底物向前堆积推进
options.en: Arginine inhibits arginase, pushing substrate forwards

options.zh: 精氨酸提高 ASS 的活性，加快胞质那一段
options.en: Arginine raises ASS activity in the cytosolic half

quiz.explain_zh: 精氨酸是 NAG 合成酶（NAGS）的变构激活剂，NAGS 用乙酰CoA + 谷氨酸做出 NAG，而 NAG 才是 CPS-1 的必需变构激活剂——没有 NAG，CPS-1 几乎没有活性。所以精氨酸不直接作用于 CPS-1；它也不抑制精氨酸酶，恰恰相反，精氨酸是精氨酸酶的底物；ASS 虽然是胞质段的限速酶，但不由精氨酸别构激活。
quiz.explain_en: Arginine is the allosteric activator of NAG synthase, which makes NAG from acetyl-CoA and glutamate, and it is NAG that is the obligatory allosteric activator of CPS-1, without which the enzyme is essentially inactive. Arginine therefore does not act on CPS-1 directly. Nor does it inhibit arginase; on the contrary, arginine is the substrate of arginase. And although ASS is rate-limiting for the cytosolic half, it is not allosterically activated by arginine.

quiz.q_zh: 尿素循环的限速步骤是哪一步，由哪个酶催化？
quiz.q_en: Which step limits the rate of the urea cycle, and which enzyme catalyses it?

options.zh: 氨甲酰基转给鸟氨酸这一步，由 OTC 催化
options.en: Transfer of the carbamoyl group onto ornithine by OTC

options.zh: 精氨酸水解生成尿素这一步，由精氨酸酶催化
options.en: Hydrolysis of arginine to urea, catalysed by arginase

options.zh: 瓜氨酸与天冬氨酸的缩合这一步，由 ASS 催化
options.en: Condensation of citrulline with aspartate, done by ASS

options.zh: 氨甲酰磷酸的合成这一步，由 CPS-1 催化
options.en: Synthesis of carbamoyl phosphate, catalysed by CPS-1

quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 催化的氨甲酰磷酸合成既不可逆又是限速步，还是唯一受变构调控（NAG）的一步，它的速率决定整个循环的水平。精氨酸酶那一步只是收尾放出尿素；ASS 是胞质段里最慢的一步、常被称作胞质段的限速酶，但整个循环的总限速点在 CPS-1；OTC 的转酰基反应因为氨甲酰磷酸是高能酸酐而极快、不构成瓶颈。
quiz.explain_en: The carbamoyl phosphate synthesis catalysed by CPS-1 is both irreversible and rate-limiting and is the only allosterically regulated step, through NAG, so its rate sets the level of the whole cycle. The arginase step merely finishes the job by releasing urea; ASS is the slowest enzyme of the cytosolic half and is often called rate-limiting for that half, but the overall control point is CPS-1; and the OTC transfer is very fast because carbamoyl phosphate is a high-energy anhydride, so it is no bottleneck.

quiz.q_zh: 关于脂肪酸氧化的调控，下面哪种说法是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the regulation of fatty acid oxidation is correct?

options.zh: 调控点在入口，CPT-1 被丙二酰CoA 抑制
options.en: Control is at the entrance: malonyl-CoA inhibits CPT-1

options.zh: 调控点在 β-氧化脱氢步，被 NADH 反馈抑制
options.en: Control is at the dehydrogenation step, exerted by NADH

options.zh: 基本上不存在什么调控，四个步骤开始了就顺下来
options.en: There is essentially none: the four steps run straight

options.zh: 调控点在硫解酶，被乙酰CoA 的堆积所抑制
options.en: Control is at thiolase, blocked by acetyl-CoA levels

quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪酸氧化的总开关是肉碱穿梭：CPT-1 被脂肪合成的中间物丙二酰CoA 抑制，从而保证合成与氧化不同时进行；上游的动员端还有 HSL/ATGL 受 cAMP-PKA 调控。β-氧化四步内部虽然受 NADH/乙酰CoA 的产物比例影响，但那是热力学层面的推挤，不是设定通量的调控点；说「基本没有调控」正是老师这里的说法，实际不成立。
quiz.explain_en: The master switch on fatty acid oxidation is the carnitine shuttle: CPT-1 is inhibited by malonyl-CoA, an intermediate of fat synthesis, which keeps synthesis and oxidation from running at once, while upstream mobilisation is controlled through hormone-sensitive lipase and ATGL under cAMP-PKA. Within the four beta-oxidation steps the NADH and acetyl-CoA ratios do exert thermodynamic push-back, but that is not the flux-setting control point, and the claim of essentially no regulation, which is what the teacher says here, does not hold.

title_zh: SAM 与四氢叶酸：两类一碳单位供体
title_en: SAM and tetrahydrofolate: the two one-carbon donors

points.zh: SAM 的左半边是甲硫氨酸 methionine，右半边是腺苷 adenosine（腺嘌呤 + 核糖）；老师特意点明它没带磷酸，所以叫核苷而不是核苷酸，两截接起来就是 SAM。
points.en: The left half of SAM is methionine, the right half is adenosine (adenine + ribose). He stressed it carries no phosphate, so it is a nucleoside, not a nucleotide; the two halves joined give SAM.

points.zh: 连接处的硫原子在图上被他标了一个正号：这个硫带一分子正电荷，是一个三键的锍（sulfonium）中心。
points.en: The sulfur at the junction is marked with a plus sign on his figure: it carries one positive charge and sits as a three-bonded sulfonium centre.

points.zh: 他给的记忆理由：硫一般喜欢形成两个、四个、六个键，不太喜欢形成三个键，所以这种状态不稳定。
points.en: His mnemonic: sulfur likes to form two, four or six bonds and dislikes three, so this state is unstable.

points.zh: 不稳定的直接后果就是硫上那一分子甲基很容易被给出去，SAM 因此是一个活泼的甲基供体。
points.en: The direct consequence of that instability is that the methyl on the sulfur is easily donated, which makes SAM a reactive methyl donor.

points.zh: 他的总结句：SAM 99% 的作用都是提供一碳单位，而这个一碳单位具体指的就是甲基。
points.en: His summary line: 99% of what SAM does is supply a one-carbon unit, and that unit is specifically a methyl group.

points.zh: 举的例子是 DNA、RNA 的甲基化 —— 那个甲基就是 SAM 提供的，被加到核苷酸上去。
points.en: His example is DNA and RNA methylation: that methyl comes from SAM and is transferred onto the nucleotide.

points.zh: 四氢叶酸 THF 是另一个一碳单位供体；他在长长的一串结构上指出一碳单位可以结合在两个位置，并说具体是哪两个位置不需要记。
points.en: Tetrahydrofolate (THF) is the other one-carbon donor. On the long structure he pointed out two positions where the one-carbon unit attaches, and said you do not need to memorise which.

points.zh: 两者的分工：SAM 主要供给 DNA/RNA 的甲基化，THF 主要供给核苷酸的代谢；核苷酸代谢里会不会也用到 SAM，他说不确定，估计用得比较少。
points.en: The division of labour: SAM mainly serves DNA/RNA methylation, THF mainly serves nucleotide metabolism. He was unsure whether SAM is used in nucleotide metabolism at all, guessing it is rare.

extra.zh: SAM 是怎么造出来的、用完变成什么，课上没讲。甲硫氨酸的硫直接进攻 ATP 的 C5'，把整个腺苷抢过来，同时把 ATP 的三个磷酸全切下来（Pi + PPi）—— 这是生化里唯一一个把 ATP 三个磷酸都用掉的反应，由甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶 MAT 催化。给出甲基后 SAM 变成 SAH（S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸），水解成腺苷 + 同型半胱氨酸，同型半胱氨酸再由甲硫氨酸合酶（用 N5-甲基THF 供甲基、维生素 B12 为辅酶）甲基化回甲硫氨酸。这就是甲硫氨酸循环，也是 SAM 与 THF 唯一的交汇口。
extra.en: How SAM is made and what it becomes was not covered. The methionine sulfur attacks C5' of ATP and takes the whole adenosyl group, releasing all three phosphates (Pi + PPi) — the only reaction in biochemistry that consumes all three phosphates of ATP, catalysed by methionine adenosyltransferase (MAT). After donating its methyl, SAM becomes SAH (S-adenosylhomocysteine), which is hydrolysed to adenosine + homocysteine; homocysteine is remethylated to methionine by methionine synthase using N5-methyl-THF with vitamin B12 as cofactor. This methionine cycle is the single point where SAM and THF chemistry meet.

extra.zh: THF 上那两个位置就是 N5 和 N10，而且一碳单位有多个氧化态，决定了它能干什么：N5,N10-亚甲基THF（甲醛级）给 dUMP 甲基化生成 dTMP；N10-甲酰THF（甲酸级）给嘌呤环的 C2 和 C8；N5-甲基THF（甲醇级）只走甲硫氨酸循环。老师说「结合在哪你不需要知道」，但氧化态这一层恰恰是后面嘌呤合成和 dTMP 合成的关键。
extra.en: The two positions on THF are N5 and N10, and the one-carbon unit exists at several oxidation states that determine what it can do: N5,N10-methylene-THF (formaldehyde level) methylates dUMP to dTMP; N10-formyl-THF (formate level) supplies C2 and C8 of the purine ring; N5-methyl-THF (methanol level) feeds only the methionine cycle. He said you need not know where it binds, but this oxidation-state layer is exactly what matters later for purine and dTMP synthesis.

extra.zh: 腺嘌呤 adenine（只是碱基）／腺苷 adenosine（碱基 + 核糖）／腺苷酸 AMP（再加一个磷酸）三个词要分清。老师在这里区分得很好，SAM 里连的确实是腺苷；但一旦说成「SAM = 腺嘌呤 + 甲硫氨酸」就漏掉了核糖，结构就说不通了 —— S-adenosyl 里的 adenosyl 指的是腺苷基。
extra.en: Keep adenine (base only), adenosine (base + ribose) and AMP (plus one phosphate) apart. He drew this distinction correctly here — SAM really does contain adenosine. Saying instead that SAM is adenine plus methionine drops the ribose and the structure no longer works: the adenosyl in S-adenosyl means the adenosine group.

extra.zh: 「SAM 99% 的作用是提供甲基」作为口诀可以，但严格说 SAM 还有两条非甲基化的去向：提供氨丙基（脱羧后参与亚精胺、精胺等多胺的合成），以及在自由基 SAM 酶里裂解出 5'-脱氧腺苷自由基去启动难做的重排反应。考试按甲基供体记没问题，知道有例外即可。
extra.en: The line that 99% of SAM's job is methyl donation works as a mnemonic, but SAM has two non-methylation fates: after decarboxylation it donates an aminopropyl group for polyamine synthesis (spermidine, spermine), and in radical SAM enzymes it is cleaved to a 5'-deoxyadenosyl radical that initiates difficult rearrangements. Remembering it as the methyl donor is fine as long as you know the exceptions exist.

quiz.q_zh: SAM 上的甲基之所以特别容易被转移出去，老师给的结构上的理由是什么？
quiz.q_en: What structural reason did the teacher give for the methyl on SAM being so easily transferred?

options.zh: 核糖 2' 位羟基对甲基发生分子内亲核进攻
options.en: The ribose 2' hydroxyl attacks the methyl group intramolecularly

options.zh: 硫带正电荷、处于不稳定的三键锍状态
options.en: The sulfur is positively charged in an unstable sulfonium state

options.zh: 腺嘌呤环的共轭体系把 C–S 键显著拉长
options.en: Conjugation in the adenine ring markedly lengthens the C–S bond

options.zh: 甲硫氨酸的羧基把电子密度推向甲基一侧
options.en: The methionine carboxyl pushes electron density toward the methyl

quiz.explain_zh: 硫在 SAM 里同时连着甲基、甲硫氨酸的碳链和腺苷的 C5'，形成三个键并带一分子正电荷，是不稳定的锍中心，所以甲基是很好的离去基团。羧基推电子、2' 羟基进攻、腺嘌呤共轭拉长 C–S 键这三种说法都不是 SAM 活化甲基的机制，SAM 的活性完全来自那个正电荷硫。
quiz.explain_en: In SAM the sulfur bonds to the methyl, to the methionine chain and to C5' of adenosine at once, giving a positively charged, unstable sulfonium centre, so the methyl is an excellent leaving group. Electron donation from the carboxyl, intramolecular attack by the 2' hydroxyl, and conjugation lengthening the C–S bond are all not how SAM activates its methyl; the reactivity comes entirely from the charged sulfur.

quiz.q_zh: 按老师课上的说法，SAM 和四氢叶酸各自主要供给哪个场景？
quiz.q_en: According to the lecture, which processes do SAM and THF each mainly serve?

options.zh: SAM 供核苷酸代谢，THF 供磷脂的甲基化
options.en: SAM serves nucleotide metabolism, THF methylates phospholipids

options.zh: SAM 只提供甲基，THF 只负责提供游离氨基
options.en: SAM supplies only methyls, THF supplies only free amino groups

options.zh: THF 负责给甲基化供能，SAM 只负责运输一碳单位
options.en: THF energises methylation, SAM only ferries the carbon unit

options.zh: SAM 供 DNA 甲基化，THF 供核苷酸代谢
options.en: SAM serves DNA methylation, THF serves nucleotide metabolism

quiz.explain_zh: 老师明确说这两个都是一碳单位供体，只是场景不同：SAM 那边主要是 DNA、RNA 的甲基化，THF 这边主要是核苷酸的代谢。把两者的场景对调是错的；THF 提供的是一碳单位而不是氨基，它的一碳单位有甲基、亚甲基、甲酰等多种氧化态；一碳单位转移也不靠 THF 供能，两者都是基团供体而不是能量货币。
quiz.explain_en: He said plainly that both are one-carbon donors serving different arenas: SAM mostly DNA and RNA methylation, THF mostly nucleotide metabolism. Swapping the two arenas is wrong; THF carries one-carbon units, not amino groups, and at several oxidation states (methyl, methylene, formyl); and neither donor energises the transfer, both are group donors rather than energy currency.

title_zh: 叶酸、磺胺类药物，与核苷酸代谢章的开场
title_en: Folate, the sulfonamides, and the opening of the nucleotide chapter

points.zh: 核苷酸代谢里的一碳单位主要由四氢叶酸提供；他再次说不确定这里会不会用到 SAM，估计用得比较少。
points.en: The one-carbon units in nucleotide metabolism come mainly from THF; he again said he was not sure whether SAM is used here and guessed it is rare.

points.zh: 他由此解释为什么孕妇推荐补充「四氢叶酸」：它有助于 DNA 的快速复制、有助于碱基的快速合成。
points.en: From this he explained why pregnant women are told to take supplementary 'tetrahydrofolate': it supports rapid DNA replication and rapid base synthesis.

points.zh: 接着引出比较早期发现的一类药物 —— 磺胺 sulfonamide，他称之为广谱抗菌药，并说「可以算是」抗生素，现在用得比较少了。
points.en: He then introduced a drug class discovered relatively early — the sulfonamides — calling them broad-spectrum antibacterials that 'more or less count as' antibiotics, less used nowadays.

points.zh: 他讲的机制第一句：磺胺是一种模拟四氢叶酸的物质，可以顶替四氢叶酸去发挥作用。
points.en: His mechanism, first claim: a sulfonamide mimics tetrahydrofolate and can act in its place.

points.zh: 他讲的机制第二句：四氢叶酸能接受甲基、能提供一碳单位，而磺胺不能接受甲基。
points.en: His mechanism, second claim: THF can accept a methyl and donate a one-carbon unit, whereas a sulfonamide cannot accept a methyl.

points.zh: 他讲的机制第三句：磺胺因此掺入到细菌的 DNA 合成里边，又不给细菌提供一碳单位，细菌的合成就中断了。
points.en: His mechanism, third claim: the sulfonamide is therefore built into bacterial DNA synthesis but supplies no one-carbon unit, so bacterial synthesis is interrupted.

points.zh: 他给这一段定的分量是「稍微了解一下就 OK」，重点只要求记住四氢叶酸和 SAM 这两个一碳单位供体及其不同场景。
points.en: He rated this passage as 'just be aware of it', with the real requirement being only the two one-carbon donors, THF and SAM, and their different arenas.

points.zh: 随后正式进入核苷酸代谢这一章，他反复提醒这一章最折磨人、太复杂太烧脑，会给几句总结的话，要求学生一定记下来。
points.en: He then formally opened the nucleotide metabolism chapter, warning repeatedly that it is the most punishing and brain-melting one, and that the summary sentences he gives must be written down.

extra.zh: 磺胺的机制他整个讲反了，这是本段最要紧的一处，到本段结束也没有更正。磺胺是对氨基苯甲酸 PABA（para-aminobenzoic acid）的结构类似物，不是四氢叶酸的类似物。它竞争性抑制细菌的二氢蝶酸合酶 dihydropteroate synthase (DHPS)，让细菌不能把 PABA 装到蝶啶骨架上，于是二氢叶酸→四氢叶酸的从头合成被掐断，一碳单位供应中断，嘌呤和 dTMP 的合成停摆。它不模拟 THF，不参与甲基转移，更不会掺进 DNA 里去。
extra.en: His account of the sulfonamide mechanism is inverted — the most serious error in this stretch, and he never corrects it. Sulfonamides are structural analogues of PABA (para-aminobenzoic acid), not of tetrahydrofolate. They competitively inhibit bacterial dihydropteroate synthase (DHPS), so the bacterium cannot couple PABA to the pteridine skeleton, de novo synthesis of dihydro- and then tetrahydrofolate is cut off, the one-carbon supply fails, and purine and dTMP synthesis stall. They do not mimic THF, take no part in methyl transfer, and are never incorporated into DNA.

extra.zh: 选择性毒性到底从哪来 —— 这才是磺胺值得讲的地方。人根本没有这条通路：人不能合成叶酸，只能从饮食里摄取现成的叶酸，所以 DHPS 这个靶点在人身上压根不存在，药才安全。反过来大多数细菌缺少叶酸转运体，不能从环境里捡现成的叶酸，只能自己造，于是这条路成了可打击的软肋。临床上常与甲氧苄啶 trimethoprim 合用（复方新诺明 SMZ-TMP）：TMP 抑制细菌的二氢叶酸还原酶 DHFR，两个药在同一条通路上前后两步序贯阻断，产生协同。
extra.en: Where the selectivity comes from is the point worth making. Humans do not have this pathway at all: we cannot synthesise folate and must take it preformed from the diet, so the DHPS target simply does not exist in us, which is why the drug is safe. Conversely most bacteria lack folate transporters and cannot scavenge preformed folate, so they must build it, making this pathway a vulnerable point. Clinically sulfamethoxazole is combined with trimethoprim (co-trimoxazole): TMP inhibits bacterial dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), giving sequential blockade of two consecutive steps in the same pathway and synergy.

extra.zh: 真正「直接干扰核苷酸合成」的是抗代谢物，和磺胺不是一回事，老师把这两套逻辑揉在一起了。甲氨蝶呤 methotrexate 是叶酸类似物，抑制人自己的 DHFR，把 THF 池抽干；5-氟尿嘧啶 5-FU 的代谢物 FdUMP 与 N5,N10-亚甲基THF 一起把胸苷酸合酶锁死。这两类药靶的是人（或肿瘤细胞）自己的酶，所以毒性大；磺胺靶的是人根本没有的细菌酶，所以毒性小。这个对比正好说明为什么「掺进 DNA」的说法必须归到抗代谢物那一边，而不是磺胺。
extra.en: The drugs that really do interfere with nucleotide synthesis directly are the antimetabolites, a different story that he ran together with this one. Methotrexate is a folate analogue that inhibits our own DHFR and drains the THF pool; the 5-fluorouracil metabolite FdUMP, together with N5,N10-methylene-THF, locks thymidylate synthase shut. Both target enzymes we ourselves possess, hence their toxicity; sulfonamides target a bacterial enzyme we lack, hence their safety. The contrast shows why any talk of being 'built into DNA' belongs on the antimetabolite side, not here.

extra.zh: 两个小修正。第一，孕期补充的是叶酸 folic acid（人工合成的氧化型），进体内要由二氢叶酸还原酶 DHFR 两步还原成四氢叶酸才起作用，说「补四氢叶酸」不准确；它防的是神经管缺陷。第二，磺胺是人工合成的抗菌药（百浪多息的活性代谢物），不是微生物产生的抗生素 —— 老师自己用「可以算是」打了折扣，说明他也觉得这个词不稳。
extra.en: Two small corrections. First, what is supplemented in pregnancy is folic acid, the synthetic oxidised form, which must be reduced in two steps by dihydrofolate reductase to tetrahydrofolate before it works; saying 'take THF' is inaccurate. Its purpose is preventing neural tube defects. Second, sulfonamides are synthetic antibacterials (the active metabolite of prontosil), not microbially produced antibiotics — he hedged with 'more or less count as', showing he was uneasy about the word too.

quiz.q_zh: 磺胺类药物真正的分子靶点和作用方式是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the real molecular target and mode of action of the sulfonamides?

options.zh: 作为 PABA 类似物竞争性抑制二氢蝶酸合酶
options.en: As PABA analogues, competitively inhibit dihydropteroate synthase

options.zh: 抑制细菌二氢叶酸还原酶，使 DHF 不能还原
options.en: Inhibit bacterial dihydrofolate reductase so DHF is not reduced

options.zh: 抑制胸苷酸合酶，使 dUMP 不能甲基化成 dTMP
options.en: Inhibit thymidylate synthase so dUMP is not methylated to dTMP

options.zh: 模拟四氢叶酸掺入细菌 DNA，使复制链提前终止
options.en: Mimic THF and enter bacterial DNA, terminating replication early

quiz.explain_zh: 磺胺与 PABA 结构相似，占住二氢蝶酸合酶的 PABA 结合位点，细菌造不出二氢叶酸。掺入 DNA 是老师讲错的那句，磺胺从不进核酸链；抑制二氢叶酸还原酶的是甲氧苄啶（人的对应药是甲氨蝶呤）；抑制胸苷酸合酶的是 5-氟尿嘧啶的代谢物 FdUMP。后三条各自都真实存在，只是属于别的药。
quiz.explain_en: Sulfonamides resemble PABA and occupy the PABA site of dihydropteroate synthase, so the bacterium cannot make dihydrofolate. Incorporation into DNA is the teacher's erroneous claim; sulfonamides never enter nucleic acid. Inhibiting dihydrofolate reductase is trimethoprim (methotrexate in humans), and inhibiting thymidylate synthase is FdUMP from 5-fluorouracil. Each wrong option is a real mechanism, just of a different drug.

quiz.q_zh: 磺胺对人几乎没有相应毒性，最根本的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the fundamental reason sulfonamides are largely non-toxic to humans?

options.zh: 人的肝脏能把磺胺迅速乙酰化并完全排出体外
options.en: The human liver rapidly acetylates sulfonamides and clears them

options.zh: 人的二氢蝶酸合酶与细菌的结构差别足够大
options.en: Human dihydropteroate synthase differs enough from the bacterial one

options.zh: 人的细胞膜缺少把磺胺转运进胞内的载体蛋白
options.en: Human cell membranes lack any carrier that imports sulfonamides

options.zh: 人不能合成叶酸、只从饮食摄取，没有这个靶酶
options.en: Humans cannot make folate, take it from diet, and lack the target

quiz.explain_zh: 人体内根本不存在叶酸的从头合成通路，二氢蝶酸合酶这个酶我们没有，所以药物无从下手，叶酸靠饮食摄取现成的。说人的同源酶结构不同是错的 —— 我们没有这个酶，不是有一个不一样的；乙酰化确实是磺胺的代谢方式之一，但那是清除快慢的问题，不解释靶点缺失；磺胺进不进细胞也不是选择性的来源。
quiz.explain_en: Humans have no de novo folate pathway at all — we do not possess dihydropteroate synthase, so there is nothing for the drug to hit, and folate comes preformed from the diet. Saying our homologue differs is wrong: we do not have a different version, we have none. Acetylation is indeed one route of sulfonamide metabolism, but that concerns clearance rate, not absence of a target, and cellular uptake is not the source of selectivity either.

quiz.q_zh: 关于孕期的叶酸补充，下面哪种说法是准确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about folate supplementation in pregnancy is accurate?

options.zh: 补的是叶酸，需 DHFR 还原成四氢叶酸才起效
options.en: Folic acid is supplemented; DHFR must first reduce it to THF

options.zh: 补的是叶酸，主要作用是提供 SAM 甲基化所需甲基
options.en: Folic acid is supplemented, mainly to supply methyls for SAM

options.zh: 补的是四氢叶酸，它可以直接被甲基转移酶利用
options.en: THF is supplemented and used directly by methyltransferases

options.zh: 补的是叶酸，要靠肠菌转化后才被母体吸收利用
options.en: Folic acid is supplemented and made usable by gut bacteria first

quiz.explain_zh: 药片里是氧化型的合成叶酸 folic acid，必须经二氢叶酸还原酶 DHFR 先还原成二氢叶酸、再还原成四氢叶酸才具有携带一碳单位的活性，目的是预防神经管缺陷。直接补四氢叶酸不是常规做法（老师这句不准确）；人体自己的酶就能还原，不依赖肠菌；补叶酸的主要意义在于嘌呤和 dTMP 的合成，供 SAM 甲基只是甲硫氨酸循环那一支。
quiz.explain_en: The tablet contains synthetic oxidised folic acid, which must be reduced by dihydrofolate reductase first to dihydrofolate and then to tetrahydrofolate before it can carry one-carbon units; the aim is preventing neural tube defects. Supplementing THF directly is not standard practice, which is where the teacher was inaccurate. Our own enzyme does the reduction without gut bacteria, and the main point is purine and dTMP synthesis, with the methionine cycle feeding SAM only as one branch.

title_zh: 核苷酸的结构与功能：NTP 供能、UTP 的特例、cAMP
title_en: Nucleotide structure and function: NTP energetics, the UTP exception, cAMP

points.zh: 复习一个核苷酸长什么样：三个磷酸 + 一个核糖（五元环）+ 一个 base 碱基，写成 NTP，N 代表 ATCG 任意一种，T 代表三个磷酸。
points.en: A refresher on what a nucleotide looks like: three phosphates + a ribose (five-membered ring) + a base, written NTP, where N is any of A/T/C/G and T means three phosphates.

points.zh: 他要求整章都在脑子里保留这张图，因为后面讲的全是它在不同位置上的断裂。
points.en: He asked the class to keep this picture in mind through the whole chapter, because everything that follows is about cleaving it at different positions.

points.zh: 他在图上一个一个点过去：这里可以断、这里也可以断，一共数出四种断裂方式，对应后面不同的降解步骤。
points.en: He pointed along the structure one bond at a time — this can break, and this — counting four ways it can be cut, corresponding to the later degradation steps.

points.zh: 核苷酸的功能，第一层是在三磷酸水平上的能量利用，主力是 ATP 和 GTP。
points.en: The first function of nucleotides is energy use at the triphosphate level, chiefly ATP and GTP.

points.zh: CTP 供能极少极少，UTP 供能就更少了。
points.en: CTP contributes to energy transfer only very rarely, and UTP even less.

points.zh: 他当场提问 UTP 供能出现在哪里，答案是糖原的合成 —— 这属于特例，他要求专门记一下。
points.en: He quizzed the class on where UTP is used for energy: glycogen synthesis. He flagged this as an exception worth memorising specifically.

points.zh: 单磷酸水平上他举了 cAMP，出现在乳糖操纵子 lac operon 的调控里；C 代表 cyclic 环状。
points.en: At the monophosphate level he gave cAMP, appearing in lac operon regulation; the C stands for cyclic.

points.zh: 环核苷酸的结构：普通核苷酸的磷酸接在 5' 端，而环核苷酸是 3' 端和 5' 端被同一个磷酸桥接起来成环。
points.en: The structure of a cyclic nucleotide: in an ordinary nucleotide the phosphate sits at the 5' end, whereas here one phosphate bridges the 3' and 5' positions into a ring.

points.zh: 他随即说明这一章只讨论经典核苷酸的代谢，环核苷酸不再展开。
points.en: He then said the chapter deals only with classical nucleotide metabolism and would not pursue cyclic nucleotides further.

extra.zh: 四种 NTP 的分工其实很规整，值得当口诀记：ATP 是通用能量货币；GTP 供蛋白质合成的延伸/起始因子、G 蛋白信号转导，也供尿素循环第三步和糖异生的 PEPCK；UTP 走糖基化和糖原（UDP-葡萄糖、UDP-半乳糖）；CTP 走脂类（CDP-胆碱、CDP-二酰甘油合成磷脂）。老师说 CTP「极少供能」，更准的说法是 CTP 的活化对象是脂类而不是糖。
extra.en: The division of labour among the four NTPs is tidy enough to memorise: ATP is the general currency; GTP powers translation factors and G-protein signalling, plus step three of the urea cycle and PEPCK in gluconeogenesis; UTP handles glycosylation and glycogen (UDP-glucose, UDP-galactose); CTP handles lipids (CDP-choline, CDP-diacylglycerol for phospholipids). Rather than saying CTP rarely provides energy, it is more accurate to say CTP activates lipids rather than sugars.

extra.zh: cAMP 的来龙去脉：由腺苷酸环化酶 adenylate cyclase 从 ATP 生成 3',5'-环 AMP，同时放出 PPi；由磷酸二酯酶 PDE 水解开环成 5'-AMP 来终止信号 —— 咖啡因、茶碱抑制 PDE 从而延长 cAMP 信号就是这个道理。在乳糖操纵子里，葡萄糖缺乏时 cAMP 升高，与 CRP/CAP 结合后激活转录，这就是分解代谢物阻遏（catabolite repression）的开关，与阻遏蛋白 LacI 那一层是两套独立的调控。
extra.en: Where cAMP comes from and goes: adenylate cyclase makes 3',5'-cyclic AMP from ATP, releasing PPi; phosphodiesterase hydrolyses the ring to 5'-AMP to end the signal — which is why caffeine and theophylline, as PDE inhibitors, prolong cAMP signalling. In the lac operon, cAMP rises when glucose is scarce and, bound to CRP/CAP, activates transcription: this is the catabolite repression switch, a layer independent of the LacI repressor.

extra.zh: 他数出的「四种断裂方式」其实各有归属，先记住有助于听后面的降解：磷酸之间的磷酸酐键（激酶、焦磷酸酶）；核糖 5' 位上的磷酸酯键（核苷酸酶／磷酸单酯酶）；链上连接两个核糖的磷酸二酯键（核酸酶／磷酸二酯酶）；碱基与核糖之间的 N-糖苷键（核苷酶／核苷磷酸化酶）。后面讲的消化三部曲用的正是后三种，顺序是二酯键 → 5' 酯键 → 糖苷键。
extra.en: The four cleavable bonds he counted each have an owner, and knowing them in advance makes the degradation section easier: the phosphoanhydride bonds between phosphates (kinases, pyrophosphatases); the phosphomonoester bond at ribose 5' (nucleotidase); the phosphodiester bond linking two riboses along the chain (nucleases, phosphodiesterases); and the N-glycosidic bond between base and ribose (nucleosidase, nucleoside phosphorylase). The digestion sequence that follows uses the last three, in the order diester, 5'-ester, glycosidic.

extra.zh: 核苷 nucleoside = 碱基 + 核糖；核苷酸 nucleotide = 核苷 + 磷酸。老师在约 01:00:40 明确讲了这条区分，可以往前套到这里。另外整段里他把黑板上的 NA 读成 nucleotide，实际 NA = nucleic acid 核酸，是聚合物，nucleotide 是它的单体，名词层级差了一级，听的时候把「一条 nucleotide 长链」理解成核酸链即可。
extra.en: Nucleoside = base + ribose; nucleotide = nucleoside + phosphate. He states this distinction clearly around 01:00:40 and it applies retroactively here. Also, throughout he reads the NA on the board as nucleotide, whereas NA means nucleic acid, the polymer, and nucleotide is its monomer — one level off. Read his 'long nucleotide chain' as a nucleic acid chain.

quiz.q_zh: 老师要求当作特例记住的 UTP 供能，具体出现在哪个反应？
quiz.q_en: The UTP energy contribution he flagged as an exception appears in which reaction?

options.zh: 蛋白质合成中肽链延伸反应的那一个步骤
options.en: The elongation step of the peptide chain in translation

options.zh: 糖原合成中 UDP-葡萄糖的生成那一步
options.en: The formation of UDP-glucose in glycogen synthesis

options.zh: 脂肪酸被活化生成脂酰CoA 的那一步
options.en: The activation of a fatty acid to its acyl-CoA form

options.zh: 磷脂合成中 CDP-胆碱这个中间物的生成
options.en: The formation of CDP-choline in phospholipid synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: UDP-葡萄糖焦磷酸化酶用 UTP 活化 1-磷酸葡萄糖生成 UDP-葡萄糖，这是糖原合成的供糖形式，也是 UTP 在能量代谢里少见的登场。脂肪酸活化用的是 ATP（生成 AMP + PPi）；CDP-胆碱用的是 CTP；肽链延伸靠 GTP。这三个各自都对，只是主角不是 UTP。
quiz.explain_en: UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase uses UTP to activate glucose-1-phosphate to UDP-glucose, the sugar donor for glycogen synthesis and the rare appearance of UTP in energy metabolism. Fatty acid activation uses ATP (yielding AMP + PPi), CDP-choline uses CTP, and peptide elongation uses GTP. All three are real, but none of them stars UTP.

quiz.q_zh: cAMP 与普通 AMP 在结构上的差别是什么？
quiz.q_en: How does cAMP differ structurally from ordinary AMP?

options.zh: 两分子 AMP 的磷酸相连形成一个大环结构
options.en: The phosphates of two AMP molecules join into one large ring

options.zh: 腺嘌呤环的 N1 与磷酸之间形成分子内成环
options.en: An intramolecular ring forms between adenine N1 and phosphate

options.zh: 碱基与核糖之间多形成了一个分子内的酰胺键
options.en: An extra cyclic amide bond forms between the base and ribose

options.zh: 同一个磷酸接在核糖的 3' 和 5' 位成环
options.en: One phosphate bridges the ribose 3' and 5' positions as a ring

quiz.explain_zh: 环 AMP 就是同一个磷酸基团同时酯化核糖的 3'-OH 和 5'-OH，形成一个分子内的六元磷酸二酯环，老师在黑板上画的正是这个。碱基和核糖之间是 N-糖苷键，不是酰胺环；两分子 AMP 相连是二腺苷酸类的另一回事；腺嘌呤 N1 不参与成环，它参与的是碱基配对。
quiz.explain_en: Cyclic AMP is one phosphate esterifying both the 3'-OH and the 5'-OH of the same ribose, forming an intramolecular phosphodiester ring, exactly what he drew. Base and ribose are joined by an N-glycosidic bond, not an amide ring; linking two AMP molecules is a different class of dinucleotide; and adenine N1 takes part in base pairing, not in ring closure.

title_zh: 核酸的消化：核蛋白变性到磷酸、戊糖、碱基三分家
title_en: Digestion of nucleic acid: from nucleoprotein to phosphate, pentose and base

points.zh: 讲一段 DNA 或 RNA 的降解，第一步不是切链，而是先把核酸从核蛋白上拆下来。
points.en: For degradation of a stretch of DNA or RNA, the first step is not cutting the chain but stripping the nucleic acid off the nucleoprotein.

points.zh: 核蛋白表面带很多正电荷，可以非特异或特异地结合 DNA、RNA 长链，起保护作用。
points.en: Nucleoproteins carry abundant positive surface charge and bind long DNA or RNA chains, specifically or non-specifically, protecting them.

points.zh: 胃酸把核蛋白全部变性，变性后的核蛋白结合不住核酸，游离的核酸链就被释放出来。
points.en: Gastric acid denatures the nucleoprotein completely; once denatured it can no longer hold the nucleic acid, which is released free.

points.zh: 他强调此刻核酸还是完整的一条长链，接下来的降解才逐步把它拆开。
points.en: He stressed that at this moment the nucleic acid is still one intact long chain, and the stepwise degradation follows.

points.zh: 第一步降解由磷酸二酯酶催化，在磷酸二酯键的位置把长链切开，产物是单核苷酸。
points.en: The first degradative step is catalysed by phosphodiesterase, cutting at the phosphodiester bonds and yielding mononucleotides.

points.zh: 他在黑板上画出链的排布：磷酸—核糖—碱基，再磷酸—核糖—碱基，切的就是连接相邻核糖的那个磷酸。
points.en: He drew the chain layout on the board — phosphate, ribose, base, then phosphate, ribose, base — and the cut falls on the phosphate joining adjacent riboses.

points.zh: 第二步：单核苷酸被磷酸单酯酶切开，产物是核苷加磷酸。
points.en: Second step: the mononucleotide is cut by a phosphomonoesterase, giving a nucleoside plus phosphate.

points.zh: 第三步：核苷被核苷酶切开，产物是戊糖加碱基；他自己说这一串比较绕。
points.en: Third step: the nucleoside is cut by a nucleosidase into pentose plus base — he admitted the sequence is convoluted.

points.zh: 整条路走完，一条核酸链被拆成磷酸、戊糖、碱基三部分，这就是核酸在体内降解的概述。
points.en: Once through, a nucleic acid chain has been taken apart into phosphate, pentose and base — his overview of nucleic acid degradation in the body.

extra.zh: 部位和酶的来源他都没交代。胃酸让核蛋白变性、把核酸释放出来是对的，但核酸链本身的降解主要发生在小肠，由胰腺分泌的核酸酶（胰 DNase、胰 RNase，都属于磷酸二酯酶类）催化，把长链切成寡核苷酸再到单核苷酸；随后由小肠黏膜刷状缘的核苷酸酶脱磷酸、核苷酶或核苷磷酸化酶断糖苷键。胃里做的只是「解包装」这一步。
extra.en: He gave neither the location nor the source of the enzymes. Gastric acid does denature nucleoprotein and free the nucleic acid, but degradation of the chain itself happens mainly in the small intestine, catalysed by pancreatic nucleases (pancreatic DNase and RNase, both phosphodiesterases) that cut the chain to oligonucleotides and then mononucleotides; brush-border nucleotidases then remove phosphate and nucleosidases or nucleoside phosphorylase break the glycosidic bond. The stomach only does the unpackaging.

extra.zh: 「磷酸二酯酶」在这里其实是核酸酶 nuclease 的统称，还要再分：内切酶 endonuclease 从链内部切，外切酶 exonuclease 从末端一个一个啃。胰 RNase 和胰 DNase 是内切酶，所以先出寡核苷酸，再由外切酶补完成单核苷酸。另外「磷酸单酯酶」作用在核苷酸上时的正式名字是核苷酸酶 nucleotidase（细胞内主要是 5'-核苷酸酶），老师自己在约 01:03:19 也用了这个名字。
extra.en: 'Phosphodiesterase' here is a blanket term for nucleases, which subdivide further: endonucleases cut within the chain, exonucleases nibble from the ends. Pancreatic RNase and DNase are endonucleases, so oligonucleotides appear first and exonucleases finish the job to mononucleotides. And the phosphomonoesterase acting on a nucleotide is properly a nucleotidase (intracellularly mostly 5'-nucleotidase), a name he himself uses around 01:03:19.

extra.zh: 膳食核酸对人体几乎不提供嘌呤嘧啶原料 —— 这一点课上没说，但它是理解整章的关键。吸收进来的碱基绝大部分在肠黏膜就地降解（嘌呤直接走到尿酸）排掉，细胞里的核苷酸靠自身的从头合成和补救途径供应。所以高嘌呤饮食的实际后果是抬高血尿酸，而不是「补 DNA」，这也预告了后面痛风那一段的逻辑。
extra.en: Dietary nucleic acid supplies almost none of the body's purines and pyrimidines — not mentioned in class, but key to the whole chapter. Most absorbed bases are degraded on the spot in the intestinal mucosa (purines straight through to uric acid) and excreted; cellular nucleotides come from de novo and salvage synthesis. So a high-purine diet raises serum urate rather than 'topping up DNA', which sets up the gout discussion later.

extra.zh: 黑板上的缩写 NA 他读成 nucleotide，应为 nucleic acid 核酸。核酸是聚合物，nucleotide 是它的单体，两者差一个层级。他整段用 nucleotide 指代整条核酸链，听讲时自行降一级理解即可，但答题时别把「核酸的消化」写成「核苷酸的消化」。
extra.en: He reads the board abbreviation NA as nucleotide; it stands for nucleic acid. Nucleic acid is the polymer and nucleotide its monomer, one level apart. He uses nucleotide for the whole chain throughout, so mentally shift one level while listening — but do not write 'digestion of nucleotides' when the topic is digestion of nucleic acid.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸二酯酶在核酸链上切的是哪个键？
quiz.q_en: Which bond does phosphodiesterase cleave in a nucleic acid chain?

options.zh: 三磷酸链上相邻两个磷酸之间的磷酸酐键
options.en: The phosphoanhydride bond between phosphates of a triphosphate

options.zh: 连接相邻两个核糖的 3',5'-磷酸二酯键
options.en: The 3',5'-phosphodiester bond joining two adjacent riboses

options.zh: 连接碱基与核糖 C1' 的 N-糖苷键
options.en: The N-glycosidic bond joining the base to the ribose C1'

options.zh: 核糖 5' 羟基与磷酸间的磷酸单酯键
options.en: The phosphomonoester bond between ribose 5'-OH and phosphate

quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸二酯键就是一个磷酸同时酯化上游核糖的 3'-OH 和下游核糖的 5'-OH，把链连起来，切开它长链才变成单核苷酸。N-糖苷键是后面核苷酶或核苷磷酸化酶干的活；5' 磷酸单酯键由核苷酸酶脱掉；磷酸酐键属于 NTP 上的高能键，与链的骨架无关。
quiz.explain_en: A phosphodiester bond is one phosphate esterifying the 3'-OH of the upstream ribose and the 5'-OH of the downstream one, holding the chain together; cutting it turns the polymer into mononucleotides. The N-glycosidic bond is later handled by nucleosidase or nucleoside phosphorylase, the 5'-phosphomonoester by nucleotidase, and phosphoanhydride bonds belong to the NTP tail, not the backbone.

quiz.q_zh: 按老师讲的顺序，胃酸在核酸消化中起的作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the sequence he taught, what does gastric acid do in nucleic acid digestion?

options.zh: 直接水解磷酸二酯键把长链打断成单核苷酸
options.en: It hydrolyses phosphodiester bonds into mononucleotides directly

options.zh: 把碱基上的氨基脱掉便于后续的氧化降解
options.en: It removes amino groups from bases to ease later oxidation

options.zh: 使核蛋白变性、放开它结合的核酸长链
options.en: It denatures nucleoprotein and releases the bound nucleic acid

options.zh: 激活胰核酸酶原并把它送进小肠腔内
options.en: It activates pancreatic pronucleases and sends them to the gut

quiz.explain_zh: 核蛋白靠正电荷抱住核酸，胃酸把蛋白变性后这层保护就散了，核酸以完整长链的形式游离出来 —— 老师特别强调此时链还是完整的。酸本身不切磷酸二酯键，那是磷酸二酯酶的活；脱氨发生在后面碱基降解阶段；胰酶的激活是胰蛋白酶原那一套，与核酸酶的释放不是一回事。
quiz.explain_en: Nucleoprotein grips nucleic acid by positive charge; once acid denatures the protein that protection falls away and the nucleic acid comes free as an intact chain — he made a point of the chain still being whole here. Acid itself does not cut phosphodiester bonds, that is the phosphodiesterase's job; deamination belongs to the later base degradation stage; and zymogen activation is the trypsinogen story, not how nucleases are released.

title_zh: 两步还是三步、植物微生物的另一条路，与为什么只关心碱基
title_en: Two steps or three, the plant and microbial route, and why only the base matters

points.zh: 他复述流程时把磷酸二酯酶的产物叫成「一个一个的这种碱基」，接着说这些还要再经过三步降解。
points.en: Recapping, he called the products of phosphodiesterase 'these bases, one by one', and said they still had three more degradation steps to go.

points.zh: 他随即自己数了一遍：第一步磷酸单酯酶把磷酸切掉，第二步核苷酶把碱基切掉，于是改口「一共是经过两步」。
points.en: He then counted through it himself — first the phosphomonoesterase removes phosphate, second the nucleosidase removes the base — and corrected himself to 'two steps in all'.

points.zh: 两步走完，三个组分就被均匀地、完全地分开了，这就是核酸在体内降解的全过程。
points.en: After those two steps the three components are evenly and completely separated, which is the whole in vivo degradation of nucleic acid.

points.zh: 接着看详细版：核苷这一步的酶他叫「核苷磷酸酶」，也叫「核苷酶」，把核苷切成碱基加戊糖。
points.en: Turning to the detailed version, he named the enzyme at the nucleoside step 'nucleoside phosphatase', also 'nucleosidase', cutting the nucleoside into base plus pentose.

points.zh: 他随即补充一句：我们体内水解产生的这个戊糖是带磷酸的核糖。
points.en: He immediately added that the pentose produced in our bodies is a phosphate-bearing ribose.

points.zh: 在一些植物和微生物体内这一步走得更彻底，是真的水解，产物是碱基直接加核糖，糖上不带磷酸。
points.en: In some plants and microbes the step goes further as a genuine hydrolysis, giving base plus ribose directly, with no phosphate on the sugar.

points.zh: 他把这条对比定为「一个小点」，能记住最好，记不住也没有关系。
points.en: He rated this contrast a minor point: nice to remember, no harm if not.

points.zh: 三个产物里磷酸不需要再降解，因为游离磷酸本身就可以作为一种缓冲盐用。
