quiz.explain_en: N1 comes from aspartate by the same logic as the third step of the urea cycle: aspartate condenses onto the ring and a lyase then releases its carbon skeleton as fumarate, leaving only the nitrogen behind. C6 comes from CO2, in practice bicarbonate, carboxylating AIR. Glutamine supplies N3 and N9, glycine supplies C4, C5 and N7, folate formyl groups supply C2 and C8, and the methyl of methionine plays no part in the purine ring at all.

title_zh: 嘌呤环的编号与糖苷键位置，de novo 一词，以及 PRPP 的生成
title_en: Numbering the purine ring, the term de novo, and how PRPP is made

points.zh: 应学生要求他在图上标编号，并说这个编号「是反着来的」、命名很奇怪。
points.en: At a student's request he numbers the ring on the diagram, remarking that the numbering runs backwards and that the naming is strange.

points.zh: 他先指出核糖连接的位置，说「它连的这个位置其实是 3 位」。
points.en: He first points to where the ribose attaches, saying that this position is actually number 3.

points.zh: 随后他重新编号：先从大环开始 1、2、3，两环交界的碳是 4 和 5，上面是 6。
points.en: He then renumbers: starting on the large ring with 1, 2, 3, the two fused carbons as 4 and 5, and the top as 6.

points.zh: 接下来绕过来进小环，是 7、8、9。
points.en: Numbering then wraps around into the small ring as 7, 8, 9.

points.zh: 他总结这个编号是「先是左边大循环，然后又是右边小循环，两个方向完全反过来」，这是嘌呤命名恶心的点。
points.en: He sums up the scheme as running one way round the large ring and then the opposite way round the small one, which he calls the nasty part of purine nomenclature.

points.zh: 他说这一段没有巧妙的记法，只能死记硬背，知道哪个位置来自什么就够了，并提醒往前翻核苷酸那一张笔记里写过编号的来历。
points.en: He says there is no clever trick here, only rote learning, that knowing which position comes from what is enough, and points back to the earlier nucleotide page of notes where the numbering was explained.

points.zh: 他提到从头合成有时会写成斜体的拉丁文 de novo，这就是从头合成的意思。
points.en: He mentions that de novo synthesis is sometimes written as the italicised Latin phrase de novo, and that this is what it means.

points.zh: 转入补救合成，他说对嘌呤来说补救合成还是比较重要的，并从核糖-5-磷酸讲起：它由磷酸戊糖途径直接产生，与大量 NADPH 的生成是同一条路上的事。
points.en: Turning to salvage, he says it matters quite a lot for purines, and starts from ribose-5-phosphate: it is produced directly by the pentose phosphate pathway, on the same road that makes all that NADPH.

points.zh: 五磷酸核糖由一个名字很长的酶——磷酸核糖焦磷酸激酶——在核糖的 1 位上接一分子焦磷酸，他说这是一个激活过程、消耗两分子焦磷酸，酶叫 PRPP synthesis，产物 PRPP 就是 5 位磷酸、1 位焦磷酸的核糖。
points.en: Ribose-5-phosphate then receives a pyrophosphate at C1 from an enzyme with a long name, phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate kinase; he calls this an activation costing two pyrophosphates, names the enzyme PRPP synthesis, and spells out that PRPP is ribose with phosphate at position 5 and pyrophosphate at position 1.

extra.zh: 糖苷键的位置：嘌呤在 N9，嘧啶在 N1，没有「3 位」这一说。他说「3 位」那一句之后其实自己隐性纠正了——按他随即重排的编号（大环 1、2、3，稠合碳 4、5，再 6，绕到小环 7、8、9），核糖接的那个氮正好落在 N9，与正确答案一致，但「3 位」那句始终没有明确改口。另外他在 01:21:39 前后把「嘧啶」和「嘌呤」两个词混着说了一次，那里讲的是嘌呤。
extra.en: The glycosidic bond sits at N9 in purines and N1 in pyrimidines; there is no position 3. He effectively corrects himself right afterwards — under the renumbering he immediately draws (large ring 1, 2, 3, fused carbons 4 and 5, then 6, wrapping into the small ring as 7, 8, 9), the nitrogen bearing the ribose lands exactly on N9, which is right — but the sentence about position 3 is never explicitly withdrawn. He also swaps the words pyrimidine and purine once around 01:21:39; the subject there is purine.

extra.zh: PRPP 合成的能量账：反应是 ATP + 核糖-5-磷酸 → PRPP + AMP，只消耗一分子 ATP，不是「两分子焦磷酸」。特别之处在于断的是 ATP 的 α-β 键，整个焦磷酸基团被整体转移到核糖 C1 上（而不是水解掉），所以离去的是 AMP。净耗两个高能磷酸键，因此正确说法是「一分子 ATP、相当于两个高能磷酸键」。此外酶名是 PRPP synthetase（磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶，又名核糖磷酸焦磷酸激酶，EC 2.7.6.1），synthesis 是「合成」这件事，不是酶名。
extra.en: The energy accounting for PRPP: the reaction is ATP plus ribose-5-phosphate giving PRPP plus AMP, costing one ATP, not two pyrophosphates. What is unusual is that the α-β bond of ATP is broken and the entire pyrophosphate group is transferred intact onto C1 of the ribose rather than hydrolysed, which is why AMP leaves. Two high-energy phosphate bonds are consumed net, so the accurate phrasing is one ATP, worth two high-energy bonds. The enzyme is PRPP synthetase (ribose-phosphate diphosphokinase, EC 2.7.6.1); synthesis names the process, not the enzyme.

extra.zh: PRPP 是嘌呤从头合成、嘌呤补救、嘧啶从头合成三条路共用的分叉点，这也是它值得单列一步讲的原因。它的调控：PRPP synthetase 受 ADP 和 GDP 别构抑制；而下游 committed step（谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶）受 AMP/GMP/IMP 反馈抑制、被 PRPP 前馈激活。PRPP synthetase 的超活性突变会造成 PRPP 过量、嘌呤合成失控，是一种少见的遗传性痛风。
extra.en: PRPP is the branch point shared by purine de novo synthesis, purine salvage and pyrimidine de novo synthesis, which is why it deserves a step of its own. Its regulation: PRPP synthetase is allosterically inhibited by ADP and GDP, while the downstream committed step, glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase, is feedback-inhibited by AMP, GMP and IMP and feed-forward activated by PRPP. Superactivity mutations in PRPP synthetase overproduce PRPP and drive uncontrolled purine synthesis, a rare inherited cause of gout.

extra.zh: 核糖-5-磷酸的来源比「磷酸戊糖途径」这一句更细：氧化段（G6PD、6-磷酸葡萄糖酸脱氢酶）在产 NADPH 的同时得到核酮糖-5-磷酸，再由异构酶转成核糖-5-磷酸；细胞若只要核糖不要 NADPH，还可以走非氧化段由转酮酶/转醛酶从 6-磷酸果糖和 3-磷酸甘油醛倒着做出来。所以 NADPH 与核糖的供需可以解耦，这正是非氧化段可逆的意义。
extra.en: The origin of ribose-5-phosphate is finer-grained than just the pentose phosphate pathway: the oxidative branch (G6PD and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase) yields NADPH along with ribulose-5-phosphate, which an isomerase converts to ribose-5-phosphate; and if a cell wants ribose without NADPH it can run the non-oxidative branch in reverse, with transketolase and transaldolase building it from fructose-6-phosphate and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. Ribose and NADPH supply can therefore be decoupled, which is the point of the non-oxidative branch being reversible.

quiz.q_zh: 嘌呤核苷酸中，核糖接在碱基的哪个原子上？
quiz.q_en: Which atom of the base carries the ribose in a purine nucleotide?

options.zh: 接在 N9 上，嘧啶则接在它的 N1 上
options.en: At N9, while pyrimidines use their N1

options.zh: 接在 3 位氮上，和嘧啶的连接位点完全相同
options.en: At N3, the atom that pyrimidines also use

options.zh: 接在 C8 上，形成碳-碳型的糖苷键
options.en: At C8, through an unusual carbon-carbon bond

options.zh: 接在 N1 上，与嘧啶核苷酸完全一致
options.en: At N1, exactly as pyrimidine nucleotides do

quiz.explain_zh: 嘌呤的 N-糖苷键在 N9，嘧啶在 N1，这一对必须成对记。3 位氮在嘌呤里是谷氨酰胺提供的环内氮，不连糖；C8 上连的是四氢叶酸给的甲酰碳，糖苷键是 N-糖苷键而非碳-碳键；N1 是天冬氨酸提供的氮，在嘌呤里也不接糖。老师说「3 位」之后立刻重排编号，按他自己排的号恰好落在 N9。
quiz.explain_en: The N-glycosidic bond is at N9 in purines and N1 in pyrimidines, a pair worth memorising together. N3 in a purine is a ring nitrogen donated by glutamine and carries no sugar; C8 bears a formyl carbon from tetrahydrofolate, and the linkage is an N-glycosidic bond rather than carbon-carbon; and N1 is the aspartate-derived nitrogen, which in purines also carries no sugar. After saying position 3 the teacher immediately renumbers, and by his own scheme the sugar lands on N9.

quiz.q_zh: PRPP 合成酶催化的反应在能量上消耗了什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the PRPP synthetase reaction actually cost in energy terms?

options.zh: 两分子 ATP，各水解成 ADP 和一个磷酸
options.en: Two ATP, each split into ADP plus phosphate

options.zh: 一分子 ATP，焦磷酸基整体转到核糖 1 位
options.en: One ATP; its pyrophosphate moves onto C1

options.zh: 一分子 GTP，水解后释放 GDP 和磷酸基
options.en: One GTP, hydrolysed to GDP and phosphate

options.zh: 两分子焦磷酸，由细胞的无机焦磷酸酶提供
options.en: Two pyrophosphates from a pyrophosphatase

quiz.explain_zh: 反应式是 ATP + 核糖-5-磷酸 → PRPP + AMP：断的是 α-β 键，焦磷酸基团整体转移到核糖 C1 上，离去的是 AMP，所以只用一分子 ATP 却净耗两个高能磷酸键。不是两分子 ATP 各水解成 ADP；供能的不是 GTP；无机焦磷酸酶的作用是水解游离 PPi 把反应拉向前，它不提供焦磷酸基团。老师说的「消耗两分子焦磷酸」把高能键数和分子数混在了一起。
quiz.explain_en: The reaction is ATP plus ribose-5-phosphate giving PRPP plus AMP: the α-β bond is broken, the pyrophosphate group is transferred whole onto C1 of the ribose, and AMP leaves — so one ATP is used but two high-energy phosphate bonds are spent. It is not two ATP each going to ADP; GTP is not the donor; and inorganic pyrophosphatase hydrolyses free PPi to pull reactions forward rather than supplying pyrophosphate groups. Saying two pyrophosphates are consumed conflates the count of high-energy bonds with the count of molecules.

quiz.q_zh: 构筑核苷酸所用的核糖-5-磷酸主要来自哪条途径？
quiz.q_en: Where does the ribose-5-phosphate used to build nucleotides mainly come from?

options.zh: 尿素循环的旁路，由鸟氨酸的碳骨架转化而来
options.en: A urea cycle branch, from the ornithine skeleton

options.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径，与 NADPH 的生成同一条路
options.en: The pentose phosphate pathway, alongside NADPH

options.zh: 糖异生途径，由丙酮酸逆向生成后再磷酸化
options.en: Gluconeogenesis, from pyruvate then phosphorylated

options.zh: 糖酵解途径，由 3-磷酸甘油醛直接环化生成
options.en: Glycolysis, by cyclising glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate

quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸戊糖途径氧化段在产 NADPH 的同时给出核酮糖-5-磷酸，异构化即得核糖-5-磷酸；非氧化段还能由 6-磷酸果糖和 3-磷酸甘油醛可逆地做出核糖，使 NADPH 与核糖的供需解耦。糖异生从丙酮酸、乳酸、甘油出发造葡萄糖，不直接产生戊糖；3-磷酸甘油醛不会自己环化成核糖，它要经转酮酶/转醛酶重排；鸟氨酸是尿素循环的载体分子，与戊糖代谢无关。
quiz.explain_en: The oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway yields ribulose-5-phosphate along with NADPH, and an isomerase converts it to ribose-5-phosphate; the non-oxidative branch can also build ribose reversibly from fructose-6-phosphate and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate, decoupling ribose supply from NADPH demand. Gluconeogenesis makes glucose from pyruvate, lactate and glycerol and produces no pentose directly; glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate does not cyclise into ribose by itself but must be rearranged by transketolase and transaldolase; and ornithine is a urea cycle carrier with no role in pentose metabolism.

title_zh: PRPP 的结构与嘌呤补救途径：碱基 + PRPP 一步成单磷酸核苷酸
title_en: PRPP and purine salvage: base + PRPP gives a monophosphate nucleotide in one step

points.zh: PRPP 三个字母拆开看：P 是核糖 5 位上的磷酸，R 是 ribose 核糖，PP 是接在 1 位上的焦磷酸，全称就是 5-磷酸核糖-1-焦磷酸。
points.en: PRPP read letter by letter: P is the phosphate on C5 of ribose, R is ribose, PP is the pyrophosphate attached at C1 — 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate.

points.zh: PRPP 由核糖-5-磷酸活化而来，老师把这个酶念作 PRPP synthesis，反应把一分子焦磷酸装到核糖的 1 位上。
points.en: PRPP comes from ribose-5-phosphate; he calls the enzyme PRPP synthesis, and the reaction loads a pyrophosphate onto C1 of the ribose.

points.zh: 那个焦磷酸只起活化作用，它不是产物里最终保留的磷酸。
points.en: That pyrophosphate serves only to activate the sugar; it is not the phosphate that stays in the product.

points.zh: PRPP 是补救途径的主要底物，它直接接收游离的碱基：A 是腺嘌呤、I 是次黄嘌呤、G 是鸟嘌呤。
points.en: PRPP is the main substrate of salvage; it takes up free bases directly — A adenine, I hypoxanthine, G guanine.

points.zh: 碱基接上去以后就分别形成 AMP、IMP、GMP，同时把 1 位的焦磷酸 PPi 释放出去。
points.en: Once the base is attached you get AMP, IMP or GMP, with the C1 pyrophosphate released as PPi.

points.zh: 产物一定是 mono 磷酸形式，因为真正保留下来的是核糖 5 位那个磷酸，它从头到尾没有动过。
points.en: The product is always a monophosphate, because the phosphate that survives is the one on C5, which is never touched.

points.zh: 要背的第一句话：嘌呤的补救合成产物都是单磷酸形式，都是 AMP、IMP、GMP。
points.en: First sentence to memorise: purine salvage products are all monophosphates — AMP, IMP, GMP.

points.zh: 他要求在这里先记住，是因为按他当时的说法，嘧啶的补救里有些步骤只能在双磷酸或三磷酸水平发生，不先分清后面会晕。
points.en: He wants this fixed now because, as he put it at this moment, parts of pyrimidine salvage happen only at the di- or triphosphate level, and mixing them up later is confusing.

points.zh: 调节这一段他说不重要：AMP、IMP、GMP 越多，PRPP synthesis 活性越受抑制；PRPP 越少活性越高。
points.en: He calls the regulation section unimportant: the more AMP, IMP and GMP, the more the PRPP-making enzyme is inhibited; the less PRPP, the higher its activity.

extra.zh: 他说 AMP、IMP、GMP 是这个酶的「三个底物」。它们是这条通路的终产物，作用方式是反馈抑制 (feedback inhibition)。PRPP 合成酶真正的底物是核糖-5-磷酸和 ATP；而且 AMP/IMP/GMP 的经典反馈作用点并不是 PRPP 合成酶，而是从头合成的 committed step——谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶。PRPP 合成酶本身主要被 ADP 和 GDP 别构抑制。
extra.en: He calls AMP, IMP and GMP the enzyme's three substrates. They are the end products of the pathway and act by feedback inhibition. PRPP synthetase's real substrates are ribose-5-phosphate and ATP, and the classical target of AMP/IMP/GMP feedback is not PRPP synthetase but the committed step of de novo synthesis, glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase. PRPP synthetase itself is allosterically inhibited mainly by ADP and GDP.

extra.zh: 酶名应是 PRPP synthetase（磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶，EC 2.7.6.1），synthesis 是「合成」这件事、不是酶名。紧接本段之前他说这一步「消耗两分子焦磷酸」，帐算错了：反应是 ATP + 核糖-5-磷酸 → PRPP + AMP，只消耗一分子 ATP，但因为断的是 α-β 键、整个焦磷酸基团被整体转移到核糖 C1 上，净耗的是两个高能磷酸键。正确说法是「一分子 ATP、相当于两个高能磷酸键」。
extra.en: The enzyme is PRPP synthetase (ribose-phosphate diphosphokinase, EC 2.7.6.1); synthesis is the process, not an enzyme name. Just before this stretch he says the step consumes two pyrophosphates. The reaction is ATP + ribose-5-phosphate to PRPP + AMP: one ATP is spent, but because the alpha-beta bond is cleaved and the whole pyrophosphate group is transferred onto C1, the net cost is two high-energy phosphate bonds.

extra.zh: 补救途径存在的理由就是省钱：从头合成造一分子 IMP 要走十步、要消耗多个 ATP 当量，而补救是一步反应。脑、骨髓、外周血细胞几乎没有从头合成能力，全靠补救。HGPRT 完全缺失即 Lesch-Nyhan 综合征：次黄嘌呤、鸟嘌呤回收不了全部走向尿酸，同时 PRPP 堆积反过来推高从头合成，临床上是高尿酸血症加严重的神经症状与自残行为。
extra.en: Salvage exists because it is cheap: de novo synthesis needs ten steps and several ATP equivalents to make one IMP, while salvage is a single step. Brain, bone marrow and peripheral blood cells have almost no de novo capacity and depend on salvage. Complete loss of HGPRT is Lesch-Nyhan syndrome: hypoxanthine and guanine cannot be recycled and go to urate, while accumulating PRPP drives de novo synthesis harder — hyperuricaemia plus severe neurological disease and self-injury.

extra.zh: 碱基接到 PRPP 的 C1 上形成的是 N-糖苷键，位置是固定的：嘌呤在 N9，嘧啶在 N1。老师在本段之前讲糖苷键时说过是「3 位」，那是没有的说法；他随后重新给环上原子编号时（大环 1、2、3，稠合碳 4、5，再 6，绕到小环 7、8、9）其实正好落在 N9，等于隐性纠正，但那句「3 位」一直没有被收回。
extra.en: The base attaches to C1 of PRPP through an N-glycosidic bond at a fixed position: N9 for purines, N1 for pyrimidines. Just before this stretch he put it at position 3, which does not exist; when he renumbers the ring a moment later (1, 2, 3 around the large ring, 4 and 5 as the fusion carbons, then 6, then 7, 8, 9 on the small ring) he lands on N9 — an implicit fix that never retracts the earlier statement.

quiz.q_zh: 在嘌呤的补救途径里，PRPP 与游离的次黄嘌呤反应，一步生成什么？
quiz.q_en: In purine salvage, PRPP reacts with free hypoxanthine to give what in one step?

options.zh: IMP 与一分子焦磷酸 PPi
options.en: IMP plus one pyrophosphate PPi

options.zh: AMP 与一分子焦磷酸 PPi
options.en: AMP plus one pyrophosphate PPi

options.zh: GMP 与一分子焦磷酸 PPi
options.en: GMP plus one pyrophosphate PPi

options.zh: IMP 与两分子无机磷酸 Pi
options.en: IMP plus two inorganic phosphates Pi

quiz.explain_zh: 次黄嘌呤接到 PRPP 的 C1 上得到的核苷酸就是 IMP，同时 1 位的焦磷酸整个脱下来成为 PPi，所以 IMP 与一分子焦磷酸 PPi 是对的。生成 AMP 要用腺嘌呤、生成 GMP 要用鸟嘌呤，碱基对不上；写成两分子无机磷酸 Pi 也不对，离去的是完整的焦磷酸基团，之后才被焦磷酸酶水解成两个 Pi。
quiz.explain_en: Hypoxanthine attached to C1 of PRPP gives IMP, and the C1 pyrophosphate leaves intact as PPi, so IMP plus one PPi is right. AMP would require adenine and GMP would require guanine, so those bases do not match; two inorganic phosphates is wrong because the leaving group departs as intact pyrophosphate and is only later hydrolysed by pyrophosphatase.

quiz.q_zh: 嘌呤补救途径的产物为什么都停在单磷酸水平？
quiz.q_en: Why do purine salvage products all stop at the monophosphate level?

options.zh: 焦磷酸先被焦磷酸酶水解，只在核糖 1 位留下一个磷酸
options.en: Pyrophosphatase hydrolyses the pyrophosphate first, leaving one phosphate on C1

options.zh: 核糖 5 位原有的那个磷酸被保留，1 位的焦磷酸整个脱去
options.en: The original phosphate on C5 is kept while the whole C1 pyrophosphate leaves

options.zh: 反应由激酶催化，每一轮只能向核糖转移一个磷酸基团
options.en: A kinase catalyses it and can transfer only one phosphate to the sugar per round

options.zh: 碱基上的氨基与一分子磷酸缩合，因此只能接受一个磷酸
options.en: The base's amino group condenses with one phosphate, so only one is taken up

quiz.explain_zh: PRPP 本身就是 5-磷酸核糖-1-焦磷酸，5 位那个磷酸全程没有动，1 位焦磷酸只负责活化并在成键时脱去，所以产物就是单磷酸核苷酸。碱基提供的是接到 C1 上的那个氮（嘌呤 N9），不提供磷酸；焦磷酸水解后 1 位留下的也不是磷酸，1 位最后连的是碱基；催化这一步的是磷酸核糖转移酶，不是激酶，整个过程没有磷酸转移。
quiz.explain_en: PRPP is 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate: the C5 phosphate is never touched, and the C1 pyrophosphate only activates the sugar and leaves as the bond forms, so the product is a monophosphate. The base contributes the nitrogen that bonds to C1 (N9 in purines), not a phosphate; hydrolysing the pyrophosphate does not leave a phosphate on C1, since C1 ends up carrying the base; and the enzyme is a phosphoribosyltransferase, not a kinase, with no phosphate transfer at all.

quiz.q_zh: 课上把 AMP、IMP、GMP 说成 PRPP 合成酶的底物。关于这三者，正确的说法是什么？
quiz.q_en: He calls AMP, IMP and GMP substrates of the PRPP-making enzyme. What is actually true of them?

options.zh: 它们是终产物，反馈位点是谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶
options.en: They are end products; the feedback target is glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase

options.zh: 它们是嘌呤分解代谢的中间物，靠抑制黄嘌呤氧化酶起作用
options.en: They are purine catabolic intermediates acting by inhibiting xanthine oxidase

options.zh: 它们是 PRPP 合成酶的别构激活剂，浓度越高酶的活性反而越高
options.en: They allosterically activate PRPP synthetase, raising activity as they build up

options.zh: 它们是 PRPP 合成酶的直接底物，与核糖-5-磷酸一起被消耗
options.en: They are direct substrates of PRPP synthetase, consumed with ribose-5-phosphate

quiz.explain_zh: AMP、IMP、GMP 是嘌呤合成的终产物，它们的抑制属于反馈抑制，经典作用点是从头合成的 committed step——谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶；PRPP 合成酶本身的底物是核糖-5-磷酸和 ATP，主要被 ADP 和 GDP 别构抑制。说它们是底物混淆了产物与原料；嘌呤降解的中间物是次黄嘌呤、黄嘌呤和尿酸，黄嘌呤氧化酶是别嘌呤醇的靶点；说它们是别构激活剂则把调节方向讲反了。
quiz.explain_en: AMP, IMP and GMP are end products of purine synthesis, so their action is feedback inhibition, classically on the committed step of de novo synthesis, glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase; PRPP synthetase's own substrates are ribose-5-phosphate and ATP and it is inhibited mainly by ADP and GDP. Calling them substrates confuses product with starting material; purine catabolic intermediates are hypoxanthine, xanthine and urate, and xanthine oxidase is the target of allopurinol; calling them allosteric activators inverts the direction of control.

title_zh: IMP 不是终点：往 AMP 走要 GTP 供能、天冬氨酸供氮
title_en: IMP is not the endpoint: the route to AMP needs GTP for energy and aspartate for nitrogen

points.zh: IMP 是次黄嘌呤核苷酸，老师说它不是一种经典的核苷酸，还得再走一步。
points.en: IMP is inosine monophosphate; he says it is not a classical nucleotide and needs one further step.

points.zh: 他把这一步称作补救途径的第二步：把次黄嘌呤核苷酸变成 AMP 或者 GMP。
points.en: He calls this the second step of salvage: converting IMP into AMP or GMP.

points.zh: 记忆抓手：腺嘌呤分解成次黄嘌呤时，6 位的氨基变成羰基；反过来走就是把这个羰基换回氨基。
points.en: A mnemonic he gives: when adenine is degraded to hypoxanthine the C6 amino becomes a carbonyl, so running it backwards means putting an amino back where the carbonyl is.

points.zh: IMP 变 AMP 的第一步需要一个 GTP 供能，他特意说这个要稍微记一下。
points.en: The first step from IMP to AMP is driven by GTP, and he flags it as something to memorise.

points.zh: 加上去的氨基由天冬氨酸提供，天冬氨酸交出一分子氨基。
points.en: The amino group comes from aspartate, which donates one amino group.

points.zh: 最后再裂解一次，IMP 就变成了 AMP。
points.en: A final cleavage then converts the intermediate into AMP.

points.zh: 看鸟苷酸的结构会发现它在那个位置比次黄嘌呤多一个氨基。
points.en: Looking at guanylate, it carries one extra amino group at the corresponding position compared with hypoxanthine.

points.zh: 次黄嘌呤在那个位置本来没有羰基，所以往 GMP 走必须先造出一个羰基，再往上换氨基。
points.en: Hypoxanthine has no carbonyl at that position, so the route to GMP must first create one before an amino can replace it.

points.zh: 造羰基靠 NAD：NAD 是拿走氢的，它把这里的氢夺走，这个位置就变成了羰基。
points.en: The carbonyl is made with NAD: NAD takes hydrogen away, and the position becomes a carbonyl.

extra.zh: IMP → AMP / IMP → GMP 并不是「补救途径的第二步」。从头合成走完十步得到的也正是 IMP，两条路在 IMP 汇合，再从这里分叉去 AMP 和 GMP，所以它是从头与补救共用的分支点，不是补救独有的续集。IMP 本身是细胞里真实存在的核苷酸中间物，只是不掺入核酸。
extra.en: IMP to AMP and IMP to GMP are not a second step of salvage. De novo synthesis also ends at IMP, so both routes converge there and then branch — this is a shared branch point, not a salvage-only sequel. IMP is a genuine cellular nucleotide intermediate; it simply is not incorporated into nucleic acid.

extra.zh: 两个酶的名字他没有给：IMP → AMP 由腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶 (adenylosuccinate synthetase) 催化，GTP 活化 IMP 的 6 位氧，天冬氨酸的 α-氨基进攻生成腺苷酸代琥珀酸，再由腺苷酸代琥珀酸裂解酶切下延胡索酸得到 AMP。记忆点是交叉供能：做 A 用 GTP，做 G 用 ATP。
extra.en: He does not name the enzymes: IMP to AMP is catalysed by adenylosuccinate synthetase, with GTP activating the C6 oxygen and the alpha-amino group of aspartate attacking to give adenylosuccinate, which adenylosuccinate lyase then cleaves, releasing fumarate and leaving AMP. The memory hook is the cross-feeding: making A costs GTP, making G costs ATP.

extra.zh: 「NAD 把这里的氢直接夺走就变成羰基」讲得太简。IMP 脱氢酶催化 IMP → XMP 是有水参与的氧化：C2 先加水形成半缩醛胺型中间物，NAD+ 再接受一个氢负离子 (hydride) 生成 NADH。只拿走一个氢原子不足以把 C-H 变成 C=O，那个氧原子来自水。
extra.en: Saying NAD just pulls a hydrogen off to make a carbonyl is too compressed. IMP dehydrogenase catalyses IMP to XMP as a water-dependent oxidation: water first adds at C2 to give a carbinolamine-type intermediate, and NAD+ then accepts a hydride to form NADH. Removing one hydrogen cannot turn C-H into C=O; the oxygen comes from water.

extra.zh: 次黄嘌呤（碱基，hypoxanthine）和 IMP（核苷酸，次黄嘌呤核苷酸）在这一段被交替使用。变成 AMP/GMP 的是核苷酸 IMP；碱基层面的次黄嘌呤是嘌呤降解通路上的东西（→黄嘌呤→尿酸），也是 HGPRT 补救的底物。另外顺带一句：嘌呤不是六元环，是六元嘧啶环稠合五元咪唑环，共 9 个环原子，氨基/羰基在六元环的 C6，糖苷键在五元环的 N9。
extra.en: Hypoxanthine (the base) and IMP (the nucleotide) are used interchangeably here. What goes on to AMP or GMP is the nucleotide IMP; free hypoxanthine belongs to the catabolic route (to xanthine, then urate) and is the HGPRT salvage substrate. Also worth stating: purine is not a six-membered ring but a six-membered pyrimidine ring fused to a five-membered imidazole, nine ring atoms in all, with the amino/carbonyl at C6 of the six-membered ring and the glycosidic bond at N9 of the five-membered one.

quiz.q_zh: IMP 转变成 AMP 的那一步，供能的核苷三磷酸和氨基供体分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: For the conversion of IMP to AMP, which nucleoside triphosphate supplies energy and what donates the amino group?

options.zh: ATP 供能，氨基由谷氨酰胺提供，随后释放谷氨酸
options.en: ATP for energy, amino from glutamine, releasing glutamate

options.zh: GTP 供能，氨基由谷氨酰胺提供，随后释放谷氨酸
options.en: GTP for energy, amino from glutamine, releasing glutamate

options.zh: ATP 供能，氨基由天冬氨酸提供，随后释放延胡索酸
options.en: ATP for energy, amino from aspartate, releasing fumarate

options.zh: GTP 供能，氨基由天冬氨酸提供，随后释放出延胡索酸
options.en: GTP for energy, amino from aspartate, releasing fumarate

quiz.explain_zh: 腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶用 GTP 活化 IMP 的 6 位氧，天冬氨酸的 α-氨基进攻生成腺苷酸代琥珀酸，裂解酶再切下延胡索酸留下 AMP，这正是老师说的「GTP 供能、天冬氨酸给氨基」。谷氨酰胺供氮是 IMP→GMP 那一支的特征，而那一支用的是 ATP，所以把 ATP 与天冬氨酸、GTP 与谷氨酰胺组合起来都是把两条支路的元件拼错了。
quiz.explain_en: Adenylosuccinate synthetase uses GTP to activate the C6 oxygen of IMP, the alpha-amino group of aspartate attacks to give adenylosuccinate, and the lyase then removes fumarate leaving AMP — exactly the GTP-plus-aspartate combination he flagged. Glutamine as nitrogen donor belongs to the IMP-to-GMP branch, which runs on ATP, so pairing ATP with aspartate, or GTP with glutamine, mixes parts from the two branches.

quiz.q_zh: IMP 走向 GMP 的第一步在化学上做了什么？
quiz.q_en: Chemically, what happens in the first step from IMP towards GMP?

options.zh: 由 IMP 脱氢酶在 2 位氧化成羰基，生成 XMP 和 NADH
options.en: IMP dehydrogenase oxidises C2 to a carbonyl, giving XMP and NADH

options.zh: 由 NAD+ 把 6 位的羰基还原成羟基，生成中间物 XMP
options.en: NAD+ reduces the C6 carbonyl to a hydroxyl, giving XMP as product

options.zh: 由 ATP 把 2 位磷酸化，形成一个活化的磷酸酯中间物
options.en: ATP phosphorylates C2, forming an activated phosphate ester

options.zh: 由天冬氨酸把一个氨基加到 2 位上，直接生成 GMP
options.en: Aspartate adds an amino group at C2, directly producing GMP

quiz.explain_zh: 次黄嘌呤环的 2 位原本是 C-H，必须先氧化成羰基，下一步才有东西可以被换成氨基；催化的是 IMP 脱氢酶，产物是 XMP，NAD+ 接受氢负离子变成 NADH。天冬氨酸直接给氨基是 IMP→AMP 的化学，而且发生在 6 位；说 NAD+ 把 6 位羰基还原成羟基把氧化还原方向讲反了；这一步也不涉及 ATP 对 2 位的磷酸化。
quiz.explain_en: C2 of the hypoxanthine ring starts as C-H and must be oxidised to a carbonyl before anything can be replaced by an amino group; IMP dehydrogenase does this, giving XMP while NAD+ takes a hydride and becomes NADH. Aspartate donating an amino group directly is the chemistry of IMP to AMP, and it happens at C6; having NAD+ reduce a C6 carbonyl to a hydroxyl reverses the redox direction; and no ATP-dependent phosphorylation of C2 occurs here.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 IMP 在嘌呤代谢中的地位，哪一条说法正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement correctly describes the position of IMP in purine metabolism?

options.zh: 它是嘌呤降解的产物，只在核酸被分解之后才会出现
options.en: It is a catabolic product, appearing only after nucleic acid breakdown

options.zh: 它是经典核苷酸，会像 AMP 一样被大量掺入 RNA 链中
options.en: It is a classical nucleotide, incorporated into RNA much as AMP is

options.zh: 它是从头合成的终点，也是通往 AMP 和 GMP 的分支点
options.en: It ends de novo synthesis and is the branch point to AMP and GMP

options.zh: 它是补救途径特有的中间物，从头合成不经过这个化合物
options.en: It is unique to salvage; de novo synthesis never passes through it

quiz.explain_zh: 从头合成十步走到的终点就是 IMP，补救途径由 HGPRT 把次黄嘌呤接到 PRPP 上得到的也是 IMP，两条路在这里汇合再分叉去 AMP 和 GMP，所以说它是补救途径特有的第二步不成立。它也不是降解产物——降解方向上出现的是游离的次黄嘌呤、黄嘌呤、尿酸；它更不是掺入 RNA 的经典核苷酸，细胞里它主要作为分支中间物存在。
quiz.explain_en: The ten steps of de novo synthesis end at IMP, and salvage via HGPRT on PRPP also yields IMP, so the two routes converge there and then branch to AMP and GMP — it is not a salvage-only second step. Nor is it a catabolic product: catabolism gives free hypoxanthine, xanthine and urate. And it is not a classical nucleotide incorporated into RNA; it exists mainly as a branch-point intermediate.

title_zh: 氨基供体的取舍规则，与 IMP → GMP 的 NAD、ATP、谷氨酰胺
title_en: Which amino group a donor gives up, and the NAD, ATP and glutamine of IMP to GMP

points.zh: 学生问：天冬氨酸给的是它自己主链上的氨基吗？他答，是的，它没有额外的氨可给。
points.en: Asked whether aspartate gives up its own backbone amino group, he says yes — it has no extra nitrogen to spare.

points.zh: 之所以敢用自己的氨基，是因为剩下的那一坨就是富马酸。
points.en: It can afford to do so because what is left over is fumarate.

points.zh: 富马酸可以直接掺入三羧酸循环，所以碳骨架不浪费，用自己的氨基没有问题。
points.en: Fumarate feeds straight into the TCA cycle, so the carbon skeleton is not wasted and giving up its own amino group costs nothing.

points.zh: 对比之下，谷氨酸和谷氨酰胺不一样：谷氨酰胺一般先用侧链上那个酰胺的氨基。
points.en: Glutamate and glutamine behave differently: glutamine normally gives up the side-chain amide nitrogen first.

points.zh: 只有在那之后，才会考虑去动它主链上 α 位的氨基。
points.en: Only after that would the alpha-amino group on the backbone be touched.

points.zh: 回到 GMP：次黄嘌呤先在 NAD 的作用下被脱掉氢原子，那个位置产生一个羰基。
points.en: Back to GMP: NAD first removes hydrogen from hypoxanthine, creating a carbonyl at that position.

points.zh: 然后一样需要供能，他的原话是「上面是 GDP 供能，这里是 ATP 供能」。
points.en: Then energy is needed again; his words are that the branch above runs on GDP while this one runs on ATP.

points.zh: 氨基由谷氨酰胺提供，谷氨酰胺把这个氨基加上去，产物就是 GMP。
points.en: Glutamine supplies the amino group, and once it is attached the product is GMP.

points.zh: 他强调最晕头的一点：同一个 IMP 往 AMP 和 GMP 两边走，给氨基的来源不一样，这一小块要记。
points.en: He stresses the confusing part: the same IMP going to AMP or to GMP draws its nitrogen from different donors, and this needs memorising.

extra.zh: 「上面是 GDP 供能」说错了，应该是 GTP。他在 01:29:14 已经正确说过「第一步需要有一个 GTP 供能」，到这里说成 GDP，此后没有再改回来。正确的是：IMP → AMP 由腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶用 GTP 供能；IMP → XMP → GMP 里 GMP 合成酶用 ATP 供能。
extra.en: Saying the branch above runs on GDP is a slip for GTP. At 01:29:14 he had it right, calling for GTP; here he says GDP and never corrects it. IMP to AMP is driven by GTP through adenylosuccinate synthetase, while GMP synthetase in the IMP to XMP to GMP branch is driven by ATP.

extra.zh: GMP 合成酶用掉的 ATP 是断成 AMP + PPi（不是 ADP + Pi），也就是一次投两个高能磷酸键；它的氮正是谷氨酰胺侧链的酰胺氮，与他刚讲的「谷氨酰胺先用酰胺氮」这条规则完全对得上。酶有一个谷氨酰胺酶结构域，就地把氨解下来通过内部通道送到活性位点。
extra.en: The ATP consumed by GMP synthetase is split to AMP + PPi, not ADP + Pi, so two high-energy bonds go in at once; its nitrogen is precisely the side-chain amide of glutamine, matching the rule he has just stated. The enzyme carries a glutaminase domain that releases ammonia in place and channels it internally to the active site.

extra.zh: 天冬氨酸「给氮、碳骨架以延胡索酸离开」这个模式在生化里出现两次：IMP → AMP，以及尿素循环第三步（精氨酸代琥珀酸合成酶 + 裂解酶）。两处都用 ATP 或 GTP 先活化一个氧，再由天冬氨酸的 α-氨基进攻，最后裂解释放延胡索酸。把两处放在一起记比分开记省力。
extra.en: The pattern where aspartate donates nitrogen and its carbon leaves as fumarate appears twice in biochemistry: IMP to AMP, and step three of the urea cycle (argininosuccinate synthetase plus lyase). Both activate an oxygen with ATP or GTP, let the alpha-amino group of aspartate attack, then cleave off fumarate. Learning them together is cheaper than learning them apart.

extra.zh: 交叉供能不是巧合，而是调控设计：ATP 充足时推动 GMP 合成，GTP 充足时推动 AMP 合成，两个嘌呤核苷酸池互相拉平，避免一边过量。IMP 脱氢酶因此成为免疫抑制药物的靶点（霉酚酸/吗替麦考酚酯抑制它，选择性打击淋巴细胞，因为淋巴细胞高度依赖鸟嘌呤核苷酸的从头合成）。
extra.en: The cross-feeding is a control design, not a coincidence: plentiful ATP pushes GMP synthesis and plentiful GTP pushes AMP synthesis, keeping the two purine pools balanced. This makes IMP dehydrogenase a drug target — mycophenolic acid (mycophenolate mofetil) inhibits it and hits lymphocytes selectively, because they depend heavily on de novo guanine nucleotide synthesis.

quiz.q_zh: XMP 转变成 GMP 这一步，供能的核苷酸和氨基供体分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the step from XMP to GMP, which nucleotide supplies energy and what donates the amino group?

options.zh: GTP 供能，氨基来自天冬氨酸主链的 α-氨基
options.en: GTP for energy, amino from the alpha-amino group of aspartate

options.zh: GTP 供能，氨基来自谷氨酰胺侧链的酰胺氮
options.en: GTP for energy, amino from the side-chain amide of glutamine

options.zh: ATP 供能，氨基来自谷氨酰胺侧链的酰胺氮
options.en: ATP for energy, amino from the side-chain amide of glutamine

options.zh: ATP 供能，氨基来自天冬氨酸主链的 α-氨基
options.en: ATP for energy, amino from the alpha-amino group of aspartate

quiz.explain_zh: GMP 合成酶用 ATP（断成 AMP + PPi）活化 XMP，氨基由谷氨酰胺侧链的酰胺氮提供，这与老师刚讲的「谷氨酰胺先用酰胺氮」规则一致。课上说的「上面是 GDP 供能」是口误，那一支用的是 GTP 且属于 IMP→AMP；天冬氨酸供氮同样是 IMP→AMP 的特征，不出现在 GMP 这一支。
quiz.explain_en: GMP synthetase activates XMP using ATP (split to AMP + PPi), and the nitrogen comes from the side-chain amide of glutamine, matching the rule he has just given. His remark about GDP is a slip: that branch uses GTP and belongs to IMP going to AMP, and aspartate as nitrogen donor likewise belongs to that branch, not to this one.

quiz.q_zh: 老师解释天冬氨酸为什么敢直接交出自己主链上的氨基，理由是什么？
quiz.q_en: What reason does he give for aspartate being willing to give up its own backbone amino group?

options.zh: 因为它的氨基本来就是从谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮转过来的
options.en: Because its amino group was itself transferred from the glutamine amide

options.zh: 因为脱氨后剩下的草酰乙酸可以直接进入尿素循环再生
options.en: Because the oxaloacetate left behind is regenerated in the urea cycle

options.zh: 因为剩下的碳骨架正好是富马酸，可直接进三羧酸循环
options.en: Because the leftover carbon skeleton is fumarate, entering the TCA cycle

options.zh: 因为天冬氨酸在体内含量最高，损失一个氨基无关紧要
options.en: Because aspartate is so abundant that losing one amino group hardly matters

quiz.explain_zh: 天冬氨酸交出氮以后剩下的四碳骨架以延胡索酸（富马酸）的形式离开，直接汇入三羧酸循环变成苹果酸、草酰乙酸，再转氨就能变回天冬氨酸，碳完全没有浪费——这正是老师给的理由。说它含量最高是编造的前提；它的氨基来自哪里与这一步用不用自己的氨基无关；剩下的也不是草酰乙酸，而且草酰乙酸进的是三羧酸循环不是尿素循环。
quiz.explain_en: After donating nitrogen, the four-carbon skeleton leaves as fumarate, joins the TCA cycle as malate and oxaloacetate, and one transamination regenerates aspartate, so no carbon is lost — that is exactly his argument. Abundance is an invented premise; where its amino group came from is irrelevant to whether it can be given up; and the leftover is not oxaloacetate, which in any case belongs to the TCA cycle rather than the urea cycle.

title_zh: 嘧啶环的原子来源、氨甲酰磷酸，以及 CPS-1 与 CPS-2 的分工
title_en: Where the pyrimidine ring atoms come from, carbamoyl phosphate, and CPS-1 versus CPS-2

points.zh: 嘌呤讲完，转入嘧啶：同样要知道环上每个位置的原子来源。
points.en: With purines done he turns to pyrimidines, and again the question is where each ring atom comes from.

points.zh: 嘧啶比嘌呤简单：环的一半直接就是 aspartic 天冬氨酸的骨架。
points.en: Pyrimidine is simpler: half the ring is straightforwardly the aspartate skeleton.

points.zh: 天冬氨酸那一侧本来就带着羧基 COOH，成环时正好用得上，只需在另一处补一个氨基。
points.en: That side already carries a COOH, which is used as the ring closes; only an amino group needs adding elsewhere.

points.zh: 环左边那个氮，在动物里由谷氨酰胺提供。
points.en: The nitrogen on the left of the ring is supplied by glutamine in animals.

points.zh: 在细菌里这个氮是游离的氨；他给的理由是细菌可以直接把尿素分解成游离氨。
points.en: In bacteria it is free ammonia; his stated reason is that bacteria can break urea down into free ammonia.

points.zh: 环上的那个碳来源于二氧化碳，不是来源于一碳单位——他说这点很无厘头，只能死记硬背。
points.en: The ring carbon comes from CO2, not from a one-carbon unit; he says this is arbitrary and simply has to be memorised.

points.zh: 嘧啶的从头合成他不细讲，只提一处：动物虽然用谷氨酰胺，但最终也是以游离氨基的形式给出去。
points.en: He skips the detail of pyrimidine de novo synthesis except for one point: even in animals, where glutamine is the source, the nitrogen is handed over as free ammonia.

points.zh: 于是这里有一个游离氨、一个二氧化碳，两者结合就是尿素循环第一步的氨甲酰磷酸；他列的式子是一分子二氧化碳 + 一分子游离氨基 + 两分子 ATP + 一分子磷酸。
points.en: So there is free ammonia and CO2 side by side, and they combine exactly as in step one of the urea cycle to give carbamoyl phosphate; the equation he writes is one CO2 plus one free amino group plus two ATP plus one phosphate.

points.zh: 区别在酶：嘧啶用的是 CPS-2，主要功能是供嘧啶的从头合成；CPS-1 的主要功能是在尿素循环里造氨甲酰磷酸供合成尿素。剩下的从头合成步骤他说太复杂、不看。
points.en: The difference is the enzyme: pyrimidines use CPS-2, dedicated to pyrimidine de novo synthesis, while CPS-1 makes carbamoyl phosphate for urea in the urea cycle. The remaining de novo steps he declares too complex and skips.

extra.zh: 反应式里多了「一分子磷酸」。CPS 的底物是 HCO3−（不是溶解的游离 CO2）+ 氨 + 2 ATP：其中一个 ATP 活化 HCO3− 成羰基磷酸，另一个 ATP 把磷酸交给产物，所以氨甲酰磷酸上的那个磷酸来自后面这个 ATP，反应体系里不需要另外投入游离磷酸。另外 CPS-1 还必须有 N-乙酰谷氨酸 (NAG) 作变构激活剂才工作，这一点他没提。
extra.en: The equation carries an extra free phosphate. CPS substrates are HCO3- (not dissolved CO2), ammonia and 2 ATP: the first ATP activates bicarbonate to carboxyphosphate, the second donates the phosphate to the product, so the phosphate on carbamoyl phosphate comes from that second ATP and no free phosphate need be added. CPS-1 also strictly requires N-acetylglutamate as an allosteric activator, which he does not mention.

extra.zh: 细菌那个氮的来源结论对，理由不对。细菌 CPS 确实可以直接用游离 NH3，而动物的 CPS-II 只会用谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮，这是真的区别；但细菌胞内的氨来自氮同化、铵盐摄取和谷氨酰胺代谢，不是靠脲酶分解尿素来供应嘧啶合成。而且这里该说的是游离氨 NH3，不是「游离的氨基」。
extra.en: His conclusion about the bacterial nitrogen is right but his reason is not. Bacterial CPS can indeed use free NH3 directly while the animal CPS-II uses only the amide nitrogen of glutamine — that difference is real. But intracellular ammonia in bacteria comes from nitrogen assimilation, ammonium uptake and glutamine metabolism, not from urease splitting urea to feed pyrimidine synthesis. And the species involved is free ammonia, not a free amino group.

extra.zh: 两个 CPS 的区室和调控是考点：CPS-1 在肝细胞的线粒体基质，被 NAG 激活，供尿素循环；CPS-2 在胞质，是嘧啶从头合成的限速步，被 UTP（终产物）反馈抑制、被 PRPP 激活，在哺乳动物里它和天冬氨酸转氨甲酰酶、二氢乳清酸酶合在一条多肽上，叫 CAD。
extra.en: The compartments and controls are the exam point: CPS-1 sits in the hepatocyte mitochondrial matrix, is switched on by NAG and feeds the urea cycle; CPS-2 is cytosolic, is the rate-limiting step of pyrimidine de novo synthesis, is feedback-inhibited by UTP and activated by PRPP, and in mammals sits on one polypeptide with aspartate transcarbamoylase and dihydroorotase, called CAD.

extra.zh: 嘧啶和嘌呤的组装顺序正好相反。嘧啶是先造环：氨甲酰磷酸 + 天冬氨酸 → 氨甲酰天冬氨酸 → 二氢乳清酸 → 乳清酸 (orotate)，然后才接上 PRPP 得到 OMP，脱羧成 UMP。嘌呤则从来不存在游离碱基阶段——环是一个原子一个原子直接搭在 PRPP 上的，磷酸和核糖从第一步就在。
extra.en: Pyrimidines and purines are assembled in opposite orders. Pyrimidines build the ring first — carbamoyl phosphate plus aspartate to carbamoyl aspartate, dihydroorotate, then orotate — and only then attach PRPP to give OMP, which is decarboxylated to UMP. Purines never pass through a free base: the ring is built atom by atom directly on PRPP, with the ribose and phosphate present from the first step.

quiz.q_zh: 按课上的讲法，嘧啶环上的原子分别来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: According to the lecture, where do the atoms of the pyrimidine ring come from?

options.zh: 环的一半来自甘氨酸骨架，一个氮来自天冬氨酸，碳来自二氧化碳
options.en: Half the ring from glycine, one nitrogen from aspartate, carbon from CO2

options.zh: 环的一半来自天冬氨酸骨架，一个氮来自甘氨酸，碳来自一碳单位
options.en: Half the ring from aspartate, one nitrogen from glycine, carbon from THF

options.zh: 环的一半来自谷氨酸的骨架，一个氮来自天冬氨酸，碳来自一碳单位
options.en: Half the ring from glutamate, one nitrogen from aspartate, carbon from THF

options.zh: 环的一半来自天冬氨酸骨架，一个氮来自谷氨酰胺，碳来自二氧化碳
options.en: Half the ring from aspartate, one nitrogen from glutamine, carbon from CO2

quiz.explain_zh: 嘧啶环有一半直接用天冬氨酸的碳骨架（连它原有的羧基一起），另一个氮在动物里由谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮提供、细菌里可直接用游离氨，剩下那个碳来自二氧化碳——老师特别强调这个碳不是一碳单位给的。把骨架说成谷氨酸或甘氨酸都不对，甘氨酸整分子掺入的是嘌呤环的 C4、C5、N7；把碳说成一碳单位也不对，一碳单位供的是嘌呤的 C2 和 C8。
quiz.explain_en: Half the pyrimidine ring is the aspartate carbon skeleton including its own carboxyl; the other nitrogen comes from the amide of glutamine in animals (free ammonia in bacteria); and the remaining carbon comes from CO2, which he stresses is not a one-carbon unit. Glutamate and glycine are not the skeleton — glycine is incorporated whole into the purine ring as C4, C5 and N7 — and a one-carbon unit supplies C2 and C8 of purines, not this carbon.

quiz.q_zh: 氨甲酰磷酸合成的真实底物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the real substrates for making carbamoyl phosphate?

options.zh: CO2、氨、两分子 ATP，外加一分子游离的无机磷酸
options.en: CO2, ammonia, two ATP, plus one molecule of free inorganic phosphate

options.zh: HCO3−、天冬氨酸和一分子 ATP，另需一分子无机磷酸
options.en: HCO3-, aspartate and one ATP, together with one inorganic phosphate

options.zh: CO2、谷氨酸和三分子 ATP，磷酸基由其中一个 ATP 提供
options.en: CO2, glutamate and three ATP, with the phosphate from one of them

options.zh: HCO3−、氨和两分子 ATP，磷酸基由后一个 ATP 提供
options.en: HCO3-, ammonia and two ATP, the phosphate coming from the later ATP

quiz.explain_zh: CPS 用的碳源是碳酸氢根 HCO3− 而不是溶解的 CO2，氮源是氨（CPS-II 就地从谷氨酰胺酰胺氮取氨），两分子 ATP 一个用来活化 HCO3−、一个把磷酸交给产物，所以不需要额外投入游离磷酸——老师列式子时多写的正是这一项。天冬氨酸要到下一步（天冬氨酸转氨甲酰酶）才加进来，谷氨酸不是这个反应的底物，三分子 ATP 的写法也没有依据。
quiz.explain_en: The carbon source is bicarbonate rather than dissolved CO2, the nitrogen is ammonia (CPS-II generates it in place from the glutamine amide), and of the two ATP one activates bicarbonate while the other hands over the phosphate, so no free phosphate is required — that is precisely the extra term in his equation. Aspartate enters only at the next step, via aspartate transcarbamoylase; glutamate is not a substrate here; and three ATP has no basis.

quiz.q_zh: CPS-1 与 CPS-2 的区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What distinguishes CPS-1 from CPS-2?

options.zh: CPS-1 在胞质供嘧啶合成，CPS-2 在线粒体供尿素循环
options.en: CPS-1 is cytosolic and feeds pyrimidines, CPS-2 is mitochondrial and feeds urea

options.zh: 两者是同一个酶的两种同工型，区别只在于组织分布不同
options.en: They are two isoforms of one enzyme, differing only in tissue distribution

options.zh: CPS-1 用谷氨酰胺作氮源，CPS-2 直接用游离的氨作氮源
options.en: CPS-1 takes its nitrogen from glutamine, CPS-2 takes it from free ammonia

options.zh: CPS-1 在线粒体供尿素循环，CPS-2 在胞质供嘧啶合成
options.en: CPS-1 is mitochondrial and feeds urea, CPS-2 is cytosolic and feeds pyrimidines

quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 在肝细胞线粒体基质里工作、需要 N-乙酰谷氨酸激活，产物供尿素循环；CPS-2 在胞质，是嘧啶从头合成的限速步。把两者的位置和用途对调是最常见的错法；它们由不同基因编码，是不同的酶而不是同工型；氮源也正好讲反了，CPS-1 用游离氨，CPS-2 用谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮。
quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 works in the hepatocyte mitochondrial matrix, needs N-acetylglutamate as activator, and supplies the urea cycle; CPS-2 is cytosolic and is the rate-limiting step of pyrimidine de novo synthesis. Swapping their locations and roles is the commonest error; they are products of different genes, not isoforms; and the nitrogen sources are inverted too, since CPS-1 uses free ammonia while CPS-2 uses the glutamine amide.

title_zh: 嘧啶的补救合成：分两步，可以先做核苷再上磷酸
title_en: Pyrimidine salvage: two steps, with the option of making the nucleoside first

points.zh: 他先回头复习嘌呤那条路，好让两边对比：A、I、G 三个碱基直接加 PRPP。
points.en: He first recaps the purine route so the two can be compared: the bases A, I and G go straight onto PRPP.

points.zh: 一步就变成 AMP、IMP、GMP 的样子，最终产物都是单磷酸形式。
points.en: In one step they become AMP, IMP and GMP, and the products are all monophosphates.

points.zh: 但嘧啶的补救合成不是一步到位，它是分为两步的。
points.en: Pyrimidine salvage, by contrast, is not a single step but two.

points.zh: 对 U 和 T 来说，可以和上面同一个底物 PRPP 结合，直接生成嘧啶核苷酸。
points.en: For U and T, the base can combine with the same substrate PRPP and give a pyrimidine nucleotide directly.

points.zh: 也可以不走 PRPP：尿嘧啶直接加一个核糖，就生成尿嘧啶核苷，这时候还没有磷酸。
points.en: Or it can bypass PRPP: uracil takes a sugar directly to give uridine, which as yet carries no phosphate.

points.zh: 尿嘧啶核苷再消耗一分子 ATP，进一步磷酸化就变成 UMP。
points.en: Uridine then consumes one ATP and is phosphorylated to UMP.

points.zh: 对胞嘧啶来说，他说它只能在核苷的形式下、由核苷激酶生成 CMP，并补写上 C 在这里也能发挥作用。
points.en: For cytosine he says it can only go through the nucleoside form, phosphorylated by a nucleoside kinase to CMP, and he adds C to the diagram at that point.

points.zh: 要记的第二句话：嘧啶的补救合成可以发生在核苷的水平，也可以发生在单磷酸的水平。
points.en: Second sentence to memorise: pyrimidine salvage can occur at the nucleoside level as well as at the monophosphate level.

points.zh: 这就是嘧啶和嘌呤的那一点区别：嘌呤的补救只能落在单磷酸产物这个水平上。
points.en: That is the difference from purines, whose salvage lands only at the monophosphate level.

extra.zh: 他在这里以及后面的小结里把「碱基 + PRPP → 单磷酸核苷酸」叫成嘌呤的「从头合成」，与他自己从 01:25:28 起的正确说法（补救途径）自相矛盾，01:35:46 一句话里两个词还同时出现。正确的划分是：从头合成 (de novo) 从 PRPP 开始、经十步逐个原子拼出 IMP，限速步是谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶；用现成碱基一步生成核苷酸的是补救 (salvage)，由 HGPRT 和 APRT 催化。补救省下的正是那十步的 ATP，这也是它存在的理由。
extra.en: Here and in his summary he calls base + PRPP giving a monophosphate nucleotide purine de novo synthesis, contradicting his own correct labelling from 01:25:28 on; at 01:35:46 both terms appear in one sentence. The correct split: de novo synthesis starts from PRPP and builds IMP atom by atom over ten steps, rate-limited by glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase; making a nucleotide in one step from a ready-made base is salvage, catalysed by HGPRT and APRT. What salvage saves is exactly the ATP of those ten steps, which is why it exists.

extra.zh: 「尿嘧啶直接加一个核糖」不准确。这一步由核苷磷酸化酶家族催化（尿苷磷酸化酶、胸苷磷酸化酶），糖供体是 1-磷酸核糖 / 1-磷酸脱氧核糖，不是游离核糖；反应可逆，逆向就是降解时把核苷拆成碱基 + 1-磷酸核糖。
extra.en: Uracil taking a sugar directly is not accurate. The step is catalysed by nucleoside phosphorylases (uridine phosphorylase, thymidine phosphorylase) and the sugar donor is ribose-1-phosphate or deoxyribose-1-phosphate, not free ribose; the reaction is reversible, and run backwards it is the catabolic cleavage of a nucleoside into base plus ribose-1-phosphate.

extra.zh: 「胞嘧啶只能在核苷水平生成 CMP」这个结论对，但主语应是胞苷 (cytidine)：哺乳动物没有把游离胞嘧啶接到 PRPP 上的转移酶，游离胞嘧啶基本不被补救；实际走的是胞苷经尿苷-胞苷激酶 (uridine-cytidine kinase) + ATP → CMP。他补的那句「C 也能在这里发挥作用」说得含糊，指的正是胞苷这个核苷。
extra.en: His conclusion that cytosine can only be salvaged at the nucleoside level is right, but the subject should be cytidine: mammals have no transferase that puts free cytosine onto PRPP, and free cytosine is essentially not salvaged. The real route is cytidine plus ATP through uridine-cytidine kinase to CMP. His vague added remark that C also works here refers to that nucleoside.

extra.zh: 01:27:06 他曾说「嘧啶的补救里有的东西只能在双磷酸或者三磷酸的水平下发生」，到这里（01:37:27）他自己改成了核苷水平和单磷酸水平，后一种说法才是对的。二磷酸水平确实有重要反应，但那是核糖核苷酸还原酶的脱氧反应，属于后面一节，不是补救。
extra.en: At 01:27:06 he said parts of pyrimidine salvage happen only at the di- or triphosphate level; here at 01:37:27 he revises this himself to the nucleoside and monophosphate levels, and the later version is the correct one. There is an important diphosphate-level reaction, but it is the reduction by ribonucleotide reductase in the next section, not salvage.

quiz.q_zh: 课上要记的第二句话是：嘧啶的补救合成可以发生在哪些水平？
quiz.q_en: The second sentence he asks you to memorise: at which levels can pyrimidine salvage occur?

options.zh: 只能发生在单磷酸水平，与嘌呤的补救完全一样
options.en: Only at the monophosphate level, exactly as purine salvage does

options.zh: 只能发生在二磷酸和三磷酸水平，不经过核苷阶段
options.en: Only at the di- and triphosphate levels, never via a nucleoside

options.zh: 既可以在核苷水平，也可以在单磷酸水平，两条都通
options.en: At the nucleoside level and at the monophosphate level, both work

options.zh: 只能发生在核苷水平，磷酸要等掺入核酸时才加上
options.en: Only at the nucleoside level, with phosphate added on incorporation

quiz.explain_zh: 尿嘧啶和胸腺嘧啶可以像嘌呤一样与 PRPP 一步成单磷酸核苷酸，也可以先与糖结合成核苷、再由激酶消耗 ATP 磷酸化成 UMP，所以核苷和单磷酸两个水平都能发生。只能在单磷酸水平那是嘌呤的口诀；二磷酸和三磷酸是他 01:27:06 的旧说法，到这里已经自己改成核苷/单磷酸；说磷酸要等掺入核酸时才加，则与核苷激酶这一步直接矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: Uracil and thymine can go onto PRPP in one step like purines, or can first form a nucleoside with the sugar and then be phosphorylated to UMP by a kinase at the cost of one ATP, so both levels are available. Monophosphate-only is the purine rule; the di- and triphosphate version is his earlier statement at 01:27:06, revised here; and holding the phosphate back until incorporation contradicts the nucleoside kinase step itself.

quiz.q_zh: 「游离碱基 + PRPP 一步生成核苷酸」这条路的正确名称和催化它的酶是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct name for free base plus PRPP giving a nucleotide in one step, and which enzymes catalyse it?

options.zh: 补救途径，由核苷磷酸化酶催化，主要用于分解多余的游离碱基
options.en: Salvage, run by nucleoside phosphorylase, to dispose of spare bases

options.zh: 从头合成，由腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶催化，终点是 IMP 的分叉
options.en: De novo, run by adenylosuccinate synthetase, ending at IMP branching

options.zh: 补救途径，由 HGPRT 和 APRT 催化，比从头合成省 ATP
options.en: Salvage, run by HGPRT and APRT, much cheaper in ATP than de novo

options.zh: 从头合成，由谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶催化的限速第一步
options.en: De novo, the rate-limiting step of glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase

quiz.explain_zh: 用现成碱基一步接到 PRPP 上得到核苷酸的是补救途径 salvage，催化的酶是 HGPRT（次黄嘌呤、鸟嘌呤）和 APRT（腺嘌呤），它省下的正是从头合成那十步的能量——这也是老师在这里说成「从头合成」的地方。谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶是从头合成真正的第一步、也是限速步；核苷磷酸化酶做的是核苷 + Pi ⇌ 碱基 + 1-磷酸核糖；腺苷酸代琥珀酸合成酶是 IMP → AMP 的酶。
quiz.explain_en: Attaching a ready-made base to PRPP in one step is salvage, catalysed by HGPRT (hypoxanthine, guanine) and APRT (adenine), and what it saves is the energy of the ten de novo steps — this is the reaction he mislabels as de novo here. Glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase is the genuine first and rate-limiting step of de novo synthesis; nucleoside phosphorylase interconverts nucleoside plus Pi with base plus ribose-1-phosphate; and adenylosuccinate synthetase serves IMP going to AMP.

quiz.q_zh: 尿嘧啶不走 PRPP、直接与糖结合生成尿嘧啶核苷时，糖供体究竟是什么？
quiz.q_en: When uracil bypasses PRPP and combines with sugar to give uridine, what is the sugar donor?

options.zh: 游离核糖，由核苷水解酶催化的可逆缩合反应
options.en: Free ribose, in a reversible condensation run by nucleoside hydrolase

options.zh: 1-磷酸核糖，由尿苷磷酸化酶催化的可逆反应
options.en: Ribose-1-phosphate, in a reversible reaction of uridine phosphorylase

options.zh: 5-磷酸核糖，由磷酸核糖转移酶催化的转移反应
options.en: Ribose-5-phosphate, in a transfer run by a phosphoribosyltransferase

options.zh: UDP-葡萄糖，由糖基转移酶催化的糖基化反应
options.en: UDP-glucose, in a glycosylation catalysed by a glycosyltransferase

quiz.explain_zh: 这一步由核苷磷酸化酶家族（尿苷磷酸化酶、胸苷磷酸化酶）催化，糖供体是 1-磷酸核糖，反应可逆，所以课上说的「直接加一个核糖」不准确。游离核糖不能这样直接成糖苷键，核苷水解酶跑的是相反方向；5-磷酸核糖必须先活化成 PRPP 才能被磷酸核糖转移酶使用；UDP-葡萄糖是糖原和糖蛋白合成里的糖基供体，与核苷酸补救无关。
quiz.explain_en: The step is run by the nucleoside phosphorylases (uridine and thymidine phosphorylase) with ribose-1-phosphate as donor, and it is reversible, so taking a plain ribose is not accurate. Free ribose cannot form the glycosidic bond this way and nucleoside hydrolase runs the opposite direction; ribose-5-phosphate must first be activated to PRPP before a phosphoribosyltransferase can use it; and UDP-glucose is the sugar donor of glycogen and glycoprotein synthesis, unrelated to nucleotide salvage.

title_zh: 两条补救路用的是不同的酶，几条路并行；核苷酸合成整段小结
title_en: Different enzymes for the two salvage routes, all running in parallel; summary of the whole section

points.zh: 学生问：核苷和单磷酸是不同的步骤吗？他答：这是两种酶。
points.en: A student asks whether the nucleoside and monophosphate versions are different steps; he answers that they are two different enzymes.

points.zh: 嘌呤那边他说「它是一种酶」，念出来的名字是 APRT 和 HGPRT，说这个酶的名字非常非常长。
points.en: On the purine side he says it is one enzyme, reads out the names APRT and HGPRT, and remarks that the name is very long.

points.zh: 嘌呤这一步直接把碱基加到 PRPP 上面，一步就生成单磷酸的腺苷酸。
points.en: The purine step puts the base straight onto PRPP and gives the monophosphate nucleotide in one move.

points.zh: 嘧啶那边可以先生成不带磷酸的核苷，再由另外一个酶给它上一个磷酸，所以是两种不同的途径。
points.en: On the pyrimidine side a phosphate-free nucleoside can be made first and a second enzyme then adds the phosphate, so these are two distinct routes.

points.zh: 学生再问：这四条是按 1、2、3、4 排序发生的，还是并行的？他答：并行的，这几种都可以发生。
points.en: The student asks whether the four routes run in sequence or in parallel; he answers that they are parallel, all of them can happen.

points.zh: 嘧啶只是比嘌呤多一条可以走的路，最大的区别就是第二步它可以直接拿核糖。
points.en: Pyrimidines simply have one extra option; the single biggest difference is that the second route can take the sugar directly.

points.zh: 小结嘌呤：讲了从头合成里每个原子的来源，讲了补救合成（他说只有 PRPP 一种、产物都是单磷酸），还讲了次黄嘌呤怎么转变成腺嘌呤和鸟嘌呤。
points.en: Purine summary: where each atom of the ring comes from in de novo synthesis; salvage (which he says has only the PRPP form, always giving monophosphates); and how hypoxanthine is converted to adenine and guanine.

points.zh: 小结嘧啶：从头合成只讲了左边那一坨就是氨甲酰磷酸，为了区分特地讲了 CPS-2 与尿素循环的 CPS-1 功能不同。
points.en: Pyrimidine summary: of de novo synthesis only the carbamoyl phosphate on the left, with CPS-2 singled out to distinguish it from CPS-1 of the urea cycle.

points.zh: 嘧啶的补救有两种可选：既可以用 PRPP 为底物，也可以用核糖为底物；他强调讲到这里为止全部都是单磷酸的形式。
points.en: Pyrimidine salvage has two options, PRPP or the sugar as substrate; and he stresses that everything so far has been at the monophosphate level.

extra.zh: 「APRT 和 HGPRT 是一种酶」是错的，它们是两种不同的酶，底物特异性不同：APRT（腺嘌呤磷酸核糖转移酶）把腺嘌呤变成 AMP；HGPRT（次黄嘌呤-鸟嘌呤磷酸核糖转移酶）把次黄嘌呤变成 IMP、鸟嘌呤变成 GMP。所以产物也不都是「单磷酸的腺苷酸」。他自己把两个名字都念了出来。HGPRT 缺陷就是 Lesch-Nyhan 综合征。
extra.en: APRT and HGPRT are not one enzyme but two, with different base specificities: APRT (adenine phosphoribosyltransferase) turns adenine into AMP, while HGPRT (hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase) turns hypoxanthine into IMP and guanine into GMP. So the product is not always adenylate. He reads out both names himself. Loss of HGPRT is Lesch-Nyhan syndrome.

extra.zh: 「嘌呤的补救只有一种、只能以 PRPP 为底物、只能在单磷酸水平」说得太绝对。腺苷激酶 (adenosine kinase) 可以用 ATP 把腺苷这个核苷直接磷酸化成 AMP，这正是嘌呤在核苷水平的补救路线；核苷磷酸化酶的可逆反应也能在碱基与核苷之间来回。作为与嘧啶对比的口诀可以用，但不能说成唯一路线。
extra.en: Saying purine salvage has only one form, only from PRPP and only at the monophosphate level is too absolute. Adenosine kinase phosphorylates the nucleoside adenosine directly to AMP using ATP — that is purine salvage at the nucleoside level — and the reversible nucleoside phosphorylase reaction also moves between base and nucleoside. As a contrast with pyrimidines the slogan is usable, but it is not the only route.

extra.zh: 补救之所以重要，不只是省 ATP。脑、骨髓和外周血细胞的从头合成能力很弱，几乎完全依赖补救回收循环里的碱基，这也是为什么 HGPRT 缺失会同时打出两种后果：一方面次黄嘌呤和鸟嘌呤回收不了，全部倒向尿酸，出现严重高尿酸血症；另一方面用不掉的 PRPP 堆积，反过来推高从头合成，使尿酸产量进一步上升。
extra.en: Salvage matters for more than ATP economy. Brain, bone marrow and peripheral blood cells have weak de novo capacity and depend almost entirely on recycling bases, which is why losing HGPRT causes two things at once: hypoxanthine and guanine cannot be recycled and pour into urate, giving severe hyperuricaemia, while unused PRPP accumulates and drives de novo synthesis harder, raising urate production further.

extra.zh: 小结里「嘌呤的从头合成」这个词被他用了两次，指的不是同一件事：说「从头合成就是它里边每个碳原子是在哪来的」时是对的；说「从头合成就是 A、I、G 三个碱基直接加 PRPP」时指的其实是补救。判断标准很简单——有没有现成的碱基。有现成碱基就是补救，没有、要一个原子一个原子在 PRPP 上搭出来才是从头。
extra.en: He uses the phrase purine de novo synthesis twice in the summary for two different things: saying de novo synthesis is about where each ring atom comes from is correct; saying it is A, I and G going straight onto PRPP describes salvage. The test is simple — is there a ready-made base? If yes it is salvage; if the ring has to be built atom by atom on PRPP it is de novo.

quiz.q_zh: APRT 和 HGPRT 之间是什么关系？
quiz.q_en: What is the relationship between APRT and HGPRT?

options.zh: 是两种酶，APRT 管腺嘌呤，HGPRT 管次黄嘌呤和鸟嘌呤
options.en: Two enzymes: APRT handles adenine, HGPRT handles hypoxanthine and guanine

options.zh: 是同一个酶的两种不同写法，底物范围和产物完全一致
options.en: Two names for one enzyme, identical in substrate range and product

options.zh: 是同一个酶的两个亚基，必须结合起来才有转移酶活性
options.en: Two subunits of one enzyme that must assemble for transferase activity

options.zh: 是两种酶，APRT 管次黄嘌呤和鸟嘌呤，HGPRT 管腺嘌呤
options.en: Two enzymes: APRT handles hypoxanthine and guanine, HGPRT handles adenine

quiz.explain_zh: APRT（腺嘌呤磷酸核糖转移酶）把腺嘌呤变成 AMP，HGPRT（次黄嘌呤-鸟嘌呤磷酸核糖转移酶）把次黄嘌呤变成 IMP、鸟嘌呤变成 GMP，是碱基特异性不同的两种酶——课上说「它是一种酶」是错的，老师自己把两个名字都念了出来。把两者的底物对调也不对；它们各自独立成酶，不是同一个酶的亚基，HGPRT 完全缺失就是 Lesch-Nyhan 综合征。
quiz.explain_en: APRT (adenine phosphoribosyltransferase) converts adenine to AMP and HGPRT (hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase) converts hypoxanthine to IMP and guanine to GMP: two enzymes with different base specificities, so calling them one enzyme is wrong even though he reads out both names. Swapping their substrates is equally wrong; they are independent enzymes rather than subunits, and complete HGPRT loss is Lesch-Nyhan syndrome.

quiz.q_zh: 课上说嘌呤的补救「只有 PRPP 这一种」。哪一条说明它并不是唯一路线？
quiz.q_en: He says purine salvage exists only in the PRPP form. Which fact shows that is not the only route?

options.zh: 黄嘌呤氧化酶能把黄嘌呤在核苷水平还原成鸟苷酸
options.en: Xanthine oxidase reduces xanthine to guanylate at the nucleoside level

options.zh: 腺苷脱氨酶能把腺苷在核苷水平直接转变成 AMP
options.en: Adenosine deaminase converts adenosine straight into AMP as a nucleoside

options.zh: 腺苷激酶能用 ATP 把腺苷在核苷水平磷酸化成 AMP
options.en: Adenosine kinase uses ATP to phosphorylate adenosine to AMP as a nucleoside

options.zh: 胸苷酸合酶能把腺嘌呤在碱基水平直接磷酸化成 AMP
options.en: Thymidylate synthase phosphorylates adenine to AMP at the base level

quiz.explain_zh: 腺苷激酶 adenosine kinase 直接用 ATP 把腺苷磷酸化成 AMP，这是嘌呤在核苷水平的补救，所以「只有 PRPP 一种」讲得太绝对；核苷磷酸化酶的可逆反应同样能在碱基与核苷之间来回。黄嘌呤氧化酶只做氧化（次黄嘌呤→黄嘌呤→尿酸），不做还原也不生成鸟苷酸；腺苷脱氨酶把腺苷变成肌苷并放出氨，方向是降解；胸苷酸合酶作用于 dUMP，与腺嘌呤无关。
quiz.explain_en: Adenosine kinase phosphorylates adenosine to AMP with ATP, which is purine salvage at the nucleoside level, so only-PRPP is too absolute; the reversible nucleoside phosphorylase reaction also moves between base and nucleoside. Xanthine oxidase only oxidises (hypoxanthine to xanthine to urate) and makes no guanylate; adenosine deaminase turns adenosine into inosine with release of ammonia, a catabolic direction; and thymidylate synthase acts on dUMP and has nothing to do with adenine.

title_zh: 脱氧核苷酸的生成：A、U、C、G 在二磷酸水平被还原
title_en: Making deoxyribonucleotides: A, U, C and G are reduced at the diphosphate level

points.zh: 他先划定前面讲过的范围：到目前为止全部都是单磷酸的形式，也全部是非脱氧的，名字里都没有带 D。
points.en: He first marks off what has been covered: everything so far has been monophosphate and everything has been non-deoxy, with no D in the name.

points.zh: 剩下两个问题：三磷酸的形式怎么合成，脱氧的这些东西又是怎么合成的。
points.en: Two questions remain: how the triphosphate forms are made, and how the deoxy compounds are made.

points.zh: dNTP 的定义有两点：第一它带三个磷酸，TP 就是这个意思；第二它是脱氧的。
points.en: A dNTP is defined by two things: it carries three phosphates, which is what TP means, and it is deoxygenated.

points.zh: 脱氧发生在核糖的 2 位，是把 2 位那个位置的氧脱掉。
points.en: The deoxygenation is at position 2 of the ribose, where the oxygen is removed.

points.zh: dNTP 的合成主要有两种途径，他按碱基把它们分开讲。
points.en: He says dNTP synthesis has two main routes and splits them by base.

points.zh: 第一条以 A、U、C、G 这四个为底物；T 还没讲，因为胸腺嘧啶这个玩意儿是特立独行的。
points.en: The first route takes A, U, C and G as substrates; T is held back because thymine behaves on its own.

points.zh: 还原反应发生在二磷酸水平，也就是还没有脱氧的 NDP 这种形式上。
points.en: The reduction happens at the diphosphate level, on the still-oxygenated NDP form.

points.zh: 反应本身就是在 2 位这个位置把羟基还原成单个的氢。
points.en: The reaction itself reduces the hydroxyl at position 2 down to a single hydrogen.

points.zh: 要打括号记的：A、U、C、G 这四种碱基的 dNTP 合成是在二磷酸的水平下进行的；还原完之后再由一个激酶给它上一个磷酸，就变回三磷酸。
points.en: The point to bracket and memorise: for A, U, C and G the deoxy step happens at the diphosphate level, after which a kinase adds one more phosphate to restore the triphosphate.

extra.zh: 酶名他没有给：这是核糖核苷酸还原酶 (ribonucleotide reductase, RNR)，底物就是 ADP、GDP、CDP、UDP 四种二磷酸核苷酸。它靠活性位点上的自由基化学把 2′-OH 换成 H，还原力经硫氧还蛋白 / 谷氧还蛋白最终由 NADPH 提供。酶上有活性位点和特异性位点两套别构位点，用 ATP/dATP/dTTP/dGTP 的占位来平衡四种 dNTP 的比例；dATP 高时全面关闭酶（这正是 ADA 缺陷导致 SCID 的分子解释）。羟基脲就是抑制 RNR 的药。
extra.en: He does not name the enzyme: it is ribonucleotide reductase (RNR), acting on ADP, GDP, CDP and UDP. Radical chemistry at its active site replaces the 2'-OH with H, with reducing power delivered through thioredoxin or glutaredoxin from NADPH. Two classes of allosteric site, activity and specificity, are occupied by ATP, dATP, dTTP and dGTP to balance the four dNTP pools; high dATP shuts the enzyme down entirely, which is the molecular explanation for SCID in ADA deficiency. Hydroxyurea is the drug that inhibits RNR.

extra.zh: 「dNTP 的合成主要有两种途径」这句话在他这里是按 T 与非 T 划分的，而教材里核苷酸合成的两条途径通常指从头与补救。脱氧核苷酸也有自己的补救：胸苷激酶 TK1、脱氧胞苷激酶 dCK 可以直接把脱氧核苷磷酸化成 dNMP，抗病毒药阿昔洛韦、齐多夫定就是走这条路被激活的。
extra.en: His two routes are a split between T and the rest, whereas in textbooks the two routes of nucleotide synthesis usually mean de novo and salvage. Deoxyribonucleotides have their own salvage: thymidine kinase TK1 and deoxycytidine kinase dCK phosphorylate deoxynucleosides directly to dNMPs, and this is how antivirals such as aciclovir and zidovudine get activated.

extra.zh: 顺序是固定的，中间不回到单磷酸：NDP →（RNR）→ dNDP →（核苷二磷酸激酶 NDPK）→ dNTP。所以「二磷酸水平脱氧」与「细胞用三磷酸做底物」并不矛盾，两件事发生在相邻的两步上。
extra.en: The order is fixed and never returns to the monophosphate: NDP to dNDP by RNR, then dNDP to dNTP by nucleoside diphosphate kinase. So reducing at the diphosphate level and polymerising from the triphosphate are not in conflict; they are two adjacent steps.

extra.zh: 2′ 位被还原成氢不是化学上的小事，它就是 DNA 比 RNA 稳定的原因：没有 2′-OH，就没有那个能对相邻磷酸二酯键发起分子内亲核进攻的基团，因此 DNA 在碱性条件下不像 RNA 那样自发断裂。这正好解释了为什么遗传信息存在 DNA 里而不是 RNA 里。
extra.en: Reducing the 2' position is not a small chemical detail: it is why DNA is more stable than RNA. Without the 2'-OH there is no group to mount an intramolecular nucleophilic attack on the neighbouring phosphodiester bond, so DNA does not undergo the spontaneous alkaline cleavage RNA does — which is exactly why genetic information is stored as DNA.

quiz.q_zh: A、U、C、G 的核糖被还原成脱氧核糖，发生在哪个水平、由什么酶完成？
quiz.q_en: For A, U, C and G, at which level is the ribose reduced to deoxyribose, and by which enzyme?

options.zh: 二磷酸水平（NDP），由核糖核苷酸还原酶 RNR 完成
options.en: At the diphosphate level (NDP), by ribonucleotide reductase RNR

options.zh: 三磷酸水平（NTP），由核苷二磷酸激酶 NDPK 完成
options.en: At the triphosphate level (NTP), by nucleoside diphosphate kinase NDPK

options.zh: 核苷水平，由脱氧核苷激酶在核苷上直接还原完成
options.en: At the nucleoside level, reduced directly by a deoxynucleoside kinase

options.zh: 单磷酸水平（NMP），由核糖核苷酸还原酶 RNR 完成
options.en: At the monophosphate level (NMP), by ribonucleotide reductase RNR

quiz.explain_zh: RNR 的底物正是 ADP、GDP、CDP、UDP 四种二磷酸核苷酸，把 2′-OH 还原成氢得到 dNDP，还原力经硫氧还蛋白由 NADPH 供给，这与课上「在二磷酸的水平下进行」一致。RNR 不接受单磷酸或三磷酸底物；核苷二磷酸激酶只做磷酸转移、不做还原；脱氧核苷激酶属于脱氧核苷的补救磷酸化，本身也不还原糖。
quiz.explain_en: RNR acts precisely on ADP, GDP, CDP and UDP, reducing the 2'-OH to hydrogen to give dNDPs, with reducing power delivered from NADPH via thioredoxin — matching his statement that it happens at the diphosphate level. RNR does not take mono- or triphosphate substrates; nucleoside diphosphate kinase only transfers phosphate and does no reduction; and deoxynucleoside kinases perform salvage phosphorylation without touching the sugar.

quiz.q_zh: 细胞要从 ADP 得到 dATP，正确的先后顺序是什么？
quiz.q_en: To get from ADP to dATP, what is the correct order of events?

options.zh: ADP 先脱去碱基，核糖还原后再把腺嘌呤重新接回去
options.en: ADP loses its base, the sugar is reduced, then adenine is reattached

options.zh: ADP 先被 RNR 还原成 dADP，再由激酶磷酸化成 dATP
options.en: ADP is reduced by RNR to dADP, then phosphorylated by a kinase to dATP

options.zh: ADP 先被激酶磷酸化成 ATP，再由 RNR 还原成 dATP
options.en: ADP is first phosphorylated to ATP, then reduced by RNR to dATP

options.zh: ADP 先水解成 AMP，被 RNR 还原后再连加两个磷酸
options.en: ADP is hydrolysed to AMP, reduced by RNR, then given two phosphates

quiz.explain_zh: 还原这一步只认二磷酸底物，所以顺序固定为 ADP →（RNR）→ dADP →（核苷二磷酸激酶）→ dATP，正是课上说的「还原掉以后再有一个激酶给它上一个磷酸」。先磷酸化成 ATP 再还原不成立，RNR 不接受三磷酸；退回 AMP 再还原同样不成立，中间不需要回到单磷酸；把碱基卸下来再接回去更不可能，糖苷键在这条路上始终没有断过。
quiz.explain_en: Reduction accepts only diphosphate substrates, so the order is fixed: ADP to dADP by RNR, then dADP to dATP by nucleoside diphosphate kinase — exactly his remark that after reduction a kinase adds one more phosphate. Phosphorylating to ATP first fails because RNR does not take triphosphates; dropping back to AMP is unnecessary and equally wrong; and removing and reattaching the base is impossible, since the glycosidic bond is never broken along this route.

title_zh: T 这一支的特殊性，以及非脱氧的 T 与脱氧的 U
title_en: Why the T branch is different, plus non-deoxy T and deoxy U

points.zh: 接着看 TMP，也就是碱基为胸腺嘧啶的时候这个东西是怎么合成的。
points.en: He turns to TMP, that is, how the compound is made when the base is thymine.

points.zh: 他说这个东西只能在单磷酸的水平下进行，脱氧的 TTP 或者 TMP 都行，但发生还原、发生脱氧只在单磷酸水平。
points.en: He says this one only works at the monophosphate level: reduction and deoxygenation happen there and nowhere else.

points.zh: 要记的第三句：dTMP 只在单磷酸的水平发生反应。
points.en: Third sentence to memorise: dTMP reacts only at the monophosphate level.

points.zh: 学生问 dTMP 是不是所有碱基里都存在，他答：只要带上 D 它就是 DNA 的，前面讨论的全部都是 RNA 的，也就是不脱氧的。
points.en: Asked whether dTMP exists for all bases, he answers that anything with a D belongs to DNA, whereas everything discussed before was RNA, that is, non-deoxy.

points.zh: 归纳一句：只有 T 是在单磷酸水平脱氧，剩下的四个是在二磷酸水平脱氧；脱氧就是它从 RNA 变成 DNA。
points.en: His summary line: only T is deoxygenated at the monophosphate level while the other four are done at the diphosphate level, and deoxygenation is what turns RNA into DNA.

points.zh: 学生追问：我们不是一直在聊 ATCG、那不都是 DNA 吗？他答：要这样想——现在讲的是代谢。
points.en: The student presses: we have been talking about ATCG all along, isn't that DNA? He replies that one has to remember this section is about metabolism.

points.zh: 在人体内其实存在不脱氧的 T，也就是核糖形式的胸腺嘧啶核苷酸，因为往常的认知是 RNA 里 U 取代了 T。
points.en: In the human body there really is a non-deoxy T, a ribose-form thymine nucleotide, contrary to the usual belief that U replaces T in RNA.

points.zh: 这种非脱氧的 T 是真实存在的，只不过它不会掺入到 RNA 里边而已。
points.en: That non-deoxy T genuinely exists; it simply does not get incorporated into RNA.

points.zh: 所以前面讨论时五种碱基是一起讲的，只有到 DNA 这里才单独区分，因为 DNA 里一点 U 都没有；他随即又犹豫「好像也有脱氧的 U」，说笔记里写了有，但不知道它有什么功能，因为它也不会掺入 DNA。
points.en: So the bases were treated together earlier and only separated at DNA, because DNA contains no U at all — then he hesitates, saying deoxy U seems to exist after all, that his notes list it, but that he does not know what it does since it too is not incorporated into DNA.

extra.zh: 「dTMP 只能在单磷酸水平发生还原、发生脱氧」把两件事说混了。脱氧这一步 T 也是在二磷酸水平完成的：RNR 把 UDP 还原成 dUDP，和 ADP、GDP、CDP 完全一样，dUDP 再去磷酸成 dUMP。T 真正特殊的地方不是还原而是甲基化——胸苷酸合酶 (thymidylate synthase) 用 N5,N10-亚甲基四氢叶酸把 dUMP 甲基化成 dTMP，这一步确实发生在单磷酸水平。他把「单磷酸水平的甲基化」说成了「单磷酸水平的还原」。
extra.en: Saying dTMP is reduced and deoxygenated only at the monophosphate level conflates two things. T is deoxygenated at the diphosphate level like everything else: RNR reduces UDP to dUDP exactly as it does ADP, GDP and CDP, and dUDP is then dephosphorylated to dUMP. What is special about T is not reduction but methylation — thymidylate synthase methylates dUMP to dTMP using N5,N10-methylene-THF, and that step really does occur at the monophosphate level. He has described monophosphate-level methylation as monophosphate-level reduction.

extra.zh: 「不知道脱氧的 U 有什么功能」「它也不会掺入 DNA」两句都不成立。dUMP 正是 dTMP 唯一的直接前体，整条胸苷酸合成都要经过它；而 dUTP 确实会被 DNA 聚合酶误当成 dTTP 掺进 DNA 与 A 配对，细胞因此备了两道防线：dUTP 焦磷酸酶 (dUTPase) 把 dUTP 降成 dUMP 压低 dUTP/dTTP 比值，尿嘧啶-DNA 糖苷酶 (UNG) 把已经掺进去的尿嘧啶切下来走碱基切除修复。
extra.en: Both claims — that deoxy U has no known function and that it never enters DNA — are wrong. dUMP is the sole direct precursor of dTMP, so all thymidylate synthesis runs through it; and dUTP is indeed misincorporated by DNA polymerase opposite A, which is why cells keep two defences: dUTPase degrades dUTP to dUMP to hold the dUTP/dTTP ratio down, and uracil-DNA glycosylase (UNG) excises incorporated uracil for base excision repair.

extra.zh: 他说人体存在不脱氧的 T，这是对的，但可以说得更具体：tRNA 的 TψC 环里就有核糖胸苷（5-甲基尿苷 m5U54）。它不是靠掺入 rTTP 得到的，而是转录后由甲基转移酶以 SAM 为甲基供体，把已经在链上的尿苷甲基化而成——所以「不掺入 RNA」准确说是「不作为聚合酶底物掺入」，这两句合起来才自洽。
extra.en: His claim that a non-deoxy T exists in the body is correct and can be made concrete: the TψC loop of tRNA contains ribothymidine (5-methyluridine, m5U54). It does not arrive by incorporation of rTTP but is made post-transcriptionally, a methyltransferase using SAM to methylate a uridine already in the chain — so not incorporated into RNA means, precisely, not incorporated as a polymerase substrate.

extra.zh: 这一段的临床落点全在药理上：5-氟尿嘧啶在体内变成 FdUMP，与胸苷酸合酶和亚甲基四氢叶酸形成共价三元复合物把酶卡死；甲氨蝶呤抑制二氢叶酸还原酶，断掉四氢叶酸的再生，于是同时掐死 dTMP 的甲基供应和嘌呤环 C2、C8 所需的 N10-甲酰四氢叶酸——嘌呤环上那两个碳用的是甲酰基（甲酸氧化态）而不是甲基，这正是甲氨蝶呤能一并打击嘌呤从头合成的原因。
extra.en: The clinical payoff here is pharmacological: 5-fluorouracil becomes FdUMP and traps thymidylate synthase in a covalent ternary complex with methylene-THF; methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, cutting off THF regeneration and so choking both the methyl supply for dTMP and the N10-formyl-THF needed for C2 and C8 of the purine ring — those two purine carbons come from a formyl group at the oxidation level of formate, not a methyl, which is exactly why methotrexate hits purine de novo synthesis as well.

quiz.q_zh: 课上说 dTMP「只能在单磷酸水平发生还原脱氧」。真实情况是什么？
quiz.q_en: He says dTMP is reduced and deoxygenated only at the monophosphate level. What actually happens?

options.zh: 脱氧在三磷酸水平由 dUTPase 完成，甲基化在核苷水平进行
options.en: dUTPase deoxygenates at the triphosphate level; methylation is at nucleoside

options.zh: 脱氧和甲基化都在单磷酸水平，由胸苷酸合酶一步同时完成
options.en: Deoxygenation and methylation both occur in one thymidylate synthase step

options.zh: 脱氧同样在二磷酸水平由 RNR 完成，单磷酸水平做的是甲基化
options.en: RNR deoxygenates at the diphosphate level; methylation is the monophosphate step

options.zh: 脱氧确实只在单磷酸水平进行，而甲基化在二磷酸水平进行
options.en: Deoxygenation really is monophosphate-only; methylation is the diphosphate step

quiz.explain_zh: UDP 和 ADP、GDP、CDP 一样由 RNR 在二磷酸水平还原成 dUDP，再去磷酸成 dUMP；T 真正特殊的是甲基化——胸苷酸合酶用 N5,N10-亚甲基四氢叶酸把 dUMP 甲基化成 dTMP，这一步才在单磷酸水平。所以说脱氧只在单磷酸水平、或把甲基化挪到二磷酸水平都不对；dUTPase 做的是把 dUTP 水解成 dUMP，不是脱氧；胸苷酸合酶只做甲基转移，不还原糖。
quiz.explain_en: UDP is reduced by RNR at the diphosphate level to dUDP just like ADP, GDP and CDP, and dUDP is then dephosphorylated to dUMP; what is special about T is methylation, since thymidylate synthase methylates dUMP to dTMP with N5,N10-methylene-THF, and only that step is at the monophosphate level. So confining deoxygenation to the monophosphate level, or moving methylation to the diphosphate level, are both wrong; dUTPase hydrolyses dUTP to dUMP rather than deoxygenating anything; and thymidylate synthase transfers a methyl group without reducing the sugar.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说不知道脱氧的 U 有什么功能。dUMP 和 dUTP 在细胞里实际扮演什么角色？
quiz.q_en: He says he does not know what deoxy U is for. What do dUMP and dUTP actually do in the cell?

options.zh: dUMP 是 RNR 的别构激活剂，dUTP 则是复制起始的引物成分
options.en: dUMP allosterically activates RNR and dUTP primes replication start

options.zh: dUMP 是 RNA 里 U 的直接来源，dUTP 完全不会进入 DNA
options.en: dUMP is the direct source of the U in RNA, and dUTP never enters DNA

options.zh: dUMP 只是嘧啶降解的废物，靠 dUTPase 直接排出到细胞外
options.en: dUMP is merely a catabolic waste product, exported from cells by dUTPase

options.zh: dUMP 是 dTMP 的直接前体，dUTP 会被误掺入 DNA 里需清除
options.en: dUMP is the direct precursor of dTMP; misincorporated dUTP must be cleared

quiz.explain_zh: dUMP 是胸苷酸合酶的底物，也就是 dTMP 唯一的直接前体；同时 dUTP 会被 DNA 聚合酶当成 dTTP 掺进 DNA 与 A 配对，细胞因此用 dUTPase 把 dUTP 降成 dUMP 压低 dUTP/dTTP 比值，再用尿嘧啶-DNA 糖苷酶 UNG 把已掺入的尿嘧啶切除。RNA 里的 U 来自 UTP 而不是脱氧的 dUMP；dUTPase 是胞内酶，不负责往细胞外排东西；dUMP 也不是 RNR 的别构调节物，复制起始用的是 RNA 引物。
quiz.explain_en: dUMP is the substrate of thymidylate synthase and hence the only direct precursor of dTMP; meanwhile DNA polymerase does insert dUTP opposite A, so cells use dUTPase to degrade dUTP to dUMP and keep the dUTP/dTTP ratio low, and uracil-DNA glycosylase to excise uracil already in the strand. The U of RNA comes from UTP, not from deoxy dUMP; dUTPase is an intracellular enzyme and exports nothing; and dUMP is not an allosteric effector of RNR, while replication is primed by RNA.

quiz.q_zh: tRNA 里确实含有胸腺嘧啶（核糖胸苷 rT）。它是怎么来的？
quiz.q_en: tRNA really does contain thymine, as ribothymidine. How does it get there?

options.zh: 由胸苷酸合酶把 UMP 甲基化后再连接到 tRNA 的末端
options.en: Thymidylate synthase methylates UMP, which is then joined to the tRNA end

options.zh: 由 RNA 聚合酶把 rTTP 当作底物直接掺入转录产物中
options.en: RNA polymerase uses rTTP as a substrate and inserts it during transcription

options.zh: 由甲基转移酶在转录后把 tRNA 链上的尿苷甲基化而来
options.en: A methyltransferase methylates a uridine already in the tRNA after transcription

options.zh: 由 DNA 上的胸腺嘧啶在逆转录时被原样复制到 RNA 上
options.en: Thymine in DNA is copied across to RNA unchanged during reverse transcription

quiz.explain_zh: tRNA 的 TψC 环里那个核糖胸苷是转录后修饰的产物：m5U 甲基转移酶以 SAM 为甲基供体，把已经在链上的尿苷 54 甲基化成 5-甲基尿苷，所以细胞根本不需要 rTTP 这种底物——这也正好补上老师说的「不脱氧的 T 存在但不掺入 RNA」。RNA 聚合酶只用 ATP、GTP、CTP、UTP；逆转录是 RNA 到 DNA 的方向，不会把 DNA 的 T 搬进 RNA；胸苷酸合酶的底物是 dUMP 而不是 UMP，产物 dTMP 也不接到 tRNA 上。
quiz.explain_en: The ribothymidine in the TψC loop is a post-transcriptional modification: an m5U methyltransferase uses SAM to methylate uridine 54 already in the chain into 5-methyluridine, so no rTTP substrate is needed — which completes his remark that a non-deoxy T exists but is not incorporated into RNA. RNA polymerase uses only ATP, GTP, CTP and UTP; reverse transcription runs from RNA to DNA and cannot carry T the other way; and thymidylate synthase acts on dUMP rather than UMP, its product dTMP never being joined to tRNA.

title_zh: 课后选读章节导览：抗生素、激素、生物膜，以及光合作用的分量
title_en: Guide to the optional chapters: antibiotics, hormones, membranes, and where photosynthesis sits

points.zh: 他宣布静态生物化学加动态生物化学的经典内容到核苷酸代谢为止全部讲完，笔记后面剩下的都是选读内容。
points.en: He announces that the classical biochemistry course — static plus dynamic — is finished as of nucleotide metabolism; everything left in his notes is optional reading.

points.zh: 抗生素那一张基本不重要，他连星级都不标。
points.en: The antibiotics slide is essentially unimportant; he does not even give it a star rating.

points.zh: 激素给一星：大概看一下就行。
points.en: Hormones get one star: skim them and move on.

points.zh: 举例说甲状腺素是唯一带碘元素的激素。
points.en: As an example he notes that thyroid hormone is the only iodine-containing hormone.

points.zh: 肾上腺素结构比较简单，功能上让人兴奋、产生快感。
points.en: Adrenaline has a fairly simple structure; functionally it excites you and produces a rush.

points.zh: 肽类激素稍微看一下就 OK 了。
points.en: Peptide hormones deserve only a quick look.

points.zh: 离子通道他先说可以看，随即改口让学生不要看——不做信号通路的话看它没有意义，而且挺复杂；后面的信号通路同样不用太看。
points.en: He first suggests skimming ion channels, then reverses himself: without doing signal transduction it is pointless and fairly complicated. The signalling pathways that follow also need little attention.

points.zh: 生物膜给两星：膜长什么样、由什么组成，以及钠、钾、钙、氢离子和糖的几种运输机制，有个了解就行。
points.en: Biomembranes get two stars: what the membrane looks like, what it is made of, and the transport mechanisms for Na+, K+, Ca2+, H+ and sugars — a general acquaintance is enough.

points.zh: 光合作用给三星，因为可能要考；但他当场声明自己不敢保证讲的百分之百正确，只能给一个大概的概念，也摸不准国内教材把重点放在哪。
points.en: Photosynthesis gets three stars because it may be examined; but he states up front that he cannot guarantee everything he says is right, can only give a rough picture, and cannot tell where the Chinese textbooks put the emphasis.

extra.zh: 紧接在这一段之前（约 01:45:52）他说「不知道脱氧的 U 有什么功能，它也不会掺入到 DNA 里边」，两句都不成立。dUMP 正是 dTMP 的唯一直接前体：胸苷酸合酶（thymidylate synthase）用 N5,N10-亚甲基四氢叶酸把 dUMP 的 C5 甲基化成 dTMP——这一步是甲基化，不是还原。而且 dUTP 确实会被 DNA 聚合酶错掺进 DNA（与 A 配对），所以细胞留了两道防线：dUTPase 把 dUTP 降解成 dUMP 压低 dUTP/dTTP 比值，尿嘧啶-DNA 糖苷酶（UNG）把已掺入的尿嘧啶切掉走碱基切除修复。5-氟尿嘧啶就是卡在胸苷酸合酶这一步。
extra.en: Just before this stretch (around 01:45:52) he says he does not know what deoxy-U is for and that it cannot get into DNA. Both are wrong. dUMP is the sole direct precursor of dTMP: thymidylate synthase methylates C5 of dUMP using N5,N10-methylene-THF — a methylation, not a reduction. And dUTP genuinely is misincorporated by DNA polymerase (pairing with A), which is why cells keep two defences: dUTPase degrades dUTP to dUMP to keep the dUTP/dTTP ratio low, and uracil-DNA glycosylase (UNG) excises incorporated uracil for base-excision repair. 5-fluorouracil acts precisely at the thymidylate synthase step.

extra.zh: 他在前一段讲脱氧核苷酸时说 T「只能在单磷酸水平发生还原」。核糖核苷酸还原酶（RNR）对四种核糖核苷酸一视同仁，全部在二磷酸水平工作：ADP、GDP、CDP、UDP → dADP、dGDP、dCDP、dUDP。dUDP 再去磷酸成 dUMP。T 的特殊之处不在还原，而在那一步单磷酸水平的甲基化。
extra.en: Earlier he said T can only be reduced at the monophosphate level. Ribonucleotide reductase treats all four ribonucleotides alike and works at the diphosphate level: ADP, GDP, CDP and UDP become dADP, dGDP, dCDP and dUDP; dUDP is then dephosphorylated to dUMP. What is special about T is not the reduction but the methylation, which does happen at the monophosphate level.

extra.zh: 甲状腺素含碘这一点他说对了，但没说清 T4/T3 是在甲状腺球蛋白上的酪氨酸残基被碘化后偶联下来的。肾上腺素也来自酪氨酸：酪氨酸 → 多巴 → 多巴胺 → 去甲肾上腺素 → 肾上腺素，最后一步由 PNMT 用 SAM 供甲基——正好接上前面讲的 SAM 与一碳单位。
extra.en: He is right that thyroid hormone contains iodine, but does not say that T4/T3 are formed by iodinating tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin and coupling them. Adrenaline also derives from tyrosine: Tyr to DOPA to dopamine to noradrenaline to adrenaline, the last step catalysed by PNMT with SAM as methyl donor — which links straight back to the SAM and one-carbon material covered earlier.

extra.zh: 生物膜那一张里的运输机制，值得记住的定量点是 Na+/K+-ATPase 的化学计量：每水解 1 分子 ATP 泵出 3 个 Na+、泵入 2 个 K+，因此它是生电的，并且为小肠和肾小管的 Na+ 偶联葡萄糖同向转运（SGLT）提供驱动力。
extra.en: In the membrane-transport slide, the quantitative fact worth keeping is the stoichiometry of the Na+/K+-ATPase: per ATP hydrolysed it exports 3 Na+ and imports 2 K+, which makes it electrogenic and provides the driving force for Na+-coupled glucose symport (SGLT) in gut and kidney tubule.

quiz.q_zh: 胸苷酸合酶把 dUMP 变成 dTMP，这一步的化学本质是什么？
quiz.q_en: Thymidylate synthase converts dUMP to dTMP. What kind of reaction is this step?

options.zh: 以 NADPH 为氢供体的核糖脱氧反应
options.en: A ribose deoxygenation with NADPH as donor

options.zh: 以亚甲基四氢叶酸为供体的甲基化
options.en: A methylation with methylene-THF as donor

options.zh: 以 ATP 为磷酸供体的核苷酸激酶反应
options.en: A nucleotide kinase step with ATP as donor

options.zh: 以 SAM 为甲基供体的碱基甲基转移
options.en: A base methylation with SAM as methyl donor

quiz.explain_zh: N5,N10-亚甲基四氢叶酸把一个碳交给 dUMP 的 C5 并被还原成甲基，四氢叶酸自身氧化为二氢叶酸，要靠 DHFR 再生——这正是 5-FU 抑制胸苷酸合酶、甲氨蝶呤抑制 DHFR 的共同落点。SAM 是另一类甲基供体，走的是甲硫氨酸循环，不参与 dTMP 合成。核糖 2′ 位的 NADPH 依赖还原是核糖核苷酸还原酶在二磷酸水平干的事，和这一步无关。ATP 转磷酸只改变磷酸化状态（dTMP → dTDP → dTTP），造不出胸腺嘧啶的 5-甲基。
quiz.explain_en: N5,N10-methylene-THF donates a carbon to C5 of dUMP and is reduced to a methyl group, while THF itself is oxidised to dihydrofolate and must be regenerated by DHFR — which is why 5-FU (thymidylate synthase) and methotrexate (DHFR) both hit this node. SAM is a different methyl donor, belonging to the methionine cycle, and is not used for dTMP. The NADPH-dependent 2′ reduction of ribose is what ribonucleotide reductase does at the diphosphate level, not this step. Phosphate transfer from ATP only changes the phosphorylation state (dTMP to dTDP to dTTP) and cannot create the 5-methyl of thymine.

quiz.q_zh: 核糖核苷酸还原酶（RNR）在哪一个磷酸化水平上工作？
quiz.q_en: At which phosphorylation level does ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) act?

options.zh: 单磷酸水平，还原 AMP、GMP、CMP、UMP
options.en: Monophosphate level, reducing AMP, GMP, CMP, UMP

options.zh: 核苷水平，还原腺苷、鸟苷、胞苷、尿嘧啶核苷
options.en: Nucleoside level, reducing the four ribonucleosides

options.zh: 三磷酸水平，还原 ATP、GTP、CTP、UTP
options.en: Triphosphate level, reducing ATP, GTP, CTP, UTP

options.zh: 二磷酸水平，还原 ADP、GDP、CDP、UDP 四种
options.en: Diphosphate level, reducing all of ADP, GDP, CDP, UDP

quiz.explain_zh: RNR 的底物是四种核糖核苷二磷酸，产物是相应的 dNDP，随后再由激酶磷酸化成 dNTP 供复制使用。老师说 T 只能在单磷酸水平还原是错的：UDP 同样在二磷酸水平被还原成 dUDP。三磷酸和核苷这两个水平都不是 RNR 的作用点，dNTP 是 RNR 产物再磷酸化的结果，而核苷层面的反应是激酶和核苷磷酸化酶的领域。
quiz.explain_en: RNR takes the four ribonucleoside diphosphates and gives the corresponding dNDPs, which kinases then phosphorylate to dNTPs for replication. The teacher's claim that T is reduced only at the monophosphate level is wrong: UDP is reduced to dUDP at the diphosphate level like the rest. Neither the triphosphate nor the nucleoside level is RNR's substrate — dNTPs arise downstream of RNR, and nucleoside-level chemistry belongs to kinases and nucleoside phosphorylases.

title_zh: 光合作用的定义、叶绿体与类囊体的结构、光合总通式
title_en: Photosynthesis defined: chloroplast and thylakoid architecture, and the general equation

points.zh: 定义部分他一带而过：含光合色素的植物、以及很多细菌，在日光照射下把无机物合成有机物。
points.en: He runs quickly through the definition: plants containing photosynthetic pigments, and many bacteria, build organic matter from inorganic matter under sunlight.

points.zh: 这里的无机物主要指二氧化碳、水和硫化氢。
points.en: The inorganic matter here means mainly carbon dioxide, water and hydrogen sulfide.

points.zh: 他先说光合作用是「能量产生的过程」，随即改口为光能转化为化学能的过程。
points.en: He first calls photosynthesis an energy-producing process, then immediately corrects himself to a conversion of light energy into chemical energy.

points.zh: 对植物来说大部分光合作用发生在叶绿体；叶绿体跟线粒体很像，也是磷脂双分子层的双层脂质膜结构。
points.en: In plants most photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplast, which he compares to the mitochondrion: also a double lipid-bilayer structure.

points.zh: 叶绿体的基质里存在着很多类囊体，是一小片一小片叠到一起的。
points.en: The chloroplast stroma holds many thylakoids, stacked as flattened discs.

points.zh: 他说光合作用发生在类囊体的膜上。
points.en: He says photosynthesis takes place on the thylakoid membrane.

points.zh: 但紧接着说二氧化碳的固定发生在「类囊体的基质」中。
points.en: But he immediately says that CO2 fixation happens in the thylakoid's stroma.

points.zh: 光合总通式：二氧化碳 + 氢供体 H2A → 糖 + A，他明说不配平，因为没有必要配平。
points.en: The general equation: CO2 plus a hydrogen donor H2A gives sugar plus A. He deliberately leaves it unbalanced, saying there is no need to balance it.

points.zh: 氢供体最常见是水，也可以是 H2S；二氧化碳是氢的受体，被还原成糖。供体是水时放出氧气，是硫化氢时放出单质硫。
points.en: The commonest hydrogen donor is water, but it can be H2S; CO2 is the hydrogen acceptor and is reduced to sugar. With water as donor the by-product is O2; with H2S it is elemental sulfur.

extra.zh: 区室说错了一半。卡尔文循环（二氧化碳固定、暗反应）发生在叶绿体基质 stroma，也就是类囊体之外；类囊体内部叫类囊体腔 lumen，是另一个独立区室，里面不进行暗反应。他刚说对了「基质里堆着很多类囊体」，下一句就把固定放进了「类囊体的基质」，把两个词并成了一个。后面 01:57:43 他对着图说「这个是基质、这个是类囊体腔」，算半个自我纠正，但从没把两者的关系讲清楚。
extra.en: The compartments are half wrong. The Calvin cycle (CO2 fixation, the dark reactions) runs in the chloroplast stroma, i.e. outside the thylakoid; the inside of the thylakoid is the lumen, a separate compartment where no dark reactions occur. Having just correctly said that thylakoids are stacked in the stroma, he then places fixation in the thylakoid's stroma, fusing the two terms. At 01:57:43 he points at the figure and says one side is stroma and the other the lumen — half a self-correction, but he never states the relationship correctly.

extra.zh: 膜的层数要分清。叶绿体的外被是双层膜（这一点他说对了），但类囊体是单层膜围成的扁囊，切面上看到上下两片其实是同一张膜折回来，不是两层膜。他在下一段（01:51:09）说「类囊体的膜它的双层膜的膜上」，把外被的双层套到了类囊体上。
extra.en: Keep the membrane counts straight. The chloroplast envelope is a double membrane — that part he gets right — but the thylakoid is a flattened sac bounded by a single membrane; the two lines you see in cross-section are the same membrane folded back, not two membranes. In the next stretch (01:51:09) he speaks of the thylakoid's double membrane, carrying the envelope's topology onto the thylakoid.

extra.zh: 叶绿体有三个水相区室：外被两层膜之间的膜间隙、包着类囊体的基质、以及类囊体腔。光反应的全部蛋白复合体（PSII、cyt b6f、PSI、CF0F1）都嵌在类囊体膜上并且有确定的取向，正是这个取向决定了质子往哪一侧走——后面质子梯度那一段全靠它。
extra.en: The chloroplast has three aqueous compartments: the intermembrane space of the envelope, the stroma surrounding the thylakoids, and the thylakoid lumen. Every light-reaction complex (PSII, cyt b6f, PSI, CF0F1) sits in the thylakoid membrane with a defined orientation, and that orientation is what decides which side the protons go to — the whole proton-gradient story downstream rests on it.

extra.zh: 配平的总反应式是 6 CO2 + 12 H2O → C6H12O6 + 6 O2 + 6 H2O。写 12 个水而不是 6 个是有意义的：van Niel 的通式 CO2 + 2 H2A → (CH2O) + 2 A + H2O 说明放出的氧全部来自被裂解的水，而不是来自二氧化碳，这一点由同位素标记水的实验证明——也正是老师用硫化氢放出单质硫作类比时想说的道理。
extra.en: The balanced overall equation is 6 CO2 + 12 H2O to C6H12O6 + 6 O2 + 6 H2O.
