Writing twelve waters rather than six matters: van Niel's general form, CO2 + 2 H2A to (CH2O) + 2 A + H2O, shows that the released oxygen comes entirely from the split water, not from CO2 — proven by isotope labelling of water, and exactly the point his H2S-gives-sulfur analogy is reaching for.

quiz.q_zh: 卡尔文循环（暗反应、二氧化碳固定）实际发生在叶绿体的哪个部位？
quiz.q_en: Where in the chloroplast does the Calvin cycle (dark reactions, CO2 fixation) actually run?

options.zh: 叶绿体基质中，也就是类囊体之外
options.en: In the chloroplast stroma, that is, outside the thylakoid

options.zh: 类囊体腔内，紧贴着放氧复合体
options.en: In the thylakoid lumen, next to the oxygen-evolving complex

options.zh: 类囊体膜上，与 PSII 并排嵌着
options.en: In the thylakoid membrane, embedded alongside PSII

options.zh: 叶绿体外被的两层膜之间的膜间隙
options.en: In the intermembrane space of the chloroplast envelope

quiz.explain_zh: 「光反应在膜上、暗反应在基质」这句口诀的整个要点就是卡尔文循环在类囊体之外的基质里，Rubisco 是可溶性的基质蛋白。老师说的「类囊体的基质」把腔和基质并成了一个词。类囊体腔里只有放氧复合体裂解水放出的质子和氧，没有固碳酶系；类囊体膜上嵌的是 PSII、cyt b6f、PSI 和 CF0F1 这些光反应复合体；外被的膜间隙在整个光合作用里不起作用。
quiz.explain_en: The whole point of the slogan light reactions on the membrane, dark reactions in the stroma is that the Calvin cycle runs in the stroma outside the thylakoid, with Rubisco as a soluble stromal protein. The teacher's phrase the thylakoid's stroma collapses lumen and stroma into one word. The lumen holds only the protons and oxygen released by water splitting, no carbon-fixing enzymes; the thylakoid membrane holds PSII, cyt b6f, PSI and CF0F1; the envelope intermembrane space plays no part in photosynthesis.

quiz.q_zh: 光合作用释放的氧气，其氧原子来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where do the oxygen atoms in photosynthetically released O2 come from?

options.zh: 来自 RuBP 羧化后的六碳中间物
options.en: From the six-carbon intermediate of RuBP carboxylation

options.zh: 来自类囊体膜上磷脂的氧化分解
options.en: From oxidative breakdown of thylakoid membrane lipids

options.zh: 来自被固定并还原的二氧化碳
options.en: From the carbon dioxide that gets fixed and reduced

options.zh: 来自在光反应中被裂解的水分子
options.en: From the water molecules split in the light reactions

quiz.explain_zh: 水是氢供体，被 PSII 的放氧复合体光解，氧原子成对释放为 O2；同位素标记水的实验直接证明了这一点。老师用硫化氢作供体时放出单质硫的类比正好说明了这个逻辑：换掉供体，放出的就是供体那一半。二氧化碳在光合作用里是被还原的一方，它的氧最终进入糖和水；RuBP 羧化产物是水解成 3-磷酸甘油酸而不是放氧；膜脂根本不参与这个反应。
quiz.explain_en: Water is the hydrogen donor, split by PSII's oxygen-evolving complex, and its oxygen atoms are released pairwise as O2 — shown directly by isotope-labelling water. His own analogy, that an H2S donor yields elemental sulfur, makes the logic plain: change the donor and you change what is released. CO2 is the species being reduced; its oxygens end up in sugar and water. The carboxylation product of RuBP is hydrolysed to 3-phosphoglycerate, not to O2, and membrane lipids take no part at all.

title_zh: 光反应与暗反应的分工：水的分解、质子梯度、ATP 与 NADPH
title_en: Splitting light and dark reactions: water photolysis, the proton gradient, ATP and NADPH

points.zh: 任何一个光合作用都可以分成光反应和暗反应两部分。
points.en: Any photosynthesis can be divided into a light phase and a dark phase.

points.zh: 光反应发生在类囊体的膜上（他说是「双层膜的膜上」），水在光照作用下分解为氧气。
points.en: The light reactions occur on the thylakoid membrane — he calls it the double membrane — where water is broken down to oxygen under illumination.

points.zh: 水解出的氢离子会在这张膜上形成质子梯度，他明确类比线粒体内膜。
points.en: The protons released form a gradient across that membrane, and he explicitly compares this to the inner mitochondrial membrane.

points.zh: 这个梯度可以用来产生 ATP：ADP 加磷酸，跟氧化呼吸链比较像。
points.en: That gradient is used to make ATP from ADP plus phosphate, much as in the oxidative respiratory chain.

points.zh: 他说氢离子一方面会被泵出到「膜外」，用来产生 ATP。
points.en: He says the protons are pumped out to the outside of the membrane, and that this is what drives ATP synthesis.

points.zh: 另一方面氢会和 NADP 结合形成 NADPH，这就是还原力。
points.en: The other fate of the hydrogen is combination with NADP to form NADPH, the reducing power.

points.zh: 还原力最终要参与到糖类的生成里去，所以光反应做完以后才发生暗反应。
points.en: That reducing power ultimately feeds sugar synthesis, so the dark reactions follow the light reactions.

points.zh: 他说暗反应发生在「类囊体的基质」里，主要以水和二氧化碳为原料。
points.en: He places the dark reactions in the thylakoid's stroma and gives their raw materials as water and carbon dioxide.

points.zh: 暗反应接受 NADPH 提供的还原力和 ATP 提供的能量，最终产糖；他说这张把光反应和暗反应串起来的图挺重要，并预判老师考不会太深，因为这一章比传统生化难很多。
points.en: The dark reactions take reducing power from NADPH and energy from ATP to make sugar. He calls the figure linking light and dark reactions important, and predicts the exam will not go deep because this chapter is much harder than classical biochemistry.

extra.zh: 质子的几何整个反了，这是本讲光合作用最要紧的一处。他把线粒体的图景直接搬过来，说氢离子被泵到「膜外」。叶绿体正相反：PSII 的放氧复合体（Mn4CaO5 簇）在面向腔的一侧裂解水，把 4 个 H+ 直接释放进类囊体腔；质体醌穿梭配合 cyt b6f 又把基质侧的 H+ 泵进腔内。结果是腔内酸（pH 可低到 5 左右）、基质侧碱，梯度是「里高外低」。H+ 再经 CF0F1 从腔内流回基质推动 ATP 合成，ATP 和 NADPH 都生成在基质一侧。线粒体是把质子泵到内膜外侧的膜间隙、再流回基质，两者拓扑正好相反。他在 01:57:43 察觉到「这个图画的是反过来的」，但始终没有说出正确方向。
extra.en: The proton geometry is inverted, and this is the single most important error in the photosynthesis material. He carries the mitochondrial picture straight over and pumps protons to the outside of the membrane. Chloroplasts are the opposite: PSII's oxygen-evolving complex (the Mn4CaO5 cluster) splits water on the lumenal face and releases 4 H+ directly into the thylakoid lumen, while plastoquinone shuttling plus cyt b6f pumps further stromal H+ into the lumen. The lumen therefore turns acidic (pH can fall to around 5) and the stroma alkaline: the gradient points inward. H+ then flows back out of the lumen into the stroma through CF0F1 to drive ATP synthesis, and both ATP and NADPH are made on the stromal side. Mitochondria pump protons out to the intermembrane space and let them flow back into the matrix — the reverse topology. At 01:57:43 he notices the figure looks reversed but never states the correct direction.

extra.zh: 水不是暗反应的原料。卡尔文循环的底物是二氧化碳和核酮糖-1,5-二磷酸（RuBP），能量和还原力来自光反应送来的 ATP 与 NADPH。水是光反应里被光解的那一方，出现在方程左边是因为总反应式把两个阶段合并写了。
extra.en: Water is not a substrate of the dark reactions. The Calvin cycle's substrates are CO2 and ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate (RuBP), with energy and reducing power supplied as ATP and NADPH from the light reactions. Water is what gets photolysed in the light phase; it appears on the left of the overall equation only because that equation merges both phases.

extra.zh: 接受电子的是 NADP+，不是 NADPH——NADPH 已经是产物。基质侧由铁氧还蛋白-NADP+ 还原酶（FNR）催化 NADP+ + 2 e− + H+ → NADPH。注意用的是 NADP+ 而不是 NAD+：光合作用产的还原力专供合成代谢，与呼吸链用的 NADH 池分开。
extra.en: The electron acceptor is NADP+, not NADPH — NADPH is the product. On the stromal side, ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase (FNR) catalyses NADP+ + 2 e− + H+ to NADPH. Note NADP+ rather than NAD+: photosynthetic reducing power is earmarked for biosynthesis and is kept separate from the NADH pool used by the respiratory chain.

extra.zh: 两个阶段的账要分开记：每合成 1 分子六碳糖，卡尔文循环固定 6 分子 CO2，消耗 18 ATP 和 12 NADPH。而「6 CO2 + 6 H2O → 葡萄糖」是光合作用的总反应式，不是暗反应的投入清单——老师后面正是把这两个式子混着说的。
extra.en: Keep the two ledgers apart: making one hexose costs the Calvin cycle 18 ATP and 12 NADPH while fixing 6 CO2. The formula 6 CO2 + 6 H2O to glucose is the overall equation of photosynthesis, not the input list of the dark reactions — and conflating the two is exactly what he does later.

quiz.q_zh: 叶绿体光反应产生的质子梯度，方向是怎样的？
quiz.q_en: Which way does the proton gradient generated by the chloroplast light reactions point?

options.zh: 质子积累在类囊体腔，经 CF0F1 回基质
options.en: Protons build up in the lumen and return to the stroma via CF0F1

options.zh: 质子积累在叶绿体基质，经 CF0F1 回腔内
options.en: Protons build up in the stroma and return to the lumen via CF0F1

options.zh: 质子积累在外被膜间隙，经 CF0F1 回基质
options.en: Protons build up in the envelope space and return to the stroma

options.zh: 质子积累在细胞质基质，经 CF0F1 回叶绿体
options.en: Protons build up in the cytosol and return into the chloroplast

quiz.explain_zh: 放氧复合体在面向腔的一侧裂解水、把 H+ 直接倒进腔里，cyt b6f 再把基质侧的 H+ 泵进腔内，所以腔酸基质碱；H+ 经 CF0F1 流出到基质，ATP 和 NADPH 都产在基质侧，正好供给同在基质里的卡尔文循环。反过来说「基质积累、回流到腔」的路线不存在，那是把叶绿体的拓扑倒过来讲；外被的膜间隙没有质子泵，不参与储能；细胞质基质与类囊体之间隔着两层外被膜，不是产 ATP 的两侧。
quiz.explain_en: The oxygen-evolving complex splits water on the lumenal face and dumps H+ straight into the lumen, and cyt b6f pumps further stromal H+ inward, so the lumen is acidic and the stroma alkaline; H+ then exits through CF0F1 into the stroma, where both ATP and NADPH are made — right where the Calvin cycle needs them. A stroma-to-lumen route does not exist; that is the chloroplast topology turned inside out. The envelope intermembrane space has no proton pump and stores no energy, and the cytosol is separated from the thylakoid by both envelope membranes, so it is not one of the two compartments across which ATP is made.

quiz.q_zh: 卡尔文循环的直接底物和能量来源是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the direct substrates and energy sources of the Calvin cycle?

options.zh: 水和二氧化碳，还原力全部由 NADPH 提供
options.en: Water and CO2, with NADPH supplying the hydrogen

options.zh: 二氧化碳和 RuBP，耗 ATP 与 NADPH
options.en: CO2 and RuBP, with both ATP and NADPH consumed

options.zh: 水和 3-磷酸甘油酸，所需能量全由 ATP 提供
options.en: Water and 3-PGA, with ATP as the only energy input

options.zh: 二氧化碳和葡萄糖，电子全部由 FNR 提供
options.en: CO2 and glucose, with FNR supplying the electrons

quiz.explain_zh: Rubisco 把 CO2 加到 RuBP 上，产物裂解为 2 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸；随后的还原段消耗 ATP（磷酸甘油酸激酶）和 NADPH（甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶），再生段又消耗 ATP（核酮糖-5-磷酸激酶）。水是光反应的底物，不是循环的原料，老师说的「水和二氧化碳为原料」把总反应式当成了暗反应。3-磷酸甘油酸是羧化之后的产物，而不是起始的受体。葡萄糖是很多步之后的下游产物，而且 FNR 工作在基质侧不在腔内。
quiz.explain_en: Rubisco adds CO2 to RuBP and the product splits into two 3-phosphoglycerate; the reductive phase then spends ATP (phosphoglycerate kinase) and NADPH (glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase), and the regenerative phase spends more ATP (ribulose-5-phosphate kinase). Water is a light-reaction substrate, not a cycle input — quoting water and CO2 mistakes the overall equation for the dark reactions. 3-phosphoglycerate is the cycle's first product, not its starting acceptor. Glucose lies many steps downstream, and FNR works on the stromal side, not in the lumen.

title_zh: 叶绿素的结构与吸收光谱：从基态到激发态，光能变电能
title_en: Chlorophyll structure and absorption: ground state to excited state, light energy into electrical energy

points.zh: 光反应最依靠的是叶绿素。
points.en: The light reactions rest on chlorophyll.

points.zh: 叶绿素长得很像血红蛋白里的血红素，只不过叶绿素中间是镁、血红素中间是铁。
points.en: Chlorophyll looks much like the haem in haemoglobin, except that chlorophyll has magnesium at the centre and haem has iron.

points.zh: 他强调两者结构很像，但发挥的功能不太一样。
points.en: He stresses that the two look alike but do quite different jobs.

points.zh: 不同的叶绿素在环的四个角上有不同的修饰，修饰不同导致吸收的光不同。
points.en: Different chlorophylls carry different substituents at the four corners of the ring, and those differences shift which light they absorb.

points.zh: 他给的小知识点：叶绿素 b 更多吸收蓝光，叶绿素 a 更多吸收红光。
points.en: His memory hook: chlorophyll b absorbs more blue light, chlorophyll a more red light.

points.zh: 叶绿素基本不吸收绿光和黄光，主要利用红光和蓝光。
points.en: Chlorophyll barely absorbs green or yellow light and works mainly with red and blue.

points.zh: 叶绿素这么大一个环状结构，决定了它很容易吸收光线。
points.en: The large ring system is what makes chlorophyll so good at absorbing light.

points.zh: 光子把能量交给叶绿素，叶绿素从很稳定的基态被打到激发态。
points.en: A photon hands its energy to chlorophyll, kicking it from the stable ground state into an excited state.

points.zh: 激发态不稳定，体系倾向回到稳定状态；回落过程中一方面变回原样，另一方面释放出「一分子的电子」——光子就这样变成了电子，光能变成电能、电化学能。
points.en: The excited state is unstable and the system tends back to stability; on the way down chlorophyll both returns to its original form and releases what he calls one molecule of electron — the photon has become an electron, light energy has become electrical, electrochemical energy.

extra.zh: 「b 吸蓝、a 吸红」是过度简化：a 和 b 都同时在蓝区和红区有吸收峰，只是峰位不同——a 约 430 nm 和 662 nm，b 约 453 nm 和 642 nm，b 的红区峰蓝移、蓝区吸收更强。两者互补覆盖的波段比单独一种宽，这才是植物同时带两种叶绿素的意义。他说「不吸收绿光和黄光」是对的，叶片呈绿正是因为绿光被反射和透射掉了。
extra.en: Blue for b, red for a is an over-simplification: both a and b absorb in the blue and the red, with different peak positions — a at roughly 430 and 662 nm, b at roughly 453 and 642 nm, b's red peak blue-shifted and its blue absorption stronger. Together they cover a wider band than either alone, which is why plants carry both. His statement that green and yellow are not absorbed is correct, and it is why leaves look green: that light is reflected and transmitted.

extra.zh: 「释放出一分子的电子」——电子不是分子。激发态叶绿素向原初电子受体传出的是一个电子。这是措辞问题，机制他讲的没错。
extra.en: One molecule of electron: an electron is not a molecule. Excited chlorophyll passes a single electron to the primary acceptor. A wording slip only; the mechanism as he describes it is right.

extra.zh: 并不是每个叶绿素分子都会放电子。绝大多数叶绿素是天线色素，吸光后只把激发能以共振（Förster）方式一级级传给邻居；真正发生电荷分离、把电子交给原初受体的只有反应中心那一对特殊叶绿素 a——PSII 的 P680 和 PSI 的 P700。天线的作用是把捕光截面放大几百倍，让反应中心不至于闲着。
extra.en: Not every chlorophyll ejects an electron. The great majority are antenna pigments that, on absorbing light, merely pass the excitation on to neighbours by resonance (Förster) transfer; charge separation — actually handing an electron to a primary acceptor — happens only at the special chlorophyll a pair of the reaction centre, P680 in PSII and P700 in PSI. The antenna's job is to enlarge the light-capture cross-section several hundredfold so the reaction centre is never idle.

extra.zh: 叶绿素与血红素的相似是骨架上的：都由四个吡咯环组成大环。差别不止中心金属——叶绿素是镁卟啉，环 D 被还原成二氢卟吩（chlorin），还挂着一条疏水的植醇长尾把它锚进类囊体膜里；血红素没有植醇尾，靠珠蛋白包裹。功能上一个做激发态的电荷分离，一个做可逆的氧结合，用同一个骨架干两件完全不同的事。
extra.en: The resemblance between chlorophyll and haem is skeletal: both are macrocycles of four pyrroles. The differences go beyond the central metal — chlorophyll is a magnesium porphyrin whose D ring is reduced (a chlorin), and it carries a long hydrophobic phytol tail that anchors it in the thylakoid membrane, whereas haem has no tail and is held by globin. Functionally one performs excited-state charge separation and the other reversible oxygen binding: the same scaffold doing two entirely different jobs.

quiz.q_zh: 叶绿素与血红素在中心金属上的区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: How do chlorophyll and haem differ in their central metal?

options.zh: 叶绿素中心是镁，血红素中心是铁
options.en: Chlorophyll holds magnesium and haem holds iron

options.zh: 两者中心都是铁，侧链的修饰有区别
options.en: Both hold iron, differing in side-chain groups

options.zh: 叶绿素中心是铁，血红素中心是镁离子
options.en: Chlorophyll holds iron and haem holds magnesium

options.zh: 两者中心都是镁，配位的大环有区别
options.en: Both hold magnesium, differing in the ring system

quiz.explain_zh: 叶绿素是镁卟啉，血红素是铁卟啉，这一点老师讲对了。把两个金属对调是最常见的记忆错误，可以用功能来锁：铁能在 Fe2+/Fe3+ 之间变价并可逆结合氧，镁不变价、正好适合做激发态电荷分离的中心。说两者都是镁，则血红蛋白无法结合氧；说两者都是铁，则叶绿素会被氧化还原反应消耗掉，都与实际功能矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: Chlorophyll is a magnesium porphyrin and haem an iron porphyrin, which he states correctly. Swapping the two metals is the commonest memory error; anchor it by function — iron cycles between Fe2+ and Fe3+ and binds O2 reversibly, while magnesium is redox-inert, exactly what a charge-separation centre needs. If both were magnesium haemoglobin could not bind oxygen; if both were iron chlorophyll would be consumed by redox chemistry. Either way the function contradicts the claim.

quiz.q_zh: 在光合色素系统里，真正把电子交给原初受体的是哪一部分？
quiz.q_en: In the photosynthetic pigment system, which component actually hands an electron to the primary acceptor?

options.zh: 所有天线叶绿素吸光后都能放出电子
options.en: Every antenna chlorophyll releases an electron on absorbing light

options.zh: 质体醌吸收光子后把电子送进腔内
options.en: Plastoquinone absorbs a photon and sends an electron to the lumen

options.zh: 细胞色素 b6f 吸光后放出一个电子
options.en: The cytochrome b6f complex absorbs a photon and frees an electron

options.zh: 只有反应中心那一对特殊的叶绿素 a 分子
options.en: Only the special pair of chlorophyll a at the reaction centre

quiz.explain_zh: 天线色素只做能量的共振传递，把激发能汇聚到反应中心，电荷分离仅发生在 P680 或 P700 这一对特殊叶绿素 a 上。说每个天线叶绿素都放电子，等于取消了天线系统存在的意义。质体醌是接受电子并带着质子穿梭的载体，本身不吸光启动反应；细胞色素 b6f 是电子传递链中间的复合体，靠的是氧化还原电位差而不是吸收光子。
quiz.explain_en: Antenna pigments only funnel excitation energy by resonance transfer to the reaction centre; charge separation happens solely at the special chlorophyll a pair, P680 or P700. If every antenna chlorophyll ejected electrons the antenna system would have no reason to exist. Plastoquinone accepts electrons and shuttles protons but does not absorb light to start the reaction, and cytochrome b6f is a mid-chain complex driven by redox potential differences, not by photon capture.

title_zh: Z 型电子传递：从 P680 到 NADPH，以及质子被泵到哪一侧
title_en: The Z-scheme: from P680 to NADPH, and which side the protons end up on

points.zh: 释放出来的电子走的是「Z 型电子传递」，他画的左边是势能图，越往下势能越低。
points.en: The released electron travels the Z-scheme; the figure on the left is a potential-energy diagram in which lower means lower energy.

points.zh: 叶绿素接受光子后跳到激发态，从激发态往下掉回基态的过程中把电子释放出来。
points.en: Chlorophyll absorbs a photon, jumps to the excited state, and releases the electron as it falls back toward the ground state.

points.zh: 他说电子被叶绿体里的 P680 摄取，并说 P680 这些「你可以叫做细胞色素，它的名字好像就叫细胞色素」。
points.en: He says the electron is taken up by P680 in the chloroplast, and adds that these can be called cytochromes, that the name seems to be cytochrome.

points.zh: 经细胞色素摄取后又被质体醌接走，他类比说质体醌有点像电子传递链里的泛醌。
points.en: After that pick-up the electron passes to plastoquinone, which he likens to ubiquinone in the respiratory electron transport chain.

points.zh: 质体醌带着电子又重新回到高能状态。
points.en: Plastoquinone carries the electron back up to a high-energy state.

points.zh: 整体是低能到高能、又回到低能、再回到高能，他总结为「经过两次传递」。
points.en: The overall shape goes low to high, back down, and up again — he summarises it as two rounds of transfer.

points.zh: 他说最终把光反应里的氢质子传递到了 NADPH 上面，获得还原力。
points.en: He says the protons of the light reaction are finally transferred onto NADPH, yielding reducing power.

points.zh: 他说传递的每一个步骤都会把氢质子泵到膜外。
points.en: He says every step of the transfer pumps protons out of the membrane.

points.zh: 叶绿体一样有 ATP 合成酶，泵出去的氢离子再流回来产 ATP，跟动物差不多；他看图时说「这个画的是反过来的，这个是基质，这个是类囊体腔」，然后说「反正大概的你知道方向就行了」。
points.en: Chloroplasts likewise have an ATP synthase, and the pumped-out protons flow back to make ATP much as in animals. Looking at the figure he says it is drawn the other way round, points out the stroma and the lumen, and concludes that knowing roughly the direction is enough.

extra.zh: 全程没有区分 PSII 和 PSI，而 Z 图上那两次上坡正是两个光系统。PSII（反应中心 P680）负责水的光解和放氧，电子经去镁叶绿素 → 质体醌 → cyt b6f → 质体蓝素 → PSI；PSI（反应中心 P700）再受光激发，把电子交给铁氧还蛋白，最后由 FNR 在基质侧还原 NADP+。裂解水的是 PSII 不是 PSI，这一点不点明，Z 图为什么要两次吸光就没有着落了。他还完全没提放氧复合体、质体蓝素、铁氧还蛋白和 FNR。
extra.en: He never distinguishes PSII from PSI, yet the two uphill jumps in the Z-scheme are precisely the two photosystems. PSII (reaction centre P680) splits water and evolves oxygen, its electron running pheophytin to plastoquinone to cyt b6f to plastocyanin to PSI; PSI (reaction centre P700) is then re-excited and passes the electron to ferredoxin, from which FNR reduces NADP+ on the stromal side. It is PSII, not PSI, that splits water — without saying so, there is no reason for the Z-scheme to need two photon captures. He also never mentions the oxygen-evolving complex, plastocyanin, ferredoxin or FNR.

extra.zh: P680 不是细胞色素。它是 PSII 反应中心的一对特殊叶绿素 a，因吸收峰在 680 nm 而得名；P700 同理属于 PSI。链上真正的细胞色素是质体醌之后的细胞色素 b6f 复合体。他把反应中心色素、原初电子受体和细胞色素混成了一个东西。
extra.en: P680 is not a cytochrome. It is the special pair of chlorophyll a at PSII's reaction centre, named for its 680 nm absorption maximum; P700 is its counterpart in PSI. The genuine cytochrome in the chain is the cytochrome b6f complex, downstream of plastoquinone. He merges reaction-centre pigment, primary acceptor and cytochrome into a single entity.

extra.zh: 传下去的是电子，不是质子；受体是 NADP+ 而不是 NADPH（NADPH 已经是产物）。基质侧的反应是 NADP+ + 2 e− + H+ → NADPH，由 FNR 催化。水裂解放出的质子留在类囊体腔里，只有经过 CF0F1 时才回到基质，它们和电子走的是两条完全不同的路。
extra.en: What travels down the chain is electrons, not protons, and the acceptor is NADP+, not NADPH (NADPH is already the product). On the stromal side FNR catalyses NADP+ + 2 e− + H+ to NADPH. The protons released by water splitting stay in the lumen and return to the stroma only through CF0F1: electrons and protons take completely separate routes.

extra.zh: 他在这里察觉图「画的是反过来的」，但没有改口，所以要自己补上：H+ 是被泵进类囊体腔，不是泵出膜外，CF0F1 的方向是腔 → 基质。另外还有一条环式电子传递：PSI 激发后的电子经铁氧还蛋白绕回 cyt b6f，只泵质子产 ATP、不产 NADPH，植物用它来补足 ATP/NADPH 的比例，因为卡尔文循环要的 ATP 比 NADPH 多。
extra.en: He notices here that the figure looks reversed but never corrects himself, so supply it yourself: H+ is pumped into the thylakoid lumen, not out of the membrane, and CF0F1 runs lumen to stroma. There is also cyclic electron flow, in which the electron from excited PSI returns via ferredoxin to cyt b6f, pumping protons and making ATP without NADPH; plants use it to top up the ATP/NADPH ratio, because the Calvin cycle needs more ATP than NADPH.

quiz.q_zh: 水的光解、放出氧气这一步发生在哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where does water photolysis and oxygen release take place?

options.zh: FNR 上，结合水以后在基质侧裂解
options.en: At FNR, which binds water and splits it on the stromal side

options.zh: PSI 的 P700 上，面向基质一侧放氧
options.en: At P700 of PSI, which evolves oxygen on the stromal face

options.zh: PSII 的放氧复合体，面向类囊体腔
options.en: At PSII's oxygen-evolving complex, facing the thylakoid lumen

options.zh: 细胞色素 b6f 复合体，位于膜的中部
options.en: At the cytochrome b6f complex, in the middle of the membrane

quiz.explain_zh: 放氧复合体是 PSII 上含 Mn4CaO5 簇的部分，位于面向腔的一侧，每裂解 2 分子水放出 1 分子 O2、4 个电子和 4 个 H+，质子直接进腔——这既补上 P680 失去的电子，又贡献了质子梯度。P700 是 PSI 的反应中心，它的下游是铁氧还蛋白和 NADP+，从不接触水。cyt b6f 只做电子传递和质子泵，没有裂解水的锰簇。FNR 做的是基质侧还原 NADP+ 那一步。
quiz.explain_en: The oxygen-evolving complex is the Mn4CaO5-containing part of PSII on the lumenal face; splitting two waters yields one O2, four electrons and four H+, with the protons going straight into the lumen — replacing P680's lost electrons and feeding the gradient at the same time. P700 is PSI's reaction centre and its downstream partners are ferredoxin and NADP+; it never touches water. cyt b6f only transfers electrons and pumps protons, lacking any water-splitting manganese cluster, and FNR performs the stromal reduction of NADP+.

quiz.q_zh: P680 究竟是什么？
quiz.q_en: What exactly is P680?

options.zh: 类囊体膜中来回穿梭电子的质体醌分子
options.en: A plastoquinone that shuttles electrons in the membrane

options.zh: PSII 反应中心的叶绿素 a 对
options.en: The chlorophyll a pair of PSII's reaction centre

options.zh: 把电子交给 NADP+ 的黄素还原酶
options.en: The flavin reductase that hands electrons to NADP+

options.zh: 一种含血红素铁的细胞色素类蛋白复合体
options.en: A cytochrome-type protein carrying a haem iron centre

quiz.explain_zh: P680 的 P 是 pigment，680 是吸收峰的波长，指的就是 PSII 反应中心那一对叶绿素 a；受激发后它变成生物界最强的氧化剂之一，强到足以从水里夺电子。老师说它「可以叫做细胞色素」是错的，链上真正的细胞色素是 cyt b6f。质体醌是膜内的可移动电子—质子载体，不是反应中心色素。把电子交给 NADP+ 的黄素酶是 FNR，位于整条链的末端。
quiz.explain_en: The P in P680 stands for pigment and 680 for the absorption maximum; it denotes the chlorophyll a pair at PSII's reaction centre, which on excitation becomes one of the strongest oxidants in biology — strong enough to strip electrons from water. Calling it a cytochrome, as he does, is wrong; the real cytochrome in the chain is cyt b6f. Plastoquinone is a mobile electron-and-proton carrier within the membrane, not a reaction-centre pigment, and the flavin enzyme that reduces NADP+ is FNR, at the far end of the chain.

quiz.q_zh: Z 图上电子的最终去向是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the final fate of the electron in the Z-scheme?

options.zh: NADPH 在类囊体腔内被 FNR 再还原一次
options.en: NADPH is reduced again by FNR inside the lumen

options.zh: NADP+ 在基质侧由 FNR 负责还原
options.en: NADP+ is reduced by FNR on the stromal face

options.zh: 质体蓝素在类囊体腔内接受电子并被还原
options.en: Plastocyanin is reduced by the electron in the lumen

options.zh: 质体醌在类囊体膜中接受电子生成 PQH2
options.en: Plastoquinone takes it in the membrane to give PQH2

quiz.explain_zh: 非环式电子传递的终点是基质侧的 NADP+ + 2 e− + H+ → NADPH，由铁氧还蛋白-NADP+ 还原酶催化，产物 NADPH 直接留在基质里供卡尔文循环使用。质体蓝素和质体醌都是链中间的载体，接了电子还要往下传，不是终点。说 NADPH 在腔内再被还原一次是把产物当成了底物，而且 FNR 的活性位点朝向基质，不在腔内。
quiz.explain_en: Non-cyclic electron flow ends on the stromal side with NADP+ + 2 e− + H+ to NADPH, catalysed by ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase, and the NADPH stays in the stroma for the Calvin cycle. Plastocyanin and plastoquinone are mid-chain carriers that must pass the electron on, so neither is a terminus. Reducing NADPH again in the lumen mistakes the product for the substrate, and in any case FNR's active site faces the stroma, not the lumen.

title_zh: 叶绿体 ATP 合成与暗反应：Rubisco 与卡尔文循环
title_en: Chloroplast ATP synthesis and the dark reactions: Rubisco and the Calvin cycle

points.zh: 泵出来的氢离子又通过 ATP 合酶回流，跟动物差不多地产生了 ATP。
points.en: The pumped-out protons flow back through ATP synthase and, much as in animals, make ATP.

points.zh: 他总结：到这里光反应把光子转化成了化学能，进一步转化成 ATP 和还原力 NADPH。
points.en: He sums up: by this point the light reactions have turned photons into chemical energy and then into ATP and the reducing power NADPH.

points.zh: 幻灯片上那个小公式他说记不记都行、看不看都 OK。
points.en: He waves off the small equation on the slide as optional to memorise or even to read.

points.zh: 暗反应的主角是核酮糖-1,5-二磷酸羧化酶，还有一个名字叫 Rubisco，是一个很大很大的蛋白。
points.en: The dark reactions are headed by ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase, also called Rubisco, a very large protein.

points.zh: 他说这个蛋白在植物体里极度保守，「有可能是整个世界上最保守的蛋白质」，从有植物开始就存在于叶绿体里。
points.en: He calls it extremely conserved in plants, possibly the most conserved protein in the world, present in chloroplasts since plants began.

points.zh: Rubisco 的作用就是把植物体里游离的二氧化碳固定下来，他让学生记住这一条就行。
points.en: Rubisco's job is to fix the free CO2 in the plant, and he tells the student that remembering this much is enough.

points.zh: 固定的具体形式是走卡尔文循环。
points.en: The fixation happens by way of the Calvin cycle.

points.zh: 他说第一步是 Rubisco 把二氧化碳和水放在一起：人体里 CO2 和水形成碳酸、或者形成氨甲酰，而植物里加了一些别的东西，把二氧化碳和水固定生成 3-磷酸甘油酸。
points.en: He says the first step is Rubisco putting CO2 together with water: in the body CO2 and water give carbonic acid or a carbamoyl group, while in plants something else is added so that CO2 and water are fixed into 3-phosphoglycerate.

points.zh: 他指出 3-磷酸甘油酸是糖酵解 EMP 途径里的产物（先误说 TCA 循环随即改口），接下来走一个类似糖异生的过程，最终「在 Rubisco 酶的作用下」产生 6 碳糖：6 分子二氧化碳加 6 分子水经卡尔文循环生成 1 分子葡萄糖。
points.en: He notes that 3-phosphoglycerate is a glycolytic (EMP) intermediate — first misnaming the TCA cycle, then correcting himself — after which something like gluconeogenesis runs, and under the action of Rubisco a hexose is produced: 6 CO2 plus 6 water through the Calvin cycle giving one glucose.

extra.zh: 二氧化碳的受体是 RuBP，不是水。Rubisco 把 CO2 加到核酮糖-1,5-二磷酸的 C2 上，生成一个不稳定的六碳中间物，随即裂解为 2 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸——水确实参与，但参与的是这一步裂解的水解，而不是「和二氧化碳结合」。他类比的人体反应本身没错（碳酸酐酶催化 CO2 + H2O → H2CO3，CPS-1 用 HCO3− 做氨甲酰磷酸），但拿来说明 Rubisco 的化学就错了。
extra.en: The CO2 acceptor is RuBP, not water. Rubisco adds CO2 to C2 of ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate, giving an unstable six-carbon intermediate that immediately breaks into two 3-phosphoglycerate. Water is involved — in the hydrolytic cleavage of that intermediate, not in combining with CO2. His human-physiology analogies are fine in themselves (carbonic anhydrase making H2CO3, CPS-1 using HCO3− for carbamoyl phosphate) but are the wrong model for Rubisco's chemistry.

extra.zh: Rubisco 只催化羧化这一步，不生成葡萄糖。3-磷酸甘油酸 → 甘油醛-3-磷酸是磷酸甘油酸激酶（耗 ATP）加甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶（耗 NADPH）完成的，之后还要靠转酮酶、醛缩酶、核酮糖-5-磷酸激酶等一整套反应把 RuBP 再生出来，六碳糖在很多步以后才出现。他说「最终在 Rubisco 酶的作用下产生了葡萄糖」是把整条循环的功劳算到了一个酶头上。
extra.en: Rubisco catalyses only the carboxylation and makes no glucose. 3-phosphoglycerate becomes glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate via phosphoglycerate kinase (spending ATP) and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (spending NADPH), after which transketolase, aldolase and ribulose-5-phosphate kinase regenerate RuBP; hexose appears many steps later. Saying glucose is produced under the action of Rubisco credits one enzyme with the whole cycle.

extra.zh: Rubisco 出名的头衔是「地球上含量最丰富的蛋白质」，约占叶片可溶性蛋白的一半。它确实高度保守，但「最保守的蛋白质」这个最高级没有依据——真正以序列保守著称的是组蛋白 H4、泛素这一类。这很可能是把 abundant 记成了 conserved。它含量必须这么高，正是因为它催化速度慢、又分不清 CO2 和 O2，只能靠数量堆上去。
extra.en: Rubisco's famous title is the most abundant protein on Earth, roughly half the soluble protein of a leaf. It is indeed highly conserved, but the superlative most conserved has no basis — that distinction belongs to proteins like histone H4 and ubiquitin. Abundant has most likely been remembered as conserved. The abundance is itself a consequence of the enzyme being slow and unable to discriminate CO2 from O2, so the plant compensates with sheer quantity.

extra.zh: 两本账不要混：卡尔文循环每固定 6 分子 CO2、生成 1 分子六碳糖，消耗 18 ATP 和 12 NADPH，同时必须再生 6 分子 RuBP；而「6 CO2 + 6 H2O → 葡萄糖 + 6 O2」是光合作用的总反应式，把光反应和暗反应合在一起写的，水出现在里面是因为光反应要裂解它，不是暗反应的投入。
extra.en: Keep the two ledgers apart: per hexose the Calvin cycle fixes 6 CO2 while spending 18 ATP and 12 NADPH and regenerating 6 RuBP; whereas 6 CO2 + 6 H2O to glucose + 6 O2 is the overall equation of photosynthesis, merging both phases. Water appears there because the light reactions split it, not because the dark reactions consume it.

quiz.q_zh: Rubisco 催化的那一步反应，底物和产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the substrate and product of the reaction Rubisco catalyses?

options.zh: CO2 加到 RuBP，裂解为 2 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸
options.en: CO2 adds to RuBP, and the product splits into two 3-phosphoglycerate

options.zh: CO2 与水缩合成碳酸，再转变为 3-磷酸甘油酸
options.en: CO2 condenses with water to carbonic acid, then to 3-phosphoglycerate

options.zh: CO2 与甘油醛-3-磷酸缩合，直接生成 1 分子六碳糖
options.en: CO2 condenses with glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate to give a hexose directly

options.zh: CO2 与磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸缩合，生成 1 分子草酰乙酸
options.en: CO2 condenses with phosphoenolpyruvate to give one oxaloacetate

quiz.explain_zh: 羧化的受体是 5 碳的 RuBP，加上 CO2 得到不稳定的六碳中间物，水解裂开就是 2 分子 3 碳的 3-磷酸甘油酸，碳数 5 + 1 = 3 + 3 正好对上。二氧化碳与水生成碳酸是碳酸酐酶的反应，和固碳无关，老师正是在这里串了台。与甘油醛-3-磷酸缩合直接出六碳糖跳过了整个还原段和再生段。与磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸缩合生成草酰乙酸是 PEP 羧化酶的反应，属于 C4 途径的第一步，不是 Rubisco 干的。
quiz.explain_en: The carboxylation acceptor is the five-carbon RuBP; adding CO2 gives an unstable six-carbon intermediate whose hydrolytic cleavage yields two three-carbon 3-phosphoglycerate, and the carbon count 5 + 1 = 3 + 3 checks out. CO2 plus water giving carbonic acid is carbonic anhydrase's reaction and has nothing to do with fixation — this is exactly where the teacher crosses wires. Condensing with glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate to give hexose outright skips the entire reductive and regenerative phases. Condensing with phosphoenolpyruvate to give oxaloacetate is PEP carboxylase, the first step of the C4 pathway, not Rubisco.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 Rubisco 最广为人知的一个说法是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the best-known claim about Rubisco?

options.zh: 它是叶绿体中分子量最小的一种酶
options.en: It is the smallest enzyme by mass in a chloroplast

options.zh: 它是地球上进化速度最快的一种酶
options.en: It is the fastest-evolving enzyme protein on Earth

options.zh: 它是地球上含量最丰富的蛋白质
options.en: It is the most abundant single protein on Earth

options.zh: 它是地球上序列最保守的一种蛋白
options.en: It is the most sequence-conserved protein on Earth

quiz.explain_zh: Rubisco 约占叶片可溶性蛋白的一半，是公认含量最丰富的蛋白质，原因是它催化速度慢、还会把 O2 当底物，植物只能靠堆数量弥补。老师说的「最保守」是把 abundant 记成了 conserved：Rubisco 确实保守，但序列保守之最通常归给组蛋白 H4 和泛素。它进化速度并不特别快，而且它是由大小亚基组成的庞大复合物，远不是叶绿体里最小的酶。
quiz.explain_en: Rubisco makes up about half the soluble protein of a leaf and is the recognised most abundant protein, precisely because it is slow and also accepts O2, so plants compensate with quantity. The teacher's most conserved is abundant misremembered as conserved: Rubisco is conserved, but the sequence-conservation record usually goes to histone H4 and ubiquitin. It is not unusually fast-evolving, and being a large complex of small and large subunits it is nowhere near the smallest chloroplast enzyme.

title_zh: 光呼吸与 C4 途径，以及光合作用一章的收尾
title_en: Photorespiration, the C4 pathway, and closing out the photosynthesis chapter

points.zh: 他总结光合作用简单理解就是光反应加暗反应，然后补两个小点：光呼吸和 C4 途径。
points.en: He sums photosynthesis up as light reactions plus dark reactions, then adds two footnotes: photorespiration and the C4 pathway.

points.zh: 植物的卡尔文循环始终需要二氧化碳。
points.en: The plant's Calvin cycle always needs CO2.

points.zh: 但白天要发生光反应，水会变成氧气，所以白天植物体附近的氧气浓度很高。
points.en: But by day the light reactions turn water into oxygen, so the oxygen concentration around the plant is high.

points.zh: 他说这和白天要储存能量有点相违背，因为储能需要的是二氧化碳。
points.en: He says this conflicts somewhat with the daytime job of storing energy, which requires CO2.

points.zh: 于是衍生出光呼吸：在有光照的情况下，用氧气代替二氧化碳和 Rubisco 发生「固定」反应。
points.en: Hence photorespiration: under illumination, oxygen substitutes for CO2 in a fixation reaction with Rubisco.

points.zh: 他把光呼吸定性为「退而求其次」的手段，用来维持它的能量、维持六碳糖的产生，并说具体原理应该不需要掌握。
points.en: He frames photorespiration as a second-best measure that keeps the plant's energy supply and hexose production going, and says the detailed mechanism probably need not be mastered.

points.zh: C4 途径他定义为「专门用来对付光呼吸的一种手段」。
points.en: He defines the C4 pathway as a means specifically for countering photorespiration.

points.zh: 他描述 C4 是把二氧化碳从叶片的表面转移到叶片的内部，新产生的氧气则更倾向于从叶片表面散出去，二氧化碳被运到细胞内部后可以高效地跑卡尔文循环。
points.en: He describes C4 as moving CO2 from the leaf surface into the leaf interior, while newly made oxygen tends to escape from the surface; once CO2 is inside the cell the Calvin cycle can run efficiently.

points.zh: 最后总结：白天植物一方面进行光反应，另一方面在叶片表面靠光呼吸维持一个比较微弱的卡尔文循环，同时用 C4 途径把珍贵的二氧化碳运到叶片内部高效合成；讲完他说自己也不知道这一章真正的重点在哪，让学生去看自己的教材。
points.en: His closing summary: by day the plant runs the light reactions, sustains a weak Calvin cycle at the leaf surface by photorespiration, and uses C4 to carry precious CO2 inside for efficient synthesis. He then says he does not know where the real emphasis of this chapter lies and refers the student to their own textbook.

extra.zh: 光呼吸的方向整个反了，这是本段最重要的更正。它不是替代路线，而是 Rubisco 加氧酶活性带来的净损失：RuBP + O2 → 1 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸 + 1 分子 2-磷酸乙醇酸。2-磷酸乙醇酸要经叶绿体—过氧化物酶体—线粒体三个区室的乙醇酸途径才能回收，过程中放出 CO2 和 NH3，还额外消耗 ATP 和还原力（NH3 必须由谷氨酰胺合成酶重新固定回来，又是一笔 ATP）。所以光呼吸是把已经固定的碳又丢掉一部分，既不产糖也不「维持卡尔文循环」。他说「用氧气代替二氧化碳发生固定」中的「固定」也不成立：O2 不会被固定成糖。
extra.en: The direction of photorespiration is entirely reversed, and this is the most important correction in this stretch. It is not an alternative route but a net loss arising from Rubisco's oxygenase activity: RuBP + O2 gives one 3-phosphoglycerate plus one 2-phosphoglycolate. Salvaging 2-phosphoglycolate takes the glycolate pathway across three compartments — chloroplast, peroxisome, mitochondrion — releasing CO2 and NH3 and consuming ATP and reducing power along the way (the NH3 must be refixed by glutamine synthetase, costing more ATP). Photorespiration therefore throws away carbon that was already fixed; it makes no sugar and sustains no Calvin cycle. Even his word fixation is wrong here: O2 is not fixed into sugar.

extra.zh: C4 的空间分隔不是叶片表面对叶片内部，而是两类细胞之间。叶肉细胞（mesophyll cell）里由 PEP 羧化酶把 HCO3− 固定到磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸上生成草酰乙酸，再转成苹果酸或天冬氨酸；这些四碳酸经胞间连丝运到维管束鞘细胞（bundle sheath cell）后脱羧，在那里局部释放出高浓度 CO2。Rubisco 和整个卡尔文循环只在维管束鞘细胞里进行。关键有两条他都没讲：PEP 羧化酶对底物亲和力高而且完全不与 O2 反应，所以第一步固定不受氧干扰；维管束鞘细胞被包裹、产氧的 PSII 活性低，CO2/O2 比值被人为拉高，加氧反应就跑不起来。氧气「从叶片表面散出去」不是机制。
extra.en: The C4 compartmentation is not leaf surface versus leaf interior but between two cell types. In mesophyll cells PEP carboxylase fixes HCO3− onto phosphoenolpyruvate to give oxaloacetate, converted to malate or aspartate; these four-carbon acids travel through plasmodesmata to the bundle sheath cells and are decarboxylated there, releasing a locally high concentration of CO2. Rubisco and the entire Calvin cycle operate only in the bundle sheath. Two key points he omits: PEP carboxylase has high substrate affinity and does not react with O2 at all, so the first fixation is immune to oxygen; and bundle sheath cells are enclosed and have low oxygen-evolving PSII activity, so the CO2/O2 ratio is deliberately raised and the oxygenase reaction cannot compete. Oxygen escaping from the leaf surface is not the mechanism.

extra.zh: 光呼吸和 C4 不是白天并行使用的两套工具。光呼吸正是 C4 要消除的对象；C4（以及 CAM 的时间分隔策略）就是为了把 Rubisco 周围的 CO2 浓度提上去，让加氧反应尽量不发生。他自己在 02:03:32 说「C4 是专门用来对付光呼吸的一种手段」，那句是对的，与随后「一边用光呼吸维持微弱的卡尔文循环」自相矛盾，但他没有察觉，也没有改口。
extra.en: Photorespiration and C4 are not two tools used side by side during the day. Photorespiration is precisely what C4 exists to eliminate: C4 (and CAM's temporal separation) raises the CO2 concentration around Rubisco so the oxygenase reaction is suppressed. At 02:03:32 he says correctly that C4 is a means specifically for countering photorespiration, which contradicts his subsequent picture of photorespiration sustaining a weak Calvin cycle — he neither notices nor retracts.

extra.zh: 算一下损失就明白光呼吸为什么是亏的：乙醇酸途径里每 2 分子 2-磷酸乙醇酸（共 4 个碳）最后只换回 1 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸（3 个碳），另 1 个碳以 CO2 放掉，等于回收率四分之三。在 C3 植物中，光呼吸可以吃掉大约四分之一的净固定碳，温度越高、气孔关得越紧，这个比例越大——这正是 C4 和 CAM 植物在热带干旱环境里占优势的原因。
extra.en: Do the arithmetic and the loss is obvious: in the glycolate pathway every two 2-phosphoglycolate (four carbons in total) yield back only one 3-phosphoglycerate (three carbons), the fourth leaving as CO2 — a three-quarters recovery. In C3 plants photorespiration can consume roughly a quarter of net fixed carbon, and the hotter it is and the tighter the stomata close, the larger that fraction — which is exactly why C4 and CAM plants dominate hot, dry environments.

quiz.q_zh: Rubisco 的加氧酶反应（光呼吸第一步）的产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does Rubisco's oxygenase reaction (the first step of photorespiration) produce?

options.zh: 2 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸，整个过程不放 CO2
options.en: Two 3-phosphoglycerate, with no CO2 released at any point

options.zh: 1 分子六碳糖，同时额外多消耗一些 NADPH
options.en: One hexose sugar, at the extra cost of some NADPH

options.zh: 1 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸和 1 分子 2-磷酸乙醇酸
options.en: One 3-phosphoglycerate plus one 2-phosphoglycolate

options.zh: 2 分子 2-磷酸乙醇酸，随后进入过氧化物酶体
options.en: Two 2-phosphoglycolate, which then enter the peroxisome

quiz.explain_zh: O2 取代 CO2 加到 RuBP 上，5 个碳被切成 3 + 2：一半仍是可用的 3-磷酸甘油酸，另一半是 2-磷酸乙醇酸这个「废料」，必须走乙醇酸途径回收，途中放 CO2 和 NH3、还耗 ATP 和还原力。羧化反应才是给出 2 分子 3-磷酸甘油酸且不放 CO2 的那一个。加氧反应不产糖，反而净亏碳。也不会得到 2 分子 2-磷酸乙醇酸——RuBP 只有 5 个碳，切不出两个 2 碳废料还剩下什么。
quiz.explain_en: O2 replaces CO2 on RuBP and the five carbons are cut 3 + 2: half remains usable 3-phosphoglycerate, the other half is the waste product 2-phosphoglycolate, which must be salvaged by the glycolate pathway at the cost of released CO2 and NH3 plus ATP and reducing power. It is the carboxylase reaction that gives two 3-phosphoglycerate and releases no CO2. The oxygenase reaction makes no sugar and loses carbon on balance. Nor can it give two 2-phosphoglycolate: RuBP has only five carbons, too few to yield two two-carbon fragments.

quiz.q_zh: C4 途径的空间分隔究竟发生在哪两处之间？
quiz.q_en: Between which two locations does the C4 pathway partition its chemistry?

options.zh: 维管束鞘细胞先固定，运到叶肉细胞脱羧
options.en: Fixation in bundle sheath cells, decarboxylation in mesophyll

options.zh: 叶肉细胞固定，运到维管束鞘细胞再脱羧
options.en: Fixation in mesophyll cells, decarboxylation in bundle sheath

options.zh: 叶片表面固定，运到叶片内部再脱羧
options.en: Fixation at the leaf surface, decarboxylation deeper inside

options.zh: 叶绿体基质固定，运到类囊体腔再脱羧
options.en: Fixation in the chloroplast stroma, decarboxylation in the lumen

quiz.explain_zh: 叶肉细胞的 PEP 羧化酶先把 HCO3− 固定成草酰乙酸并转成苹果酸或天冬氨酸，四碳酸经胞间连丝进入维管束鞘细胞脱羧，在那里堆出高浓度 CO2 供 Rubisco 使用，整个卡尔文循环只在维管束鞘细胞里跑。把两类细胞的角色对调，CO2 就会被释放在没有 Rubisco 的地方，毫无意义。表面对内部是老师的说法，但 C4 分隔的是细胞类型不是叶片深浅；基质与类囊体腔之间的分隔属于光反应和暗反应的区室问题，与 C4 无关。
quiz.explain_en: PEP carboxylase in mesophyll cells first fixes HCO3− into oxaloacetate and converts it to malate or aspartate; the four-carbon acid moves through plasmodesmata into bundle sheath cells and is decarboxylated there, building a high local CO2 concentration for Rubisco, and the entire Calvin cycle runs only in the bundle sheath. Swap the two cell types and CO2 would be released where there is no Rubisco — pointless. Surface versus interior is the teacher's version, but C4 separates cell types, not leaf depths, and the stroma-versus-lumen split is the light/dark compartment question, unrelated to C4.

quiz.q_zh: 光呼吸与 C4 途径的关系应该怎么描述？
quiz.q_en: How should the relationship between photorespiration and the C4 pathway be described?

options.zh: C4 靠加快光呼吸来消耗掉多余的氧气
options.en: C4 speeds up photorespiration so as to consume the excess oxygen

options.zh: 光呼吸为 C4 途径提供草酰乙酸底物
options.en: Photorespiration supplies the oxaloacetate that C4 needs

options.zh: C4 提高 CO2/O2 比值，从而抑制光呼吸
options.en: C4 raises the CO2/O2 ratio and thereby suppresses photorespiration

options.zh: 光呼吸与 C4 白天并行，共同维持产糖
options.en: The two run in parallel by day and jointly sustain sugar output

quiz.explain_zh: C4 存在的理由就是消除光呼吸：把 CO2 泵到维管束鞘细胞里浓缩起来，Rubisco 周围 CO2/O2 比值一高，加氧反应就竞争不过羧化反应。老师自己也说过 C4 是「专门用来对付光呼吸的手段」，但同一段又说两者白天并用、共同维持产糖，这两句不能同时成立——光呼吸是净亏损，没有产糖能力可供维持。C4 也不消耗氧气，它绕开氧而不是烧掉氧。四碳酸来自 PEP 羧化酶固定 HCO3−，与光呼吸无关。
quiz.explain_en: C4 exists in order to eliminate photorespiration: by pumping and concentrating CO2 in the bundle sheath it raises the CO2/O2 ratio around Rubisco so that the oxygenase reaction cannot compete with carboxylation. He himself calls C4 a means specifically for countering photorespiration, yet in the same stretch has the two working in parallel to sustain sugar output — both cannot be true, since photorespiration is a net loss with no sugar output to sustain. C4 also consumes no oxygen; it bypasses oxygen rather than burning it. The four-carbon acids come from PEP carboxylase fixing HCO3−, nothing to do with photorespiration.

title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】课程收尾：剩余选读章节与下一次约课
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Wrapping up: the remaining optional chapters and scheduling the next session

points.zh: 笔记后面还有分子生物学的内容：DNA 的重组方式、位点特异性重组，感兴趣可以稍微看一下。
points.en: The rest of his notes covers molecular biology: modes of DNA recombination and site-specific recombination, worth a glance if interested.

points.zh: 接着是转座和转座子是什么。
points.en: Then transposition and what transposons are.

points.zh: 再往后是 DNA 的复制过程、转录怎么产生 mRNA、转录的调节、以及翻译的过程，他说这几部分自己写得相当详细。
points.en: After that come DNA replication, transcription to mRNA, transcriptional regulation and translation, all of which he says his notes cover in considerable detail.

points.zh: 最后面是考研英语阅读的内容，不用看。
points.en: The very last part is graduate-entrance English reading material and can be ignored.

points.zh: 他宣布经典生物化学的内容到此全部结束，并坦承有两三节课自己听得不是很到位、要再回去翻一翻；有疑问直接微信发他，课都有录屏。
points.en: He declares the classical biochemistry material finished, admits that two or three sessions were not his best and that he will go back over them, and invites questions by WeChat since everything was screen-recorded.

points.zh: 学生提出再约一节课，过一过新冠相关的病毒、农学、蛋白质学内容；他说这块一个小时甚至半个多小时就够，因为不是那么成体系的知识点，让学生先把感兴趣的问题整理好发过去，他备完课统一讲。
points.en: The student asks for one more session on COVID-related virology, agronomy and protein science; he says an hour, even half an hour, would do since the material is not systematic, and asks the student to collect the questions of interest and send them over so he can prepare and cover them together.

extra.zh: 关于光合作用这一章，他在本讲里两次明确表示没有把握：01:48:35 说「我不敢保证我说的百分之百是对的」「我真摸不准光合作用这一张到底哪里是重点」，02:04:03 又说「真正的重点在哪我也不知道，你还是看看你们的教材」。这不是谦辞，本部分的更正卡片正是按标准教科书逐条补上的；考试范围以教材和授课要求为准，本讲义不替代它。
extra.en: On the photosynthesis chapter he twice states plainly that he is unsure: at 01:48:35 that he cannot guarantee everything he says is correct and cannot tell where the emphasis lies, and at 02:04:03 that he does not know where the real emphasis is and the student should consult their own textbook. This is not modesty — the correction cards in this part supply the standard textbook account point by point. What the exam covers is set by the textbook and the course, and these notes do not substitute for them.

extra.zh: 「后面这些都是选修」指的是他自己这份笔记的编排，不等于考纲。分子生物学那几节——DNA 复制、转录及其调节、翻译——在绝大多数生物化学考试里都是要考的核心内容，别按「选读」处理。真正可以放心跳过的只有最后那部分考研英语阅读材料。
extra.en: Everything after this is optional refers to the layout of his own notes, not to the syllabus. The molecular biology sections — DNA replication, transcription and its regulation, translation — are core examinable material in almost any biochemistry course and should not be treated as optional reading. The only part that can safely be skipped is the graduate-entrance English reading material at the end.

extra.zh: 复习本段光合作用时，先把三条骨架捋直，其余细节再补：一，水由 PSII 的放氧复合体裂解，NADP+ 由 PSI 经铁氧还蛋白和 FNR 还原，Z 图的两次上坡就是这两个光系统；二，质子积累在类囊体腔、经 CF0F1 流回基质，方向与线粒体相反；三，光反应在类囊体膜上，卡尔文循环在类囊体之外的基质里。这三条立住了，Rubisco、光呼吸和 C4 才有地方挂。
extra.en: When revising this photosynthesis material, get three structural facts straight before any detail: first, water is split by PSII's oxygen-evolving complex while NADP+ is reduced at PSI via ferredoxin and FNR — the two uphill jumps of the Z-scheme are these two photosystems; second, protons accumulate in the thylakoid lumen and return to the stroma through CF0F1, the reverse of the mitochondrial arrangement; third, the light reactions run on the thylakoid membrane while the Calvin cycle runs in the stroma outside it. With those in place, Rubisco, photorespiration and C4 have somewhere to hang.

quiz.q_zh: 把光合作用两个阶段的区室关系排对，下面哪一条成立？
quiz.q_en: Which statement correctly places the two phases of photosynthesis?

options.zh: 光反应在外被双层膜，卡尔文循环在腔内
options.en: Light reactions in the envelope membranes, Calvin cycle in the lumen

options.zh: 光反应在类囊体膜上，卡尔文循环在基质
options.en: Light reactions on the thylakoid membrane, Calvin cycle in the stroma

options.zh: 光反应在基质里，卡尔文循环在类囊体膜上
options.en: Light reactions in the stroma, Calvin cycle on the thylakoid membrane

options.zh: 光反应在类囊体腔，卡尔文循环也在腔内
options.en: Light reactions in the thylakoid lumen, Calvin cycle also in the lumen

quiz.explain_zh: 光反应的四个复合体 PSII、cyt b6f、PSI、CF0F1 全都嵌在类囊体膜上，而 Rubisco 是可溶的基质蛋白，卡尔文循环就在类囊体之外的基质里进行——这正是「光反应在膜上、暗反应在基质」这句口诀的含义。把两者对调等于让可溶酶去做跨膜的电荷分离。类囊体腔只是质子和氧的去处，没有固碳酶系。外被双层膜不含光合复合体，只负责代谢物进出叶绿体。
quiz.explain_en: The four light-reaction complexes — PSII, cyt b6f, PSI and CF0F1 — are all embedded in the thylakoid membrane, while Rubisco is a soluble stromal protein and the Calvin cycle runs in the stroma outside the thylakoid; that is exactly what the slogan light reactions on the membrane, dark reactions in the stroma means. Swapping them would ask a soluble enzyme to perform transmembrane charge separation. The lumen is merely where protons and oxygen end up and holds no carbon-fixing enzymes, and the envelope membranes carry no photosynthetic complexes, only metabolite transporters.

quiz.q_zh: 光反应的两个产物 ATP 和 NADPH 分别生成在哪一侧？
quiz.q_en: On which side are the two light-reaction products, ATP and NADPH, generated?

options.zh: ATP 生成在膜间隙，NADPH 在基质
options.en: ATP is made in the envelope space, NADPH in stroma

options.zh: ATP 生成在腔内，NADPH 也在腔内
options.en: ATP is made in the lumen and NADPH there too

options.zh: ATP 和 NADPH 都生成在基质这一侧
options.en: Both ATP and NADPH are made on the stromal side

options.zh: ATP 生成在基质侧，NADPH 在腔内
options.en: ATP is made on the stromal side, NADPH in the lumen

quiz.explain_zh: CF0F1 的头部（CF1）伸在基质里，质子从腔内流出时在基质侧合成 ATP；FNR 的活性位点也朝向基质，NADP+ 在基质侧被还原成 NADPH。两个产物都产在基质，正好交给同在基质里的卡尔文循环，整个设计是自洽的。把产物放进腔里说不通，因为腔里既没有 ADP/Pi 的供给，也没有 NADP+ 池。外被膜间隙根本不参与光合作用的能量转换。
quiz.explain_en: The CF1 head of CF0F1 protrudes into the stroma, so ATP is synthesised on the stromal side as protons leave the lumen, and FNR's active site likewise faces the stroma, where NADP+ is reduced to NADPH. Both products appear in the stroma and are handed straight to the Calvin cycle there — the design is self-consistent. Putting either product in the lumen makes no sense, since the lumen supplies neither ADP and Pi nor a NADP+ pool, and the envelope intermembrane space plays no part in photosynthetic energy conversion at all.
